zh.tag: AI 代理团队级记忆中枢，沉淀对话、文档与代码为可复用资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个为 AI 代理设计的团队级记忆中枢，将对话、文档和代码转化为四种可复用的记忆资产（聊天记忆、技能、LLM 维基、代码图谱），并支持跨代理和框架的治理、共享与装备。它旨在减少重复工作，让代理在团队中持续积累知识。
zh.content: 仓库包含部署脚本（一键启动 memory-core、memory-hub 和 proxy）、核心服务代码、迁移工具，以及详细的安装文档（中英文）。提供面板用于管理记忆资产。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js >=22.16，支持 OpenClaw 和 Hermes 等代理框架，使用 TencentDB 作为存储后端。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1057 星，总星数达 16543，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。其“团队记忆”理念切中 AI 代理协作痛点，且提供一键部署，迅速吸引开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理添加持久记忆，减少重复上下文输入。
团队协作场景：共享代理记忆，提升团队知识复用效率。
个人开发者：构建“一人公司”式的代理团队，自动化工作流。
研究爱好者：探索代理记忆管理与跨框架集成。

en.tag: Team-level memory hub for AI agents, turning conversations, docs, and code into reusable assets
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents, transforming conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks. It aims to reduce repetitive work by enabling agents to accumulate knowledge persistently.
en.content: The repo includes deployment scripts (one-click start for memory-core, memory-hub, and proxy), core service code, migration tools, and detailed installation docs (EN/CN). A panel is provided for managing memory assets.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.16, supports agent frameworks like OpenClaw and Hermes, and uses TencentDB as the storage backend.
en.hot: Gained 1,057 stars today, reaching 16,543 total, and topped the GitHub Trending daily chart. Its 'team memory' concept addresses the pain point of AI agent collaboration, and one-click deployment quickly attracts developers.
uses: AI agent developers: add persistent memory to agents, reducing repetitive context input.
Team collaboration: share agent memory to improve knowledge reuse efficiency.
Solo developers: build a 'one-person company' agent team for automated workflows.
Researchers/enthusiasts: explore agent memory management and cross-framework integration.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打包资深工程师工作流与质量门禁
zh.what: 这个仓库提供一套生产级工程技能，将资深工程师的流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为 AI 代理可遵循的规范。它通过斜杠命令和自动触发，覆盖从规格定义到发布的完整开发生命周期。
zh.content: 仓库包含 24 个技能，每个技能对应一个开发阶段或关注点（如代码审查、测试驱动开发、Web 性能审计），并提供 8 个斜杠命令（/spec、/plan、/build 等）来激活相应技能。还包含一个 CLI 安装工具，支持 70+ 代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，依赖 Vercel Labs 的 skills CLI（npx skills add）进行安装，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流 AI 编码代理。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上获得 8.3 万星标，今日新增 593，位居趋势榜第二。它解决了 AI 编码代理缺乏工程纪律的痛点，将资深工程师的经验系统化，受到开发者广泛关注。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理进行开发的工程师，希望提升代码质量和一致性
团队想将内部最佳实践标准化并让代理自动遵循
对 AI 辅助开发流程感兴趣的技术管理者或架构师

en.tag: Packaging senior-engineer workflows and quality gates for AI coding agents
en.what: This repo provides production-grade engineering skills that encode the workflows, quality gates, and best practices of senior engineers for AI agents to follow. It covers the full development lifecycle from spec to ship via slash commands and automatic triggers.
en.content: The repo contains 24 skills, each mapped to a development phase or concern (e.g., code review, TDD, web performance), and 8 slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, etc.) to activate them. It also includes a CLI installer supporting 70+ agents.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, relies on the Vercel Labs skills CLI (npx skills add) for installation, compatible with major AI coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc.
en.hot: With 83k stars and +593 today, ranking #2 on trending, it addresses the pain point of AI coding agents lacking engineering discipline by systematizing senior engineer experience, gaining wide attention.
uses: Engineers using AI coding agents who want to improve code quality and consistency
Teams looking to standardize internal best practices and have agents follow them automatically
Technical managers or architects interested in AI-assisted development workflows

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一个虚拟文件系统与执行环境
zh.what: Cloudflare Computer 是一个位于 Durable Object 内的虚拟文件系统，为 AI 代理提供可插拔的执行环境。它通过 workspace.runtime.exec 作为统一入口，支持容器、隔离 shell 和隔离 JavaScript 三种后端。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心包 @cloudflare/computer、文档（docs/）、示例（examples/）以及贡献指南。示例展示了容器、worker-shell 和 worker-javascript 三种用法。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Cloudflare Durable Objects、SQLite、Workers RPC、capnweb 协议，以及 just-bash 和 ECMAScript 模块。
zh.hot: 今日新增 2802 星，总星数 4891，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3。它展示了在边缘运行 AI 代理的新范式，引发开发者关注。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理提供文件系统与执行环境，构建可交互的代理应用
边缘计算爱好者：探索在 Cloudflare Workers 上运行容器和隔离环境的可能性
原型验证：适合实验和探索，不适合生产环境

en.tag: Give your agent a virtual filesystem and execution environment
en.what: Cloudflare Computer is a virtual filesystem living inside a Durable Object, providing a pluggable execution surface for AI agents. It exposes a single entry point via workspace.runtime.exec, with three backends: container, isolate shell, and isolate JavaScript.
en.content: The repo contains the core package @cloudflare/computer, docs/, examples/, and contribution guides. Examples demonstrate container, worker-shell, and worker-javascript usage.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, leveraging Cloudflare Durable Objects, SQLite, Workers RPC, capnweb protocol, and just-bash or ECMAScript modules.
en.hot: Gained 2802 stars today, reaching 4891 total, ranking #3 on GitHub Trending. It showcases a new paradigm for running AI agents at the edge, sparking developer interest.
uses: AI agent developers: provide agents with a filesystem and execution environment to build interactive agent apps
Edge computing enthusiasts: explore running containers and isolates on Cloudflare Workers
Prototyping: suitable for experiments and exploration, not for production

zh.tag: 面向真实工程师的 AI 代理技能集
zh.what: 这是一套由资深工程师设计的 AI 代理技能（skills），旨在帮助开发者进行真正的工程开发，而非简单的“氛围编码”。它提供可组合、易定制的小型技能模块，适用于任何模型，并支持通过 skills.sh 或 Claude Code 插件安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个可选的技能模块（如 /triage、/setup-matt-pocock-skills 等），以及一个快速安装脚本和 Claude Code 插件配置。用户通过 npx 命令选择安装，并运行设置向导完成配置。
zh.stack: 基于 Shell 脚本和 Node.js（npx），可选集成 Claude Code 插件。依赖 skills.sh 生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 18.6 万+ Star 和每日 2251 新增，该项目因解决 AI 编程中“真实工程”痛点而爆火，提供比 GSD、BMAD 等更可控、可定制的方案。
uses: 专业开发者 —— 希望用 AI 辅助真实工程开发，而非简单代码生成
AI 代理用户 —— 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等工具的工程师，需要结构化技能集
技术团队 —— 统一团队 AI 工作流，提升代码质量和可维护性

en.tag: AI agent skills for real engineers
en.what: A set of AI agent skills designed by a senior engineer for real engineering work, not vibe coding. It offers small, composable, and customizable skill modules that work with any model, installable via skills.sh or as a Claude Code plugin.
en.content: The repo contains multiple optional skill modules (e.g., /triage, /setup-matt-pocock-skills), a quick install script, and a Claude Code plugin configuration. Users select skills via npx and run a setup wizard to configure.
en.stack: Built on Shell scripts and Node.js (npx), with optional Claude Code plugin integration. Depends on the skills.sh ecosystem.
en.hot: With 186k+ stars and 2251 daily additions, this project exploded by addressing the pain point of 'real engineering' in AI coding, offering a more controllable and customizable alternative to GSD, BMAD, etc.
uses: Professional developers — who want AI to assist real engineering, not just code generation
AI agent users — engineers using Claude Code, Codex, etc., needing structured skill sets
Tech teams — to standardize AI workflows and improve code quality and maintainability

zh.tag: 开源身份认证与单点登录平台
zh.what: authentik 是一个开源的身份提供商（IdP），为现代应用提供单点登录（SSO）功能。它支持 SAML、OAuth2/OIDC、LDAP、RADIUS 等多种协议，适用于从个人实验室到大型生产集群的自托管场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 authentik 的核心服务、Outpost（用于代理和认证的组件）以及 Web 前端。提供 Docker Compose、Kubernetes Helm Chart、AWS CloudFormation 和 DigitalOcean Marketplace 等多种部署方式。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，后端基于 Django，前端使用 Web 技术（如 JavaScript/TypeScript）。依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis 等常见基础设施组件。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代 Okta、Auth0 等商业 IdP 的方案，authentik 在自托管社区中广受欢迎。今日新增 138 星，总星数达 23168，位列 GitHub 趋势榜第五。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望完全掌控身份认证基础设施的个人或团队。
中小企业：需要替代昂贵商业 IdP 的可靠身份管理方案。
开发者：需要为应用集成 SSO 或统一认证流程的开发者。
DevOps 工程师：在 Kubernetes 或云环境中部署和管理身份服务。

en.tag: Open-source identity provider and SSO solution
en.what: authentik is an open-source Identity Provider (IdP) that provides single sign-on (SSO) for modern applications. It supports protocols like SAML, OAuth2/OIDC, LDAP, RADIUS, and more, designed for self-hosting from small labs to large production clusters.
en.content: The repository contains the core server, outposts (for proxy and authentication), and web frontend. Deployment options include Docker Compose, Kubernetes Helm, AWS CloudFormation, and DigitalOcean Marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily written in Python, with backend based on Django and frontend using web technologies (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript). It relies on common infrastructure components like PostgreSQL and Redis.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to commercial IdPs like Okta and Auth0, authentik is popular in the self-hosting community. With 138 stars today and 23,168 total, it ranks #5 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: individuals or teams wanting full control over their identity infrastructure.
SMBs: seeking a reliable identity management solution to replace costly commercial IdPs.
Developers: needing to integrate SSO or unify authentication flows in their applications.
DevOps engineers: deploying and managing identity services in Kubernetes or cloud environments.

zh.tag: 为长期运行的 AI 代理团队打造的轻量级循环工程状态内核
zh.what: LoopX 是一个本地优先的控制平面，用于管理长期运行的 AI 代理工作。它保持目标、门禁、待办事项、证据、配额和交接的稳定，而 Codex、Claude Code 等代理执行有界回合。它不替代代理运行时，而是提供可审查、可重启、易于交接的循环工程。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心状态内核、控制平面看板、文档（包括概念入门、产品发布就绪度）、示例循环、以及 Python 包（pyproject.toml）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python（3.11+），依赖包括用于状态管理的库，可能涉及异步处理，但具体依赖未列出。
zh.hot: 今日新增 847 星，总星数 2944，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6 名。它解决了 AI 代理长期运行中的关键痛点，如目标漂移、证据过期和交接困难，因此受到关注。
uses: 开发者和团队使用 Codex、Claude Code 等编码代理进行长期项目，需要管理目标和进度。
需要将多个代理的工作进行交接和协作的团队。
对代理工作流进行监控、复盘和持续改进的工程管理者。
希望在不更换代理运行时的情况下，增加控制层和可审计性的用户。

en.tag: Lightweight loop engineering state kernel for long-running AI agent teams
en.what: LoopX is a local-first control plane for managing long-running AI agent work. It keeps objectives, gates, todos, evidence, quota, and handoffs stable while agents like Codex or Claude Code execute bounded turns. It doesn't replace agent runtimes but provides reviewable, restartable, and handoff-friendly loop engineering.
en.content: The repo includes the core state kernel, control-plane board, docs (concept primer, release readiness), example loops, and a Python package (pyproject.toml).
en.stack: Primary language is Python (3.11+), with dependencies for state management, possibly async, but specifics not listed.
en.hot: Gained 847 stars today, total 2944, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. It addresses critical pain points in long-running AI agent work like objective drift, stale evidence, and handoff difficulties, driving its popularity.
uses: Developers and teams using coding agents like Codex or Claude Code for long-running projects needing goal and progress management.
Teams that need to hand off work between multiple agents or peers.
Engineering managers who want to monitor, review, and continuously improve agent workflows.
Users who want to add a control layer and auditability without replacing their agent runtime.

zh.tag: Google 核心 Java 库，集合、并发、I/O 等工具集
zh.what: Guava 是 Google 提供的一组核心 Java 库，包含新的集合类型（如 multimap 和 multiset）、不可变集合、图库，以及并发、I/O、哈希、基本类型、字符串等工具。它被 Google 内部大多数 Java 项目广泛使用，也被许多其他公司采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Guava 的源代码、构建配置（Maven/Gradle）、文档和示例，分为 JRE 和 Android 两个版本，支持通过 Maven 或 Gradle 依赖引入。
zh.stack: 基于 Java 开发，支持 JDK 1.8+，提供 JRE 和 Android 两种 flavor，使用 Maven 和 Gradle 构建。
zh.hot: 作为 Java 开发的事实标准库，Guava 拥有超过 5.1 万 star，今日新增 13 个，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Java 开发者：在日常项目中简化集合、并发和 I/O 操作
Android 开发者：使用 Android flavor 获得兼容支持
库作者：利用 Guava 的工具类提高代码质量和效率

en.tag: Google core Java libraries: collections, concurrency, I/O, and more
en.what: Guava is a set of core Java libraries from Google that includes new collection types (such as multimap and multiset), immutable collections, a graph library, and utilities for concurrency, I/O, hashing, primitives, strings, and more. It is widely used in most Java projects at Google and by many other companies.
en.content: The repository contains Guava's source code, build configuration (Maven/Gradle), documentation, and examples, with two flavors: JRE and Android, and can be added via Maven or Gradle dependencies.
en.stack: Developed in Java, requires JDK 1.8+, offers JRE and Android flavors, built with Maven and Gradle.
en.hot: As a de facto standard library for Java development, Guava has over 51k stars, with 13 new stars today, remaining popular among developers.
uses: Java developers: simplify collections, concurrency, and I/O in daily projects
Android developers: use the Android flavor for compatibility
Library authors: leverage Guava's utilities to improve code quality and efficiency

zh.tag: 免费开源的中国中小学及大学PDF教材合集
zh.what: 这是一个聚合了中国小学、初中、高中及大学各学科PDF教材的开源仓库，旨在打破教育资源获取壁垒，让所有人免费获得正版教材。项目特别强调促进义务教育普及、消除地区教育贫困，并帮助海外华人子女了解国内教育。
zh.content: 仓库按学段（小学、初中、高中、大学）和学科（数学、语文、英语等）分类，存放大量PDF文件，并附有README说明项目由来和愿景。
zh.stack: 主要包含PDF文件，无复杂技术栈；主语言标记为Roff（可能因部分文档格式），实际为纯文档仓库。
zh.hot: 凭借77k+星标和日增134的热度，它因免费提供稀缺教材资源而爆火，回应了教育资源不公的痛点，并吸引了大量学生、家长和教育工作者。
uses: 学生：免费获取正版教材PDF，辅助学习和复习
家长：为子女提供课外辅导材料，尤其适合海外华人家庭
教育工作者：分享和参考教材内容，促进教学资源公平
自学者：获取系统化教材，进行自我提升

en.tag: Free open-source collection of Chinese K-12 and college PDF textbooks
en.what: This is an open-source repository aggregating PDF textbooks for Chinese primary, junior high, senior high, and university levels, aiming to break down barriers to educational resources and provide free access to authentic textbooks. It emphasizes promoting compulsory education, reducing regional educational poverty, and helping overseas Chinese children stay connected with domestic education.
en.content: The repository organizes PDF files by education level (primary, junior, senior, university) and subject (math, Chinese, English, etc.), with a README explaining the project's origin and vision.
en.stack: Primarily consists of PDF files with no complex tech stack; main language marked as Roff (likely due to some document formats), but it's essentially a document repository.
en.hot: With 77k+ stars and 134 daily additions, it went viral for providing scarce textbook resources for free, addressing educational inequality and attracting students, parents, and educators.
uses: Students: Access free authentic textbook PDFs for study and review
Parents: Provide supplementary materials for children, especially overseas Chinese families
Educators: Share and reference textbook content to promote educational equity
Self-learners: Obtain systematic textbooks for self-improvement

zh.tag: 用自然语言构建、部署并运行 AI 代理的开源平台
zh.what: AutoGPT 是一个开源平台，允许用户用自然语言描述目标，自动生成并运行 AI 代理来完成完整的工作流程。它提供可视化构建器、调度和触发功能，让非程序员也能轻松使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoGPT 平台的源代码、文档、示例和可视化构建器。它提供四种交互界面：AutoPilot（对话式创建代理）、代理仪表盘、构建器和调度器，并支持自托管。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖现代 AI 模型和工具链，支持与外部服务集成。
zh.hot: AutoGPT 拥有超过 18.6 万星标，是 AI 代理领域的先驱项目，被 Andrej Karpathy 等专家誉为提示工程的下一个前沿。它让非程序员也能轻松创建 AI 代理，因此广受关注。
uses: 希望自动化重复性工作流程的职场人士，通过自然语言创建代理来节省时间。
对 AI 代理感兴趣的开发者，用于学习和构建自定义代理。
企业团队需要部署可调度的 AI 代理来处理数据、报告等任务。
教育者或研究者探索 AI 代理的潜力，进行实验和教学。

en.tag: Open-source platform to build, deploy, and run AI agents with plain English
en.what: AutoGPT is an open-source platform that lets users describe goals in plain English and automatically builds and runs AI agents to complete entire workflows. It offers a visual builder, scheduling, and triggers, making it accessible even to non-programmers.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, documentation, examples, and visual builder for the AutoGPT platform. It offers four interaction surfaces: AutoPilot (conversational agent creation), agent dashboard, builder, and scheduler, with self-hosting support.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging modern AI models and toolchains, with integrations for external services.
en.hot: With over 186k stars, AutoGPT is a pioneering project in the AI agent space, praised by experts like Andrej Karpathy as the next frontier of prompt engineering. Its accessibility to non-programmers drives its popularity.
uses: Professionals looking to automate repetitive workflows by creating agents with natural language to save time.
Developers interested in AI agents, for learning and building custom agents.
Teams needing to deploy scheduled AI agents for tasks like data processing or reporting.
Educators or researchers exploring the potential of AI agents for experiments and teaching.

zh.tag: 面向 MCP 的本地代码智能图谱，让 AI 编码工具只读关键上下文
zh.what: code-review-graph 通过 Tree-sitter 解析代码库，构建持久的结构化代码地图并增量追踪变更。它作为 MCP 服务器运行，让 AI 编码助手在代码审阅或处理大型仓库时只获取真正相关的上下文，从而显著减少 token 消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具与 MCP 服务器实现，提供 build、install 等命令，并附带 benchmark 数据、GitHub Action 集成文档及多语言 README。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+ 开发，使用 Tree-sitter 进行代码解析，通过 MCP 协议与 AI 工具通信，支持 pip/pipx 安装。
zh.hot: 项目精准击中 AI 编程“token 燃烧”痛点，宣称在真实仓库中实现 38 倍至 528 倍的上下文压缩；凭借近 2 万星标与单日 74 星增速登上 Trending 前十，反映出开发者对低成本、高精度 AI 代码审阅的强烈需求。
uses: 使用 AI 编码助手（如 Cursor、Claude Code）的开发者 —— 降低代码审阅时的 token 消耗与等待时间
大型代码库维护者 —— 在 monorepo 或遗留项目中为 AI 提供精准、增量更新的代码上下文
追求数据隐私的团队 —— 通过 Local-first 架构在本地构建代码图谱，避免上传源码至云端

en.content: The repository contains the Rust core library, bindings for Python/Node.js/WebAssembly, documentation, and benchmarks. Key features include smart classification, position-aware text extraction, Markdown conversion, table detection, CID font support, and multi-column layout handling.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation with no ML models; the only dependency is lopdf for PDF parsing. Bindings are provided for Python, Node.js, and browser WebAssembly.
en.hot: Gaining 1,190 stars today to reach 12,545 total, it's hot due to its superior benchmark performance, significantly faster than alternatives, and its ability to handle ~54% of text-based PDFs without OCR, saving costs.
uses: Developers needing fast local PDF-to-Markdown conversion or text extraction

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Native 构建，并集成了 Metro bundler 和 Babel 等工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 51.4k 星标，是 React 生态中构建跨平台应用的主流选择，今日新增 35 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: React 开发者希望快速构建跨平台移动应用
初创团队需要低成本发布 iOS 和 Android 应用
需要热更新和 OTA 更新的应用开发场景
教育或原型设计，利用 Snack 在浏览器中快速测试

en.tag: An open-source framework for building universal native apps with React
en.what: Expo is an open-source framework that lets developers write once in React and run native apps on Android, iOS, and the web. It provides a full suite of tools and services to streamline development, building, and deployment.
en.content: The repo contains the source code for the Expo SDK, CLI, documentation, sample apps, and related libraries, with support for trying it in the browser via Snack.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on React Native, and integrates tools like Metro bundler and Babel.
en.hot: With 51.4k stars, it's a leading choice for cross-platform apps in the React ecosystem, gaining 35 stars today and consistently attracting developer attention.
uses: React developers looking to quickly build cross-platform mobile apps
Startups needing to ship iOS and Android apps with low overhead
Scenarios requiring hot reload and over-the-air updates
Education or prototyping, using Snack for in-browser testing

zh.tag: 开源项目管理工具，Jira/Linear 替代品
zh.what: Plane 是一个开源的项目管理平台，用于管理任务、冲刺、文档和问题分类。它旨在替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp 等商业工具，提供现代、简洁的界面和丰富的功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的项目源码，包括前端（TypeScript/React）和后端（Python/Django），以及 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署配置。提供 Cloud 和自托管两种部署方式，支持丰富的功能如工作项、周期、模块和视图。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 TypeScript、React（前端）和 Python、Django（后端），数据库使用 PostgreSQL，支持 Docker 和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: 作为开源替代品，Plane 在开发者社区中广受欢迎，Star 数已超过 5.5 万，今日新增 95 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。其现代 UI 和丰富功能吸引了大量寻求自托管项目管理方案的用户。
uses: 团队希望从 Jira 等商业工具迁移到开源方案
需要自托管、数据可控的项目管理平台
开发者想要定制和扩展项目管理功能
个人或小团队寻找免费且功能全面的项目管理工具

en.tag: Open-source project management tool, Jira/Linear alternative
en.what: Plane is an open-source project management platform for managing tasks, sprints, docs, and triage. It aims to replace commercial tools like Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp with a modern, clean interface and rich features.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, including frontend (TypeScript/React) and backend (Python/Django), along with Docker and Kubernetes deployment configs. It offers both Cloud and self-hosted deployment, with features like work items, cycles, modules, and views.
en.stack: Tech stack includes TypeScript, React (frontend) and Python, Django (backend), with PostgreSQL as database, supporting Docker and Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative, Plane is popular among developers, with over 55k stars and 95 new stars today, ranking #6 on the TypeScript daily trending. Its modern UI and rich features attract users seeking self-hosted project management solutions.
uses: Teams looking to migrate from commercial tools like Jira to open-source
Organizations needing self-hosted, data-controlled project management
Developers wanting to customize and extend project management features
Individuals or small teams seeking a free and feature-rich project management tool

zh.tag: 开源 AI 编程代理，终端与桌面双形态
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，能在终端或桌面应用中自主完成编码任务。它支持多种主流模型，可执行代码、管理文件，并具备权限控制与沙箱隔离。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 CLI、终端 UI、桌面应用（BETA）以及控制台，提供安装脚本、多语言 README 和丰富的配置选项。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Bun 作为运行时，支持 npm 全局安装，并集成多种 AI 模型提供商。
zh.hot: 凭借 19.4 万 Star 和每日 500+ 新增，OpenCode 成为开源 AI 编程代理的标杆，提供终端与桌面双体验，满足开发者对自主编码工具的需求。
uses: 开发者：在终端中快速使用 AI 代理辅助编码，提高效率
团队：通过桌面应用进行可视化代码审查与协作
学习 AI 编程：探索自主代理如何执行复杂任务

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent with terminal & desktop apps
en.what: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that autonomously completes coding tasks in terminal or desktop apps. It supports major models, executes code, manages files, with permission control and sandboxing.
en.content: The repo includes core CLI, terminal UI, desktop app (BETA), and console, with install scripts, multilingual READMEs, and extensive configuration.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses Bun as runtime, installable via npm, integrates multiple AI model providers.
en.hot: With 194k stars and 500+ daily additions, OpenCode leads open-source AI coding agents, offering terminal & desktop experiences for autonomous coding.
uses: Developers: quickly use AI agent in terminal to boost coding efficiency
Teams: use desktop app for visual code review and collaboration
AI coding learners: explore how autonomous agents handle complex tasks

zh.tag: 基于 Claude Code 的 AI 求职申请框架
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 驱动的求职申请框架，基于 Claude Code 构建。它可以评估职位描述、定制简历、撰写求职信并准备面试。用户可以 fork 仓库，填写个人资料，然后让 Claude 自动处理求职流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的求职工作流，包括 /setup、/scrape 和 /apply 等命令，以及针对丹麦求职市场的搜索技能（如 Jobindex、Jobnet 等），但设计为可替换为本地求职网站。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Claude Code 构建，依赖 Claude 的 API 进行自然语言处理和自动化操作。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 月榜排名第 13，本月新增 318 星，总星数达 30543。作者用该框架成功找到工作，证明了其实际效果，吸引了大量求职者关注。
uses: 求职者：希望自动化求职流程，提高申请效率
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流感兴趣，想学习或扩展框架
招聘者：了解 AI 在招聘中的应用，或用于筛选候选人

en.tag: AI job application framework built on Claude Code
en.what: An AI-powered job application framework built on Claude Code. It evaluates job postings, tailors CVs, writes cover letters, and prepares for interviews. Users fork the repo, fill in their profile, and let Claude handle the job search workflow.
en.content: The repo contains a structured workflow with commands like /setup, /scrape, and /apply, along with job portal search skills for the Danish market (Jobindex, Jobnet, etc.), but designed to be swapped for local job boards.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Claude Code, leveraging Claude's API for natural language processing and automation.
en.hot: Ranked #13 on GitHub Trending monthly, with 318 stars added this month, totaling 30,543. The author used the framework to land a job, proving its effectiveness and attracting many job seekers.
uses: Job seekers: want to automate job applications and increase efficiency
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows, want to learn or extend the framework
Recruiters: understand AI applications in hiring, or use for candidate screening

zh.tag: 开源一体化企业管理平台（ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM）
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个开源的企业管理平台，整合了 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 和项目管理等功能，适用于协作、按需和共享经济场景。它提供无头 API 和可定制的前端，帮助企业高效管理运营。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源码，包括前端应用（如管理面板）、后端 API、数据库模型、文档和部署配置。还集成了 Ever Works（自主代理运行时）和 Ever Teams（工作与生产力平台）的链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，前端采用 React/Next.js（Web）和 React Native/Expo（移动端），后端基于 NestJS，数据库支持 PostgreSQL 等。
zh.hot: 今日新增 52 星，总星数 4293，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 9 名。其全面的功能集和近期发布的 Ever Works 代理运行时吸引了关注。
uses: 中小企业：需要一体化 ERP/CRM/HRM 解决方案，降低软件成本
开发者：希望定制或扩展企业管理功能，利用无头 API 构建自定义应用
共享经济平台：需要管理协作、按需服务的业务运营
人力资源团队：使用 ATS 和员工跟踪功能优化招聘和绩效管理

en.tag: Open-source all-in-one business management platform (ERP/CRM/HRM/ATS/PM)
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open-source business management platform that integrates ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management, designed for collaborative, on-demand, and sharing economies. It offers headless APIs and customizable frontends to streamline business operations.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, including frontend apps (e.g., admin panel), backend APIs, database models, documentation, and deployment configurations. It also links to Ever Works (an autonomous agentic runtime) and Ever Teams (a work & productivity platform).
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, using React/Next.js for web frontend and React Native/Expo for mobile, with a NestJS backend and PostgreSQL support.
en.hot: Gained 52 stars today, reaching 4293 total, and ranked #9 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. Its comprehensive feature set and the recent release of Ever Works agentic runtime have drawn attention.
uses: SMBs: need an all-in-one ERP/CRM/HRM solution to reduce software costs
Developers: want to customize or extend business management features using headless APIs
Sharing economy platforms: need to manage collaborative, on-demand service operations
HR teams: use ATS and employee tracking to optimize recruitment and performance

zh.tag: 微软开源代码编辑器，全球开发者首选 IDE
zh.what: Visual Studio Code 是一个由微软开发并开源的代码编辑器，结合了编辑器的简洁性和开发者所需的编辑-构建-调试核心循环。它提供全面的代码编辑、导航和理解支持，以及轻量级调试、丰富的扩展模型和与现有工具的轻量集成。
zh.content: 该仓库包含 VS Code 产品的完整源代码（Code - OSS），包括编辑器核心、扩展 API、以及构建和测试脚本。还发布了路线图、月度迭代计划和最终计划。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 编写，基于 Electron 框架，支持跨平台（Windows、macOS、Linux）。依赖 Node.js 和多种前端技术。
zh.hot: VS Code 是当前最流行的代码编辑器，拥有超过 18.8 万星标，今日新增 86 星，持续霸榜。其开源模式、丰富的扩展生态和活跃的社区使其长期保持热度。
uses: 软件开发者：日常编码、调试和版本控制
技术团队：统一开发环境，支持多种语言和框架
开源贡献者：参与 VS Code 开发或扩展开发
学习者：通过阅读源码学习大型 TypeScript 项目架构

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source code editor, the go-to IDE for developers worldwide
en.what: Visual Studio Code is an open-source code editor developed by Microsoft, combining the simplicity of a code editor with the core edit-build-debug cycle developers need. It offers comprehensive code editing, navigation, and understanding support, along with lightweight debugging, a rich extensibility model, and lightweight integration with existing tools.
en.content: This repository contains the complete source code of the VS Code product (Code - OSS), including the editor core, extension API, and build/test scripts. It also publishes the roadmap, monthly iteration plans, and endgame plans.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript, built on the Electron framework, and cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux). It depends on Node.js and various front-end technologies.
en.hot: VS Code is the most popular code editor today, with over 188k stars and 86 new stars today, consistently trending. Its open-source model, rich extension ecosystem, and active community keep it perpetually hot.
uses: Software developers: daily coding, debugging, and version control
Tech teams: unified development environment, supporting multiple languages and frameworks
Open-source contributors: participating in VS Code development or extension development
Learners: studying large-scale TypeScript project architecture by reading source code

zh.tag: AI 生产力工作室，智能对话与自主代理
zh.what: Cherry Studio 是一个 AI 生产力套件，提供智能对话、自主代理和超过 300 个预设助手。它统一接入前沿大语言模型，让用户在一个应用中完成多种 AI 任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用源码（基于 Electron）、构建图标、多语言文档和开发指南。核心功能包括智能聊天、代理执行和助手市场。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Electron 构建跨平台桌面应用。依赖现代前端框架和 AI 模型 API 集成。
zh.hot: 近 5 万星标，今日新增 328，因提供一站式 AI 工具和丰富助手而受欢迎。
uses: 需要统一管理多个 AI 模型的个人用户
希望使用预设助手提高工作效率的职场人士
对自主代理和自动化感兴趣的技术爱好者

en.tag: AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants
en.what: Cherry Studio is an AI productivity suite offering smart chat, autonomous agents, and over 300 preset assistants. It unifies access to frontier LLMs, enabling users to handle various AI tasks in one app.
en.content: The repo contains desktop app source (Electron-based), build icons, multilingual docs, and dev guides. Core features include smart chat, agent execution, and assistant marketplace.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on Electron for cross-platform desktop. Uses modern frontend frameworks and AI model API integrations.
en.hot: Nearly 50k stars with 328 added today, popular for its all-in-one AI toolkit and extensive assistant library.
uses: Individuals who want to manage multiple AI models in one place
Professionals seeking productivity gains via preset assistants
Tech enthusiasts interested in autonomous agents and automation

zh.tag: 终端里的开源 AI 编程代理
zh.what: Qwen Code 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，直接在终端中运行。它提供智能代码补全、自动记忆、子代理和团队协作等功能，支持多种 AI 模型和协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Qwen Code 的 CLI 工具、核心框架、IDE 插件、桌面应用、SDK 以及 IM 机器人（Telegram/钉钉/微信/飞书）等组件。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 22+，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Qwen 等 API 以及 Ollama/vLLM 本地模型。
zh.hot: 作为通义千问官方出品的终端 AI 编程代理，开源且功能全面，本周新增 252 星，总星数达 26292，受到开发者社区广泛关注。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中直接获得 AI 辅助编程，无需离开命令行
团队协作 —— 使用子代理和代理团队功能进行协同开发
多模型用户 —— 灵活切换不同 AI 模型，包括本地部署

en.tag: Open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal
en.what: Qwen Code is an open-source AI coding agent that runs directly in your terminal. It offers intelligent code completion, auto-memory, sub-agents, and team collaboration, supporting multiple AI models and protocols.
en.content: The repository contains the Qwen Code CLI tool, core framework, IDE plugins, desktop app, SDKs, and IM bots (Telegram/DingTalk/WeChat/Feishu).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js 22+, supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Qwen APIs and local models via Ollama/vLLM.
en.hot: As an official terminal AI coding agent from Qwen, it's open-source and feature-rich, gaining 252 stars this week with a total of 26292 stars, widely noticed by the developer community.
uses: Developers — get AI-assisted coding directly in the terminal without leaving the command line
Teams — collaborate using sub-agents and agent teams for joint development
Multi-model users — flexibly switch between different AI models, including local deployments

zh.tag: 浏览器端 3D 高斯泼溅编辑工具
zh.what: SuperSplat Editor 是一款免费开源的 3D 高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting）编辑工具，支持检查、编辑、优化和发布 3D 高斯泼溅模型。它基于 Web 技术构建，直接在浏览器中运行，无需下载安装。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的编辑器源代码，包括前端界面、核心编辑功能、本地化支持（多语言文件）以及开发构建脚本。用户可通过 npm 安装依赖并运行本地开发服务器。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，使用 Node.js 18+ 作为开发环境，依赖 npm 包管理，并利用现代 Web 技术（如 WebGL/WebGPU）实现 3D 渲染。
zh.hot: 3D 高斯泼溅是当前 3D 重建和渲染的热门技术，SuperSplat 作为少有的免费开源编辑器，吸引了大量开发者。近 9800 星，今日新增 12 星，稳居 TypeScript 趋势榜前列。
uses: 3D 内容创作者：在浏览器中快速编辑和优化 3D 高斯泼溅模型
开发者：学习 3D 高斯泼溅技术或基于此构建自定义工具
教育/研究：用于 3D 视觉和渲染技术的教学与实验

en.tag: Free, open-source, browser-based 3D Gaussian Splat editor
en.what: SuperSplat Editor is a free and open-source tool for inspecting, editing, optimizing, and publishing 3D Gaussian Splats. Built on web technologies, it runs directly in the browser with no download or installation required.
en.content: The repository contains the full editor source code, including the frontend UI, core editing functionality, localization support (multiple locale files), and development build scripts. Users can install dependencies via npm and run a local dev server.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js 18+, uses npm for dependency management, and leverages modern web technologies (e.g., WebGL/WebGPU) for 3D rendering.
en.hot: 3D Gaussian Splatting is a hot technology in 3D reconstruction and rendering, and SuperSplat stands out as a rare free, open-source editor. With nearly 9.8k stars and 12 new stars today, it ranks high on the TypeScript trending list.
uses: 3D content creators: quickly edit and optimize 3D Gaussian Splat models in the browser
Developers: learn 3D Gaussian Splatting or build custom tools on top
Education/research: teaching and experimenting with 3D vision and rendering

zh.tag: 可视化拖拽构建 AI 智能体
zh.what: Flowise 是一个开源平台，允许用户通过可视化拖拽界面构建 AI 智能体（Agent）和自动化工作流。它集成了多种大语言模型、向量数据库和工具，无需编写代码即可创建复杂的 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含四个主要模块：server（Node.js 后端）、ui（React 前端）、components（第三方节点集成）和 api-documentation（自动生成的 Swagger API 文档）。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 Node.js、React、Express 和 PNPM 管理依赖。支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种 AI 服务和数据库。
zh.hot: Flowise 拥有超过 5.5 万星标，今日新增 26 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜（TypeScript）第 14 名。其低代码/无代码特性降低了 AI 应用开发门槛，吸引了大量开发者和非技术人员。
uses: 开发者快速搭建 AI 原型或生产级工作流
非技术用户通过可视化界面创建聊天机器人和自动化流程
企业用于内部工具集成和业务流程自动化
教育场景中用于教学 AI 概念和 Agent 设计

en.tag: Build AI agents visually with drag-and-drop
en.what: Flowise is an open-source platform that lets users build AI agents and automation workflows through a visual drag-and-drop interface. It integrates various LLMs, vector databases, and tools, enabling complex AI applications without coding.
en.content: The repository contains four main modules: server (Node.js backend), ui (React frontend), components (third-party node integrations), and api-documentation (auto-generated Swagger API docs).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Node.js, React, Express, and PNPM for dependency management. Supports Docker deployment and integrates various AI services and databases.
en.hot: With over 55k stars and 26 new stars today, Flowise ranks #14 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript). Its low-code/no-code approach lowers the barrier to AI app development, attracting developers and non-technical users alike.
uses: Developers quickly prototyping or building production-grade AI workflows
Non-technical users creating chatbots and automation flows via visual interface
Enterprises integrating internal tools and automating business processes
Educational settings for teaching AI concepts and agent design

zh.tag: AI 代理的本地优先 Web 智能层
zh.what: Wigolo 为 AI 代理提供统一的 Web 接口，支持搜索、抓取、爬取、提取、缓存、相似查找和研究等操作。它作为 MCP 服务器运行，无需 API 密钥、无需云服务、按查询计费为零。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器、REST API、SDK、CLI 工具、示例和文档。支持与 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等主流编码代理集成，也兼容 LangChain、CrewAI 等框架。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js ≥20，采用 MCP 协议，支持 REST 和 SDK 嵌入。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2529 星，总星数达 3617，因其为 AI 代理提供零成本、本地优先的 Web 智能能力，解决了 API 密钥和云依赖的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者 —— 为编码代理添加 Web 搜索和抓取能力
自托管代理用户 —— 通过 MCP 或 REST 集成本地 Web 智能
AI 应用构建者 —— 使用 SDK 嵌入 Web 数据采集功能

en.tag: Local-first web intelligence layer for AI agents
en.what: Wigolo provides a unified web interface for AI agents, enabling search, fetch, crawl, extract, cache, find-similar, research, and autonomous gather loops. It runs as an MCP server with no API keys, no cloud, and zero cost per query.
en.content: The repository includes an MCP server, REST API, SDK, CLI tools, examples, and documentation. It integrates with major coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and frameworks like LangChain, CrewAI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js ≥20, uses MCP protocol, supports REST and SDK embedding.
en.hot: Gained 2529 stars this week, reaching 3617 total, due to its zero-cost, local-first web intelligence for AI agents, eliminating API key and cloud dependency pain points.
uses: AI agent developers — add web search and fetch capabilities to coding agents
Self-hosted agent users — integrate local web intelligence via MCP or REST
AI application builders — embed web data collection using the SDK

zh.tag: LLM 评测与红队测试 CLI，已被 OpenAI 收购
zh.what: promptfoo 是一个用于评估和红队测试 LLM 应用的开源 CLI 和库。它支持自动化评测、漏洞扫描和模型对比，帮助开发者告别试错，构建安全可靠的 AI 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具、库、文档和示例，提供声明式配置、命令行界面和 CI/CD 集成，支持多种 LLM 提供商（如 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 等）。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，需要 Node.js >=22.22.0，可通过 npm、brew、pip 安装，支持多种 LLM API。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方收购的项目，promptfoo 在 GitHub 上拥有 24k+ stars，今日新增 48，因其在 LLM 安全测试领域的领先地位而备受关注。
uses: AI 工程师：评估和优化 prompt 与模型性能
安全团队：对 LLM 应用进行红队测试和漏洞扫描
DevOps：集成 CI/CD 实现自动化质量与安全门禁
产品经理：对比不同模型，选择最佳方案

en.tag: CLI for LLM evals & red teaming, now part of OpenAI
en.what: promptfoo is an open-source CLI and library for evaluating and red-teaming LLM apps. It enables automated evals, vulnerability scanning, and model comparison, helping developers move beyond trial-and-error to ship secure, reliable AI apps.
en.content: The repository includes a CLI, library, docs, and examples, offering declarative configs, command-line interface, and CI/CD integration, with support for multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, etc.).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, requires Node.js >=22.22.0, installable via npm, brew, or pip, and supports various LLM APIs.
en.hot: As an officially acquired project by OpenAI, promptfoo has 24k+ stars on GitHub with 48 new today, gaining attention for its leading position in LLM security testing.
uses: AI engineers: evaluate and optimize prompts and model performance
Security teams: red team and vulnerability scan LLM apps
DevOps: integrate CI/CD for automated quality and security gates
Product managers: compare models to choose the best option

zh.tag: 浏览器内零服务器代码知识图谱与图RAG代理
zh.what: GitNexus 是一个客户端知识图谱引擎，完全在浏览器中运行。你可以拖入一个 Git 仓库（支持 GitHub、GitLab、Azure 或本地）或 ZIP 文件，即可获得一个交互式知识图谱，并内置 Graph RAG 代理，用于代码探索。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CLI 工具（npx gitnexus analyze/setup）、Web UI（浏览器聊天界面）、MCP 服务器配置，以及用于索引代码库、生成知识图谱和提供智能 MCP 工具的核心代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 npm 包（gitnexus），支持 MCP（Model Context Protocol）集成，并利用图数据库和 RAG 技术。
zh.hot: GitNexus 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 45k+ 星标，因为它提供了一种全新的代码分析方式，比 DeepWiki 更深入，让 AI 代理能够通过知识图谱理解代码关系，而不是仅仅依赖描述。
uses: 开发者：在浏览器中快速探索任何代码库，无需服务器设置。
AI 代理用户：通过 MCP 集成，为 Cursor、Claude Code 等提供架构级上下文。
技术团队：进行代码审查、依赖分析和架构可视化。
教育者：用于教学代码结构和调用链。

en.tag: Zero-server code knowledge graph with built-in Graph RAG agent, runs entirely in browser
en.what: GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph engine that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (GitHub, GitLab, Azure, or local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built-in Graph RAG agent for code exploration.
en.content: The repository includes a CLI tool (npx gitnexus analyze/setup), a Web UI (browser chat interface), MCP server configuration, and core code for indexing codebases, generating knowledge graphs, and providing smart MCP tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, distributed as an npm package (gitnexus), integrates with MCP (Model Context Protocol), and leverages graph database and RAG techniques.
en.hot: GitNexus has gained 45k+ stars quickly because it offers a novel approach to code analysis, deeper than DeepWiki, enabling AI agents to understand code relationships via knowledge graphs rather than just descriptions.
uses: Developers: Quickly explore any codebase in the browser without server setup.
AI agent users: Provide architectural context to Cursor, Claude Code, etc., via MCP integration.
Tech teams: For code review, dependency analysis, and architecture visualization.
Educators: To teach code structure and call chains.

zh.tag: 基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架
zh.what: Next.js 是一个基于 React 的全栈 Web 框架，支持服务端渲染、静态生成和增量静态再生。它提供了文件系统路由、API 路由、中间件等开箱即用的功能，让开发者可以快速构建高性能的 Web 应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 的核心源码、文档、示例以及贡献指南。主要目录包括 packages（核心包）、examples（示例应用）、test（测试）等。
zh.stack: 基于 React 和 Node.js，使用 Rust 编写的 Turbopack 作为打包工具。依赖包括 React、Webpack（可选）、Babel 等。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的 React 框架之一，Next.js 拥有超过 141k 的 Star，持续活跃的社区和 Vercel 的商业支持使其长期占据 GitHub 热门榜。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 构建全栈 React 应用的首选框架
团队/企业 —— 需要高性能、SEO 友好的生产级 Web 应用
初创公司 —— 快速搭建 MVP 或产品级网站

en.tag: The React Framework for Production
en.what: Next.js is a React-based full-stack web framework that supports server-side rendering, static generation, and incremental static regeneration. It provides file-system routing, API routes, middleware, and other out-of-the-box features, enabling developers to quickly build high-performance web applications.
en.content: The repository contains Next.js core source code, documentation, examples, and contribution guidelines. Key directories include packages (core packages), examples (sample apps), test (tests), etc.
en.stack: Built on React and Node.js, with Turbopack (Rust-based) as the bundler. Dependencies include React, Webpack (optional), Babel, etc.
en.hot: As one of the most popular React frameworks, Next.js has over 141k stars, with an active community and commercial support from Vercel, keeping it consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: Frontend developers — the go-to framework for building full-stack React apps
Teams/enterprises — need high-performance, SEO-friendly production web apps
Startups — quickly build MVP or production-grade websites

zh.tag: AI 求职代理：自动扫描、评分、定制简历，本地运行
zh.what: 一个开源的 AI 求职系统，能自动扫描招聘网站，用 A-F 评分体系（1.0-5.0）评估职位，并针对每个职位定制简历、追踪申请进度。所有操作都在本地 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code、Codex）中完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个多代理系统，可扫描招聘网站、评估职位、定制简历并追踪申请。提供多语言 README、演示 GIF、Press 页面和趋势图表。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，依赖 AI 编码 CLI（Claude Code、Codex 等）作为运行环境，使用本地 AI 模型处理任务。
zh.hot: 解决了求职者的核心痛点——用 AI 反向筛选公司，而非被公司筛选。上线后迅速获得 61,681 星，日增 170 星，被 WIRED、Business Insider 等媒体报道。
uses: 求职者 —— 自动化批量申请，节省时间
开发者 —— 学习如何构建 AI 代理系统
招聘者 —— 了解 AI 如何改变求职流程

en.tag: AI job search agent: scan, score, tailor CV, track applications, runs locally
en.what: An open-source AI job search system that scans job portals, evaluates listings with a structured A-F rubric (1.0-5.0 score), tailors CVs for each role, and tracks applications. It runs entirely in your local AI coding CLI (e.g., Claude Code, Codex).

Developers — learn how to build AI agent systems
Recruiters — understand how AI transforms job search

zh.tag: 反“AI流水线”前端框架，为AI代理注入设计品味与精致UI技能
zh.what: Taste Skill 是一套可移植的 Agent 技能集合，专门解决 AI 生成的前端界面千篇一律、缺乏设计感的问题。它通过结构化的布局、排版、动效和间距规则，让 AI 代理（如 Codex、Cursor、Claude Code）输出更精致、更具品牌感的界面。同时内置图像生成技能，可用于快速生成 Web、移动端和品牌套系的视觉参考板。
zh.content: 仓库包含一系列可复用的 Agent Skill 模块（前端布局、排版、动效、间距规范）以及图像生成提示词与参考板模板，支持与 ChatGPT Images 等工具链配合后交由主流 AI 编程助手实现。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 构建，兼容 Vercel Labs 的 Agent Skills 生态，可与 ChatGPT Images、Codex、Cursor、Claude Code 等主流 AI 工具链无缝集成。
zh.hot: 在 AI 生成代码泛滥导致界面同质化严重的背景下，Taste Skill 切中了开发者对“AI 审美”的痛点；仓库已获 64.7k Star，本月新增 19.1k，位列 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 3，足见社区对反“AI 流水线”设计的强烈需求。
uses: 前端开发者/AI 辅助编程用户 —— 想让 Cursor/Codex 输出更精致、不千篇一律的界面
设计师与创意开发者 —— 需要快速生成品牌视觉参考板并直接落地为代码
独立开发者/创业公司 —— 在缺少专职设计师时，用结构化技能提升产品 UI 质感
AI Agent 构建者 —— 希望为自研 Agent 集成反“slop”的前端设计与实现能力

en.tag: Anti-slop agent skills framework that gives AI builders design taste
en.what: Taste Skill is a portable set of agent skills that upgrades AI-built interfaces with stronger layout, typography, motion, and spacing to eliminate generic-looking UIs. It acts as an anti-slop frontend framework, giving AI agents like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code a refined design taste. The repo also includes image-generation skills for creating reference boards for web, mobile, and brand kits.
en.content: The repository contains reusable agent skill modules covering frontend layout, typography, motion, and spacing guidelines, along with image-generation prompts and reference board templates designed to be paired with tools like ChatGPT Images and implemented via Codex, Cursor, or Claude Code.
en.stack: Built primarily in JavaScript and compatible with the Vercel Labs Agent Skills ecosystem, it integrates seamlessly with mainstream AI toolchains including ChatGPT Images, Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code.
en.hot: As AI-generated code floods the web with homogenized interfaces, Taste Skill strikes a nerve by curing AI's bad taste; it has amassed 64.7k stars with 19.1k added this month alone, ranking 3rd on GitHub's JavaScript monthly trending list.
uses: Frontend developers using AI-assisted coding who want Cursor/Codex to produce polished, non-generic UIs
Designers and creative developers looking to rapidly generate brand reference boards and turn them into code
Indie hackers and startups needing to elevate product UI quality without dedicated designers
AI agent builders seeking to equip their agents with anti-slop frontend design and implementation skills

Backend developers — reference advanced topics like distributed systems and high concurrency

zh.tag: 跨平台 JavaScript 运行时环境
zh.what: Node.js 是一个开源的、跨平台的 JavaScript 运行时环境，允许在服务器端运行 JavaScript 代码。它基于 V8 引擎，采用事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 模型，适合构建高性能网络应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Node.js 核心源码、构建系统、测试套件、文档及治理文件。提供 Current、LTS 和 Nightly 三种发布类型，支持多平台二进制下载。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 JavaScript 和 C++，依赖 V8 引擎、libuv、OpenSSL 等底层库。构建系统使用 GYP 和 Makefile。
zh.hot: 作为 JavaScript 生态的基石，Node.js 持续获得广泛关注，今日新增 36 星，总星数超 11.8 万，稳居日榜第 7。
uses: 后端开发者 —— 构建高性能 Web 服务、API 和微服务
全栈开发者 —— 使用同一语言开发前后端
DevOps 工程师 —— 构建命令行工具和自动化脚本
初学者 —— 学习服务器端 JavaScript 编程

en.tag: Cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment
en.what: Node.js is an open-source, cross-platform JavaScript runtime environment that executes JavaScript code server-side. Built on the V8 engine, it uses an event-driven, non-blocking I/O model, making it ideal for high-performance network applications.
en.content: The repository contains Node.js core source code, build system, test suite, documentation, and governance files. It offers Current, LTS, and Nightly release types with multi-platform binary downloads.
en.stack: Primary languages are JavaScript and C++, with dependencies on V8 engine, libuv, OpenSSL, etc. Build system uses GYP and Makefile.
en.hot: As the cornerstone of the JavaScript ecosystem, Node.js continues to attract widespread attention, gaining 36 stars today with over 118k total stars, ranking 7th on the daily trending list.

Full-stack developers — using the same language for frontend and backend
DevOps engineers — building CLI tools and automation scripts
Beginners — learning server-side JavaScript programming

zh.tag: 让AI代理用原始人语回复，节省65%输出token
zh.what: Caveman 是一个技能/插件，适用于 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等30+ AI编码代理。安装后，代理会以原始人式的简短语言回答问题，同时保持代码、命令和错误信息的准确性，从而大幅减少输出token消耗。
zh.content: 仓库包含安装脚本、配置文件（支持30+代理）、不同原始人等级（如caveman、grunt）以及基准测试数据。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript，依赖各AI代理的配置系统（如Claude Code的CLI配置、Cursor的rules等）。
zh.hot: 凭借幽默的原始人概念和惊人的65% token节省效果，迅速获得9万+星标，开发者纷纷尝试降低AI使用成本。
uses: AI编码代理用户 —— 希望减少token消耗、降低API费用的开发者
Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf 等代理的重度使用者 —— 通过简短回复提升效率
对AI输出风格有幽默需求的极客 —— 享受原始人式对话

en.tag: Make AI coding agents reply like cavemen, slashing 65% output tokens
en.what: Caveman is a skill/plugin for 30+ AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor. Once installed, agents reply in terse caveman-speak, preserving code, commands, and errors verbatim while drastically cutting output token usage.
en.content: The repo includes installation scripts, configuration files for 30+ agents, multiple caveman levels (e.g., caveman, grunt), and benchmark data.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, relies on configuration systems of various AI agents (e.g., Claude Code CLI config, Cursor rules).
en.hot: With its humorous caveman concept and impressive 65% token savings, it quickly garnered 90K+ stars as developers seek to reduce AI usage costs.
uses: AI coding agent users — developers looking to cut token usage and API costs
Heavy users of Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc. — boost efficiency with terse replies
Geeks with a sense of humor — enjoy caveman-style conversations

zh.tag: Nuclei 引擎的社区漏洞检测模板库
zh.what: 这是 Nuclei 扫描引擎的官方模板仓库，存储由团队和社区贡献的各类安全检测模板。这些模板定义了如何检测应用中的安全漏洞，是 Nuclei 扫描器的核心部分。
zh.content: 仓库包含数千个 YAML 格式的模板，按漏洞类型、严重性、目录等分类，并提供统计文件（TEMPLATES-STATS.md 和 JSON）以及针对 CISA KEV 等已知被利用漏洞的覆盖。
zh.stack: 模板使用 YAML 编写，依赖 Nuclei 引擎（Go 编写）执行。项目本身主要包含模板文件和统计生成脚本，主语言标记为 JavaScript 可能因统计工具。
zh.hot: 拥有 12766 颗星，今日新增 9 颗，位列 JavaScript 日榜第 8。作为安全扫描的核心资源，持续吸引社区贡献，覆盖大量已知漏洞，是安全研究者的必备工具。
uses: 安全研究人员：快速检测目标应用是否存在已知漏洞
渗透测试人员：利用现成模板进行漏洞扫描和验证
DevSecOps 工程师：集成到 CI/CD 流程中实现自动化安全测试
CTF 玩家：查找和利用常见漏洞模板

en.tag: Community-curated templates for the Nuclei vulnerability scanner
en.what: This is the official template repository for the Nuclei scanning engine, storing security detection templates contributed by the team and community. These templates define how to detect vulnerabilities in applications and are the core of the Nuclei scanner.
en.content: The repository contains thousands of YAML templates categorized by vulnerability type, severity, directory, etc., along with statistics files (TEMPLATES-STATS.md and JSON) and coverage for known exploited vulnerabilities like CISA KEV.
en.stack: Templates are written in YAML and rely on the Nuclei engine (written in Go) for execution. The project mainly contains template files and statistics generation scripts; the primary language is marked as JavaScript possibly due to tooling.
en.hot: With 12,766 stars and 9 new stars today, ranking 8th on the JavaScript daily trending list. As a core resource for security scanning, it continuously attracts community contributions, covers numerous known vulnerabilities, and is essential for security researchers.
uses: Security researchers: quickly detect known vulnerabilities in target applications
Penetration testers: use ready-made templates for vulnerability scanning and verification
DevSecOps engineers: integrate into CI/CD pipelines for automated security testing
CTF players: find and exploit common vulnerability templates

zh.tag: 免费在线数据库 ER 图编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个在浏览器中运行的免费数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，用户无需注册即可快速绘制数据库图表、导入导出 SQL 脚本、生成迁移脚本并自定义编辑器。它旨在简化数据库设计流程，让开发者可以直观地可视化和操作数据库结构。

zh.tag: 透明 SSH/HTTPS/K8s/数据库堡垒机，无需客户端
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒主机/PAM 解决方案，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC。它不需要客户端软件或 SSH 包装器，可直接在 DMZ 中部署，并内置会话录制、浏览器访问、2FA/SSO 和暴力破解防护。

zh.stack: 基于 100% 安全 Rust 编写，无外部依赖，支持 Docker 部署，集成 TOTP 和 OpenID Connect 用于 2FA/SSO。
zh.hot: 凭借无需客户端的透明代理架构和内置会话录制等企业级功能，在 Rust 趋势榜上排名第 3，star 数达 7473，持续吸引安全运维与基础设施团队关注。
uses: 安全团队：集中管理 SSH/数据库访问并审计会话
运维人员：通过浏览器或原生客户端安全访问内网资源
Kubernetes 管理员：为集群提供统一入口与权限控制
需要符合合规要求的企业：利用 2FA/SSO 和登录保护

en.tag: Transparent SSH/HTTPS/K8s/DB bastion, no client needed
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host/PAM solution supporting SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP, and VNC. It requires no client software or SSH wrapper, can be deployed in the DMZ, and includes session recording, browser-based access, 2FA/SSO, and brute-force protection.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary with an admin web UI, built-in SSH/RDP/VNC clients, session recording and replay, plus comprehensive docs and Docker support.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust with no dependencies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates TOTP and OpenID Connect for 2FA/SSO.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on Rust trending with 7.4k stars, its clientless transparent proxy and enterprise features like session recording attract security and infra teams.
uses: Security teams: centrally manage SSH/DB access and audit sessions
Ops: securely access internal resources via browser or native clients
K8s admins: unified entry and access control for clusters
Compliance-focused enterprises: leverage 2FA/SSO and login protection

zh.content: 仓库包含完整的图数据库实现，包括稀疏矩阵表示、线性代数查询引擎、OpenCypher 兼容层、多租户支持，以及云服务（FalkorDB Cloud）和 Docker 镜像。

zh.hot: 随着 GraphRAG 和 AI Agent 记忆需求的兴起，FalkorDB 作为专为 LLM 设计的图数据库，凭借其超低延迟和独特技术路线，在 Rust 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 49 星。
uses: 构建 LLM 知识图谱（GraphRAG）的开发者，需要高性能图存储与查询
AI Agent 记忆管理场景，需要快速读写和检索实体关系
云安全、欺诈检测等需要实时图分析的应用

en.tag: Ultra-fast graph database leveraging sparse matrices & linear algebra, built for LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG)
en.what: FalkorDB is an ultra-fast, multi-tenant graph database that uses sparse adjacency matrices (GraphBLAS) under the hood and linear algebra for query execution. It aims to provide a high-performance knowledge graph for LLMs (GraphRAG), supporting the property graph model and OpenCypher queries.
en.content: The repository contains a full graph database implementation, including sparse matrix representation, linear algebra query engine, OpenCypher compatibility layer, multi-tenancy support, plus cloud service (FalkorDB Cloud) and Docker images.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging GraphBLAS for sparse matrix operations, supporting OpenCypher query language, with Docker deployment and cloud service.
en.hot: With the rise of GraphRAG and AI agent memory needs, FalkorDB, as a graph database designed specifically for LLMs, stands out with ultra-low latency and a unique technical approach, ranking #5 on the Rust daily trending with +49 stars today.
uses: Developers building LLM knowledge graphs (GraphRAG) needing high-performance graph storage and query
AI agent memory management scenarios requiring fast read/write and entity-relation retrieval
Applications like cloud security and fraud detection needing real-time graph analytics
Researchers interested in graph database internals (sparse matrices, linear algebra)
