zh.tag: 开源可组合支付平台，支持智能路由与成本优化
zh.what: Hyperswitch 是一个开源、可组合的支付基础设施，允许企业连接多个支付、支付、欺诈、保险库和代币化提供商。它通过智能路由和收入恢复提升授权率，并通过成本可观测性降低支付处理成本，同时简化对账操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心支付引擎、模块化支付套件（如成本可观测性、智能路由等）、快速入门指南、云部署配置、架构文档以及社区贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 PostgreSQL 等数据库，支持 Docker 部署，提供自托管和 SaaS 选项。
zh.hot: 拥有 43k+ 星标，因其开源、可组合的支付解决方案而受到关注，解决了支付行业的厂商锁定和高成本问题，在 Rust 日榜排名第 7。
uses: 电商平台：需要灵活接入多种支付网关并优化交易成功率。
金融科技公司：希望降低支付处理成本并增强对账效率。
开发者：寻求可定制、可自托管的支付基础设施。

en.tag: Open-source composable payments platform with intelligent routing and cost optimization
en.what: Hyperswitch is an open-source, composable payments infrastructure that enables businesses to connect to multiple payment, payout, fraud, vault, and tokenization providers. It boosts authorization rates with intelligent routing and revenue recovery, reduces payment processing costs with cost observability, and simplifies reconciliation.
en.content: The repository includes the core payment engine, modular payment suite (e.g., cost observability, intelligent routing), quickstart guides, cloud deployment configs, architecture docs, and community contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, uses PostgreSQL and other databases, supports Docker deployment, and offers both self-hosted and SaaS options.
en.hot: With 43k+ stars, it's popular for its open-source, composable payment solution that addresses vendor lock-in and high costs in the payments industry, ranking #7 on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: E-commerce platforms needing flexible integration with multiple payment gateways and improved transaction success rates.
Fintech companies looking to reduce payment processing costs and streamline reconciliation.
Developers seeking a customizable, self-hostable payment infrastructure.

zh.tag: AI 原生代理服务器与数据平面，简化智能体应用交付
zh.what: Plano 是一个 AI 原生的代理服务器和数据平面，专为智能体应用设计。它将路由、编排、可观测性和安全防护等通用基础设施从应用代码中抽离，集中管理，让开发者专注于核心业务逻辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的代理服务器核心，基于 Envoy 构建，提供智能体编排、LLM 路由、信号捕获、过滤链等功能，并附带文档和快速入门指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，基于 Envoy 构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成 OpenTelemetry 用于追踪和指标。
zh.hot: Plano 解决了智能体应用从原型到生产的痛点，提供统一的数据平面，加上 Rust 的高性能和 Envoy 的可靠性，吸引大量开发者关注，star 数接近 7000。
uses: 智能体应用开发者：需要快速将原型推向生产，避免重复构建中间件。
平台工程团队：希望统一管理多个智能体的路由、安全和可观测性。
AI 基础设施团队：需要高性能、可扩展的代理层来支撑大规模智能体服务。

en.tag: AI-native proxy server and data plane for agentic apps, simplifying production delivery
en.what: Plano is an AI-native proxy server and data plane for agentic applications. It abstracts common infrastructure like routing, orchestration, observability, and guardrails out of application code, centralizing them so developers can focus on core logic.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust-based proxy server core built on Envoy, offering agent orchestration, LLM routing, signal capture, and filter chains, along with documentation and a quickstart guide.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, built on Envoy, supports Docker deployment, and integrates OpenTelemetry for tracing and metrics.
en.hot: Plano addresses the pain of moving agentic apps from prototype to production with a unified data plane, combined with Rust's performance and Envoy's reliability, attracting nearly 7k stars.
uses: Agentic app developers: need to ship prototypes to production quickly without reinventing middleware.
Platform engineering teams: want to centrally manage routing, security, and observability across agents.
AI infrastructure teams: need a high-performance, scalable proxy layer to support large-scale agent services.

zh.tag: 单二进制、全内置的快速静态网站生成器
zh.what: Zola 是一个用 Rust 编写的静态网站生成器，将所有功能打包进一个二进制文件，无需额外依赖。它内置了语法高亮、Sass 编译、图片处理、多语言支持、主题、短代码、自动目录、搜索等功能，旨在提供简单、快速的网站构建体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Zola 的完整源代码、文档（位于 docs/content）、示例主题和测试。核心是一个 Rust 项目，使用 Tera 模板引擎，并提供了命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Tera 模板引擎（也是 Rust 实现），并利用 Cargo 进行构建。支持多种部署平台如 Netlify、Vercel 和 Cloudflare Pages。
zh.hot: Zola 在 Rust 社区中备受青睐，因其单二进制、零依赖的特性，以及内置丰富功能而广受欢迎。今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 17303，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）中排名第 9。
uses: 开发者希望快速搭建个人博客或文档站点，无需复杂配置。
喜欢 Rust 生态，追求高性能和低资源占用的用户。
需要多语言支持、图片处理等高级功能的静态网站项目。
希望将网站部署到 Netlify、Vercel 等平台的开发者。

en.tag: A fast static site generator in a single binary with everything built-in.
en.what: Zola is a static site generator written in Rust, packaged as a single binary with all features built-in, requiring no external dependencies. It includes syntax highlighting, Sass compilation, image processing, multilingual support, themes, shortcodes, automatic table of contents, search, and more, aiming to provide a simple and fast website building experience.
en.content: The repository contains Zola's full source code, documentation (in docs/content), example themes, and tests. The core is a Rust project using the Tera template engine, and it provides a command-line tool.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it depends on the Tera template engine (also Rust-based) and uses Cargo for building. It supports deployment on platforms like Netlify, Vercel, and Cloudflare Pages.
en.hot: Zola is highly regarded in the Rust community for its single-binary, zero-dependency nature and rich built-in features. It gained 13 stars today, reaching 17,303 total, ranking 9th on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily.
uses: Developers who want to quickly build a personal blog or documentation site without complex configuration.
Users who prefer the Rust ecosystem and seek high performance and low resource usage.
Static site projects that need advanced features like multilingual support and image processing.
Developers who want to deploy to platforms like Netlify, Vercel, etc.

zh.tag: 把每个任务变成可打开应用的桌面 AI 代理
zh.what: BitFun 是一个桌面 AI 代理，它将代码代理的深度与通用任务能力相结合，不仅限于软件开发。它能为每个任务创建专属界面（如图表、看板、表单），并将对话绑定到该界面的实时状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心代理运行时、桌面应用（支持 macOS/Windows/Linux）、Mini Apps 框架、自托管设备同步服务器，以及文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 Rust，桌面应用可能使用 Tauri 或类似框架，支持跨平台。依赖包括 MCP、Skills/Hooks 等定制机制，以及用于快速搜索的 flashgrep。
zh.hot: BitFun 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 19 颗星，总星数达 1496，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 10。其独特的 Agentic Mini Apps 概念和自托管多设备控制功能吸引了开发者关注。
uses: 开发者：希望使用 AI 代理进行编码、调试和代码审查，并享受桌面应用的便利。
办公人员：需要 AI 辅助研究、写作、制作演示文稿和会议记录。
技术爱好者：喜欢自托管服务，希望控制自己的数据和设备同步。
AI 应用开发者：希望基于 BitFun 构建自定义 Agent 和 Mini Apps。

en.tag: A desktop AI agent that turns every task into an app you can open
en.what: BitFun is a desktop AI agent that combines the depth of a code agent with open, general-purpose capabilities for work beyond software development. It creates a dedicated interface for each task—such as charts, boards, forms, or panels—and binds a conversation to that interface's live state.
en.content: The repository contains a high-performance agent runtime written in Rust, a polished desktop application for macOS/Windows/Linux, a Mini Apps framework, a self-hostable device-sync server, along with documentation and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: The primary language is Rust, with a desktop app likely built on Tauri or similar, supporting cross-platform. It leverages MCP, Skills/Hooks for customization, and flashgrep for fast search.
en.hot: BitFun is gaining traction on GitHub, with 19 new stars today and a total of 1496, ranking #10 on the Rust trending list. Its unique Agentic Mini Apps concept and self-hosted multi-device control are drawing developer attention.
uses: Developers: who want an AI agent for coding, debugging, and code review with a desktop app.
Office workers: needing AI assistance for research, writing, presentations, and meeting notes.
Tech enthusiasts: who prefer self-hosting and controlling their data and device sync.
AI app builders: looking to create custom agents and Mini Apps on top of BitFun.

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理拦截危险命令的安全钩子
zh.what: dcg 是一个高性能钩子，用于在 AI 编码代理执行危险命令之前将其拦截，防止误删代码。它支持多种主流 AI 编码工具，如 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Gemini CLI 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的核心二进制、安装脚本（支持 Linux/macOS/WSL 和 Windows PowerShell）、以及针对不同代理的集成文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖系统 shell 钩子机制，通过安装脚本自动配置各代理的钩子。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，防止误删代码成为刚需，star 数 5664 且日增 75，说明开发者对此类安全工具需求强烈。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，防止代理误删文件
团队在 CI/CD 或本地开发中需要额外安全层，保护关键代码库
对 AI 代理行为不放心，希望增加一道人工确认机制的用户

en.tag: A high-performance hook that blocks destructive git/shell commands from AI coding agents.
en.what: dcg is a high-performance hook that blocks destructive commands before they execute, protecting your work from accidental deletion across various AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and more.
en.content: The repository contains a Rust core binary, install scripts for Linux/macOS/WSL and Windows PowerShell, and integration docs for various agents.
en.stack: Written in Rust, relies on shell hook mechanisms, and uses install scripts to auto-configure hooks for supported agents.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, preventing accidental deletion is a must-have, reflected in 5.6k stars and 75 daily additions, showing strong demand for such safety tools.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex to prevent accidental file deletion
Teams needing an extra safety layer in CI/CD or local development to protect critical codebases
Users who want a manual confirmation step for AI agent actions

zh.tag: 高性能多人协作代码编辑器，Atom 与 Tree-sitter 作者打造
zh.what: Zed 是一款由 Rust 编写的高性能多人协作代码编辑器，支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows。它强调极快的响应速度和流畅的多人实时协作体验，旨在让开发者“以思维的速度编码”。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Zed 编辑器源代码，涵盖编辑器核心、协作功能、UI 组件、以及针对各平台的构建脚本和文档。还包含贡献指南、许可证信息以及第三方依赖的许可证管理工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Tree-sitter 进行语法解析，使用 cargo-about 管理开源许可证，并利用 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 凭借其卓越的性能和多人协作特性，Zed 在开发者中广受好评，目前拥有 88k+ 星标，今日新增 81，持续位列 Rust 趋势榜前列。
uses: 追求极致响应速度和流畅编辑体验的开发者
需要实时多人协作编码的团队
对 Rust 或编辑器开发感兴趣的开源贡献者
希望使用现代、高性能编辑器的程序员

en.tag: High-performance multiplayer code editor from the creators of Atom and Tree-sitter
en.what: Zed is a high-performance multiplayer code editor written in Rust, available on macOS, Linux, and Windows. It emphasizes lightning-fast responsiveness and seamless real-time collaboration, aiming to let developers 'code at the speed of thought'.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the Zed editor, including the editor core, collaboration features, UI components, and build scripts and documentation for each platform. It also includes contribution guidelines, license information, and tools for managing third-party dependency licenses.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, leveraging Tree-sitter for syntax parsing, using cargo-about for open-source license compliance, and GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: With its outstanding performance and multiplayer collaboration features, Zed has gained wide acclaim among developers, currently holding 88k+ stars, with 81 added today, consistently ranking high on the Rust trending list.
uses: Developers seeking ultimate responsiveness and smooth editing experience
Teams needing real-time collaborative coding
Open-source contributors interested in Rust or editor development
Programmers wanting a modern, high-performance editor

zh.tag: 开源工具，检测手机基站模拟器（IMSI捕获器）
zh.what: Rayhunter 是一个用于检测 IMSI 捕获器（又称基站模拟器或 stingray）的 Rust 工具。它最初设计运行在廉价的 Orbic RC400L 移动热点上，但社区已支持其他设备。该项目旨在让安装和使用尽可能简单，并尽量减少误报。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源代码、文档（安装指南、支持设备列表、Rayhunter Book）以及用于构建和测试的 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，可能依赖一些 Rust 生态库用于处理蜂窝网络信号和 USB 通信。
zh.hot: 该工具由 EFF 发布，针对隐私保护热点话题，star 数达 5449，在 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 类别排名第 13，受到关注。
uses: 隐私倡导者和记者，用于检测潜在的监控设备
安全研究人员，分析蜂窝网络攻击面
普通用户，希望了解周围是否存在基站模拟器
开源社区贡献者，可参与支持更多设备

en.tag: Open-source tool to detect cell-site simulators (IMSI catchers)
en.what: Rayhunter is a Rust tool for detecting IMSI catchers, also known as cell-site simulators or stingrays. It was initially designed to run on the cheap Orbic RC400L mobile hotspot, but community efforts have extended support to other devices. It aims to be easy to install and use, minimizing false positives.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, documentation (installation guide, supported devices list, Rayhunter Book), and CI configuration for building and testing.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely leveraging Rust ecosystem libraries for cellular signal processing and USB communication.
en.hot: Released by EFF, this tool addresses privacy concerns, with 5,449 stars and ranking #13 on GitHub Trending (Rust) today, gaining significant attention.
uses: Privacy advocates and journalists to detect potential surveillance devices
Security researchers analyzing cellular network attack surfaces
General users curious about nearby cell-site simulators
Open-source contributors who can help support more devices

zh.tag: Rust 编写的 CLI 代理，压缩命令输出，节省 LLM 令牌
zh.what: RTK 是一个高性能 CLI 代理，在命令输出进入 LLM 上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少 60-90% 的令牌消耗。它拦截 shell 命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将 ls 转换为树形结构、将 git diff 精简为关键信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、README（多语言）、架构文档、CI 配置等。核心是单个 Rust 二进制文件，支持 100+ 命令，开销小于 10ms。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，零依赖，通过 Homebrew 分发，支持多种 shell 集成。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码助手普及，开发者关注降低令牌成本。RTK 以 75k+ stars 迅速走红，今日新增 158，登上 Rust 日榜，因其直接解决 LLM 使用成本痛点。
uses: 使用 AI 编码助手的开发者，希望降低 API 费用
频繁运行 git、grep、测试等命令并需要高效上下文的管理者
对性能敏感，追求零依赖工具的用户
希望优化 CI/CD 中 LLM 集成的团队

en.tag: Rust CLI proxy that compresses command output to cut LLM token usage
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls into a tree and condensing git diff to essential info.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, README (multi-language), architecture docs, CI config, etc. The core is a single Rust binary supporting 100+ commands with <10ms overhead.
en.stack: Written in Rust with zero dependencies, distributed via Homebrew, integrates with multiple shells.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become common, developers focus on reducing token costs. RTK gained 75k+ stars quickly, with 158 new today, trending on Rust daily list, directly addressing LLM cost pain points.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who want to cut API costs
Users who frequently run git, grep, test commands and need efficient context
Performance-sensitive users who prefer zero-dependency tools
Teams looking to optimize LLM integration in CI/CD

zh.tag: 基于 Rust 的全功能免费服务器管理面板
zh.what: DockPanel 是一个自托管的 Docker 原生服务器管理面板，用 Rust 和 React 构建。它集成了站点、数据库、Docker 应用、Git 部署、邮件、DNS、监控、备份和安全等所有功能，且面板服务仅占用约 19MB 内存。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、React 前端、153 个一键 Docker 应用模板、776 个 API 端点、454 个端到端测试，以及完整的 CLI 和 IaC 支持。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Rust，前端使用 React，依赖 Docker 和可选的 Let's Encrypt。支持 Ubuntu 20+、Debian 11+、CentOS 9+ 等主流 Linux 发行版，兼容 x86_64 和 ARM64 架构。
zh.hot: 今日新增 72 星，总星数 643，登顶 Rust 日榜第 5。其免费、低资源占用（~19MB RAM）和丰富功能（Git 蓝绿部署、153 个模板、CVE 扫描等）吸引了大量自托管和运维用户。
uses: 服务器管理员 —— 一站式管理多台服务器上的站点、数据库、Docker 应用等
自托管爱好者 —— 在低配 VPS 或 ARM 设备上运行轻量级面板
开发者 —— 使用 Git 推送部署和 IaC 实现自动化工作流
托管服务商 —— 利用经销商账户和白标功能为客户提供管理面板

en.tag: The most feature-packed free server panel, built with Rust and React
en.what: DockPanel is a self-hosted, Docker-native server management panel built with Rust and React. It integrates sites, databases, Docker apps, Git deploy, mail, DNS, monitoring, backups, and security — all while the panel services use only ~19MB of RAM.
en.content: The repo includes a Rust backend, React frontend, 153 one-click Docker app templates, 776 API endpoints, 454 E2E tests, and full CLI and IaC support.
en.stack: Backend in Rust, frontend in React, with Docker and optional Let's Encrypt. Supports Ubuntu 20+, Debian 11+, CentOS 9+, and other major Linux distros on x86_64 and ARM64.
en.hot: With 72 new stars today (total 643, #5 on Rust daily trending), its free price, low RAM usage (~19MB), and rich features (blue-green Git deploy, 153 templates, CVE scanning) attract self-hosters and sysadmins.
uses: Server administrators — manage sites, databases, Docker apps, and more across multiple servers from one panel
Self-hosting enthusiasts — run a lightweight panel on low-spec VPS or ARM devices
Developers — automate workflows with Git push-to-deploy and Infrastructure as Code
Hosting providers — offer a management panel to clients with reseller accounts and white-labeling

zh.tag: AI 代理的上下文智能层，本地 Rust 二进制，减少 60-90% token。
zh.what: LeanCTX 是一个本地运行的上下文工程层，为 AI 编码代理提供上下文管理。它决定代理读取什么、压缩发送给模型的内容、跨会话记忆学习到的信息，并保护代理接触的数据，同时通过可验证的账本证明节省的 token。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Rust 二进制文件，提供本地代理、可选的压缩代理、实时仪表板、预算控制，以及 76 个 MCP 工具和 30+ 代理集成。
zh.stack: 主要用 Rust 编写，支持通过 crates.io、npm、AUR 和 Pi.dev 分发。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的普及，上下文管理成为痛点，LeanCTX 承诺减少 60-90% 的 token 消耗，且零配置、本地优先，因此在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，star 数已达 3533。
uses: 使用 Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望降低 token 成本并提升上下文效率。
需要跨会话持久记忆和上下文压缩的团队，避免重复读取文件。
对数据隐私敏感，希望本地处理上下文的用户。
构建自定义 AI 代理工具链的开发者，需要 MCP 集成和预算控制。

en.tag: Context intelligence layer for AI agents — local Rust binary, cuts tokens by 60–90%.
en.what: LeanCTX is a local context engineering layer for AI coding agents. It decides what agents read, compresses what they send to the model, remembers learned information across sessions, guards what they touch, and proves token savings with a verifiable ledger.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust binary offering a local proxy, optional compression proxy, real-time dashboard, budget control, plus 76 MCP tools and 30+ agent integrations.
en.stack: Written in Rust, distributed via crates.io, npm, AUR, and Pi.dev.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, context management is a pain point; LeanCTX promises 60–90% token reduction, zero config, and local-first, quickly gaining traction with 3,533 stars.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Cursor or Copilot to cut token costs and improve context efficiency.
Teams needing persistent memory and context compression across sessions to avoid re-reading files.
Users privacy-conscious, preferring local context processing.
Developers building custom AI agent toolchains requiring MCP integration and budget control.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 打造的 Node.js 全能工具箱，Bun 级体验零锁定
zh.what: Nub 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Node.js 工具链，旨在增强而非替代 Node.js。它提供 TypeScript 直接运行、快速包管理、脚本执行、文件监听、Node 版本管理等功能，目标是成为 Node 生态的瑞士军刀。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、安装脚本（支持 curl、PowerShell、Homebrew、Nix、mise、npm）、文档和 GitHub Actions 集成。核心是一个二进制文件，提供 `nub` 命令，可替代 node、tsx、npm、pnpm、npx、nodemon、nvm 等工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Node.js 运行时，支持 TypeScript、JSX、装饰器等现代语法，内置 .env 加载、数据格式加载器（YAML、TOML 等），并集成 GitHub Actions。
zh.hot: 凭借 3894 颗星和日增 25 颗，Nub 在 GitHub Trending 上崭露头角。它承诺提供 Bun 级别的开发者体验，同时保持与 Node 的完全兼容，吸引了对性能敏感的 Node 开发者。
uses: Node.js 开发者寻求更快的包管理和脚本执行
TypeScript 项目希望免构建直接运行 TS/TSX
需要统一工具链、减少依赖多个 CLI 的团队
在 CI/CD 中希望简化 Node 环境设置的用户

en.tag: A fast all-in-one Rust-powered toolkit that augments Node.js with Bun-like DX, no lock-in
en.what: Nub is a Rust-based toolkit that augments Node.js rather than replacing it. It offers direct TypeScript execution, fast package management, script running, file watching, Node version management, and more, aiming to be a Swiss Army knife for the Node ecosystem.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, install scripts (curl, PowerShell, Homebrew, Nix, mise, npm), docs, and GitHub Actions integration. The core is a single binary providing the `nub` command, replacing node, tsx, npm, pnpm, npx, nodemon, nvm, and more.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it leverages the Node.js runtime, supports modern syntax like TypeScript, JSX, decorators, includes built-in .env loading and loaders for data formats (YAML, TOML, etc.), and integrates with GitHub Actions.
en.hot: With 3,894 stars and 25 new stars today, Nub is trending on GitHub. It promises Bun-level developer experience while maintaining full Node compatibility, attracting performance-conscious Node developers.
uses: Node.js developers seeking faster package management and script execution
TypeScript projects wanting to run TS/TSX without a build step
Teams aiming to unify tooling and reduce reliance on multiple CLIs
Users who want to simplify Node setup in CI/CD pipelines

zh.tag: 增量解析器生成器，为编辑器提供快速语法树
zh.what: Tree-sitter 是一个解析器生成工具和增量解析库。它可以为源文件构建具体的语法树，并在文件编辑时高效地更新语法树。它旨在足够通用以解析任何编程语言，足够快以在文本编辑器中每次按键时解析，足够健壮以在存在语法错误时提供有用的结果，并且无依赖，以便运行时库（纯 C 编写）可以嵌入到任何应用程序中。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C 库、Rust 绑定、Wasm 绑定以及命令行界面。核心库提供增量解析功能，绑定允许在 Rust 和 Web 环境中使用，CLI 用于生成解析器和测试。
zh.stack: 核心运行时用纯 C 编写，提供 Rust 和 WebAssembly 绑定。解析器生成器使用 Rust 实现，并依赖 Node.js 进行测试。
zh.hot: Tree-sitter 是现代代码编辑器和 IDE 的基础组件，如 Neovim、Atom 等，其增量解析能力对实时语法高亮和代码分析至关重要。尽管今日新增 star 不多，但长期积累的 26k+ star 反映了其广泛采用和社区信任。
uses: 文本编辑器/IDE 开发者：集成 Tree-sitter 实现快速语法高亮和代码折叠
编程语言工具链开发者：生成解析器用于静态分析、代码格式化等
需要容错解析的开发者：在语法错误时仍能获得部分语法树

en.tag: Incremental parsing library & parser generator for fast syntax trees in editors
en.what: Tree-sitter is a parser generator tool and an incremental parsing library. It can build a concrete syntax tree for a source file and efficiently update the syntax tree as the source file is edited. It aims to be general enough to parse any programming language, fast enough to parse on every keystroke in a text editor, robust enough to provide useful results even in the presence of syntax errors, and dependency-free so that the runtime library (written in pure C) can be embedded in any application.
en.content: The repository includes the core C library, Rust bindings, Wasm bindings, and a command-line interface. The core library provides incremental parsing, bindings allow usage in Rust and web environments, and the CLI is used for generating parsers and testing.
en.stack: The core runtime is written in pure C, with bindings for Rust and WebAssembly. The parser generator is implemented in Rust and relies on Node.js for testing.
en.hot: Tree-sitter is a foundational component for modern code editors and IDEs like Neovim and Atom, with its incremental parsing being crucial for real-time syntax highlighting and code analysis. Although today's star increase is modest, the long-standing 26k+ stars reflect its widespread adoption and community trust.
uses: Text editor/IDE developers: integrate Tree-sitter for fast syntax highlighting and code folding
Programming language toolchain developers: generate parsers for static analysis, code formatting, etc.
Developers needing error-tolerant parsing: obtain partial syntax trees even with syntax errors

zh.tag: 把AI编码代理当队友分配任务的协作工作台
zh.what: Multica 是一个开源工作台，让你像给队友派活一样把 issue 分配给 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 20 种编码代理。代理会自动接单、在可控运行时中工作、实时评论并交回审查，所有上下文和决策都关联到同一 issue。支持自托管，无锁定。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Go 后端、Web 前端（看板界面）、文档（README、自托管指南、愿景）、以及用于集成 20 种代理 CLI 的运行时适配器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 构建后端，前端为 Web 应用，支持多种代理 CLI 的集成，自托管部署。
zh.hot: 44.5k stars 且单日新增 274，登上 Go 趋势榜第二，因为解决了多代理协作中上下文丢失和重复解释的痛点，将代理真正纳入团队流程。
uses: 开发者团队：统一管理多个编码代理，减少切换和重复沟通成本
技术负责人：将代理分配为团队成员，通过看板跟踪进度和审查结果
自托管用户：对数据隐私有要求，希望完全掌控代理运行环境

en.tag: Assign issues to AI coding agents like teammates in an open-source workspace
en.what: Multica is an open-source workspace where you assign issues to AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 20 others, just as you would to a teammate. Agents pick up issues, work in a runtime you control, comment as they go, and hand back for review, keeping context and decisions tied to the issue. Self-hostable with no lock-in.
en.content: The repo contains the core Go backend, a web frontend (board UI), documentation (README, self-hosting guide, vision), and runtime adapters for integrating 20 agent CLIs.
en.stack: Built primarily with Go for the backend, with a web frontend, and integrations for multiple agent CLIs; supports self-hosting.
en.hot: With 44.5k stars and +274 today, ranking #2 on Go trending, it solves the pain of context loss and repeated explanations when managing multiple agents, integrating them into team workflows.
uses: Dev teams: manage multiple coding agents in one place, reducing context switching and repeated explanations
Tech leads: assign agents as team members, track progress and review via board
Self-hosters: need data privacy and full control over agent runtimes

zh.tag: 自托管云开发环境与AI代理平台
zh.what: Coder 是一个自托管的云开发环境和 AI 编码代理平台。它允许你用 Terraform 定义开发环境，通过安全的 Wireguard 隧道连接，并在闲置时自动关闭以节省成本。它还支持在您的基础设施上运行 AI 编码代理，无需在工作区中存储 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Coder 的完整源代码，包括服务器、CLI、Terraform 提供程序、文档和示例模板。它支持多种工作区类型，如 EC2 VM、Kubernetes Pod 和 Docker 容器。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Terraform 进行基础设施定义，Wireguard 用于安全连接，并支持多种云提供商和模型提供商。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 编码代理的兴起，Coder 提供了自托管的解决方案，让开发者可以在自己的基础设施上运行 AI 代理，同时保持安全性和控制力。其 14k+ 的星标和每日新增表明社区对安全、可定制的开发环境需求旺盛。
uses: 希望自托管开发环境以增强安全性和合规性的团队
需要在 Kubernetes 或云 VM 上运行 AI 编码代理的开发者
寻求节省云成本并自动化环境生命周期的组织
对 Terraform 和基础设施即代码感兴趣的平台工程师

en.tag: Self-hosted cloud dev environments & AI agents
en.what: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. It lets you define dev environments in Terraform, connect via a secure Wireguard tunnel, and automatically shut down idle resources to save costs. It also runs AI coding agents on your infrastructure without storing API keys in workspaces.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code for Coder, including the server, CLI, Terraform provider, docs, and example templates. It supports various workspace types like EC2 VMs, Kubernetes Pods, and Docker containers.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Terraform for infrastructure definition, Wireguard for secure connectivity, and supports multiple cloud and model providers.
en.hot: With the rise of AI coding agents, Coder offers a self-hosted solution for running AI agents on your own infrastructure while maintaining security and control. Its 14k+ stars and daily additions indicate strong community demand for secure, customizable dev environments.
uses: Teams wanting self-hosted dev environments for enhanced security and compliance
Developers needing to run AI coding agents on Kubernetes or cloud VMs
Organizations looking to save cloud costs and automate environment lifecycle
Platform engineers interested in Terraform and infrastructure as code

zh.tag: Datadog 官方监控代理，采集主机与云数据
zh.what: Datadog Agent 是 Datadog 的官方监控代理，用于从主机、容器和云环境中采集指标、日志和追踪数据。它支持版本 6 和 7，并提供了丰富的集成和可配置的采集器。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Agent 的完整源码，包括核心守护进程、采集器、进程代理、安全代理等组件，以及文档和开发指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，涉及 eBPF（BPF 代码使用 GPLv2 许可）、C 语言，并依赖多种云原生技术。
zh.hot: 作为 Datadog 的核心组件，其稳定性和功能持续吸引开发者；尽管今日新增 star 为 0，但总星数 3696 仍使其位列 Go 趋势榜第 4。
uses: DevOps 工程师：部署和配置 Datadog Agent 以监控基础设施。
SRE 团队：利用 Agent 的日志和追踪功能进行故障排查。
开发者：为 Agent 贡献代码或构建自定义集成。

en.tag: Official Datadog monitoring agent for host and cloud data collection
en.what: The Datadog Agent is the official monitoring agent from Datadog, collecting metrics, logs, and traces from hosts, containers, and cloud environments. It supports versions 6 and 7, with extensive integrations and configurable collectors.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Agent, including core daemon, collectors, process agent, security agent, and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with eBPF (BPF code under GPLv2), C, and various cloud-native dependencies.
en.hot: As a core component of Datadog, its stability and features attract developers; despite 0 new stars today, its 3696 total stars keep it at #4 on the Go trending list.
uses: DevOps engineers: deploy and configure the Datadog Agent to monitor infrastructure.
SRE teams: use Agent's logging and tracing for troubleshooting.
Developers: contribute code or build custom integrations.

zh.tag: Go 编写的开源漏洞扫描器，对接 OSV 数据库
zh.what: OSV-Scanner 是一个用 Go 编写的漏洞扫描工具，它利用 OSV.dev 提供的开源漏洞数据库，自动检测项目依赖中已知的安全漏洞。它支持多种语言、包管理器和容器镜像，并提供修复建议。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的命令行工具源码、文档、示例配置和 CI 工作流，核心功能通过可扩展的 OSV-Scalibr 库实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 OSV-Scalibr 库，支持多种生态系统的解析器，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方维护的扫描器，它直接对接高质量的开源 OSV 数据库，覆盖广泛且持续更新，因此在开发者中广受欢迎，star 数已超 1 万。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中集成，自动扫描依赖漏洞
安全团队用于审计项目依赖和容器镜像的安全性
需要快速获取修复建议的开发者，利用引导式修复功能

en.tag: Open-source vulnerability scanner in Go, backed by OSV database
en.what: OSV-Scanner is a vulnerability scanner written in Go that uses the open-source OSV database to detect known security vulnerabilities in project dependencies. It supports multiple languages, package managers, and container images, and provides remediation guidance.
en.content: The repository contains the full CLI tool source code, documentation, example configurations, and CI workflows, with core functionality implemented via the extensible OSV-Scalibr library.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, relies on the OSV-Scalibr library, supports parsers for various ecosystems, and uses GitHub Actions for CI.
en.hot: As an officially maintained Google scanner, it directly leverages the high-quality open-source OSV database with broad coverage and continuous updates, making it popular among developers, with over 10k stars.
uses: Developers integrate it into CI/CD pipelines to automatically scan dependency vulnerabilities
Security teams use it to audit project dependencies and container images for security
Developers needing quick remediation advice can leverage guided remediation features

zh.tag: 基础设施即代码的行业标准工具
zh.what: Terraform 是一个基础设施即代码工具，允许用户通过声明式配置文件安全、可预测地创建、更改和改进基础设施。它支持众多云服务商和内部解决方案，将 API 编码为可共享、版本控制的配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Terraform 核心引擎，提供 CLI 工具、配置语言（HCL）解析器、状态管理、资源图构建和执行计划生成等核心功能。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 HashiCorp 的配置语言 HCL 和插件系统。
zh.hot: Terraform 是基础设施即代码领域的标杆项目，拥有近 5 万星标，长期稳定在 GitHub 热门榜。其强大的多云管理能力和活跃的社区生态持续吸引开发者。
uses: 云基础设施工程师 —— 使用 Terraform 管理多云环境，实现基础设施自动化部署与变更
DevOps 团队 —— 将基础设施配置纳入版本控制，实现 CI/CD 集成与协作
平台工程师 —— 构建内部开发者平台，提供自助式基础设施服务
初学者 —— 通过 Terraform 学习基础设施即代码概念和实践

en.tag: Industry-standard Infrastructure as Code tool
en.what: Terraform is an Infrastructure as Code tool that enables users to safely and predictably create, change, and improve infrastructure using declarative configuration files. It supports numerous cloud providers and in-house solutions, codifying APIs into version-controlled, shareable configurations.
en.content: The repository contains the Terraform core engine, including CLI tools, HCL parser, state management, resource graph construction, and execution plan generation.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and a plugin system.
en.hot: Terraform is the benchmark in IaC with nearly 50k stars, consistently appearing on GitHub trending. Its multi-cloud management capabilities and vibrant community keep attracting developers.
uses: Cloud infrastructure engineers — manage multi-cloud environments with automated deployment and changes
DevOps teams — version control infrastructure configs for CI/CD integration and collaboration
Platform engineers — build internal developer platforms with self-service infrastructure
Beginners — learn Infrastructure as Code concepts and practices via Terraform

zh.tag: 开源持续文件同步工具，安全易用
zh.what: Syncthing 是一款开源的持续文件同步程序，可在两台或多台计算机之间实时同步文件。它强调数据安全、防攻击、易用性和自动化，适合个人用户跨设备同步数据。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心同步引擎、命令行工具、Web GUI 及多种平台支持，还提供 Docker 镜像和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖标准库及少量第三方库，支持跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 凭借其安全、去中心化的文件同步方案，长期积累 8.7 万星标，今日新增 70 星，持续受到关注。
uses: 个人用户：跨设备同步文档、照片等，无需云服务。
团队协作：在局域网或互联网上同步项目文件。
隐私敏感者：自托管同步，数据不经过第三方服务器。
开发者：集成到自建 NAS 或服务器，实现自动化备份。

en.tag: Open-source continuous file synchronization, safe and easy to use
en.what: Syncthing is an open-source continuous file synchronization program that syncs files between two or more computers in real time. It prioritizes data safety, security against attackers, ease of use, and automation, ideal for individuals syncing data across devices.
en.content: The repository contains the core sync engine, CLI tools, a web GUI, and support for multiple platforms, along with Docker images and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the standard library and a few third-party libraries, with cross-platform compilation support.
en.hot: With its secure, decentralized file sync approach, it has amassed 87k stars over time, gaining 70 today, and remains a trending favorite.
uses: Individuals: sync documents, photos across devices without cloud services.
Teams: sync project files over LAN or the internet.
Privacy-conscious users: self-hosted sync, data never touches third-party servers.
Developers: integrate into NAS or servers for automated backups.

zh.tag: 高性能命令行模糊搜索工具与交互式终端应用框架
zh.what: fzf 是一个通用的命令行模糊查找器，能够在海量数据中通过模糊匹配快速定位目标。它既可以作为独立的文件、历史记录搜索工具，也可通过事件驱动架构嵌入脚本，构建丰富的交互式终端应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 编写的单二进制可执行文件源码，以及针对 Bash、Zsh、Fish、Nushell、Vim 和 Neovim 的即用型集成脚本与插件。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，编译为无依赖的独立二进制文件；通过事件驱动架构提供可编程接口，并原生支持主流 Shell 与编辑器生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 81K+ Star 和月增 1,121 Star 的势头，fzf 已成为终端效率工具的标杆；其毫秒级检索速度、零依赖部署以及对全平台 Shell 和编辑器的深度集成，让它在开发者群体中经久不衰。
uses: 终端重度用户 —— 快速模糊定位文件、目录与命令历史，替代传统 grep/find 交互。
Shell 效率极客 —— 通过键盘驱动的工作流，在 Bash/Zsh/Fish 中构建自定义模糊菜单。
Vim/Neovim 用户 —— 作为编辑器插件实现文件、Buffer、LSP 符号等模糊搜索。
运维与 DevOps 工程师 —— 在日志、进程、K8s 资源等海量文本中秒级定位目标。

en.tag: A blazing-fast command-line fuzzy finder and interactive terminal toolkit
en.what: fzf is a general-purpose command-line fuzzy finder that lets you rapidly locate items in massive datasets using fuzzy matching. It works as a standalone tool for searching files and command history, and its event-driven architecture allows embedding into scripts to build rich interactive terminal applications.
en.content: The repository contains the source code for a single Go binary, along with ready-to-use integration scripts and plugins for Bash, Zsh, Fish, Nushell, Vim, and Neovim.
en.stack: Written in Go and distributed as a self-contained, dependency-free binary. It exposes a programmable, event-driven interface and natively integrates with major shells and editors.
en.hot: With 81K+ stars and 1,121 new stars this month, fzf is a benchmark for terminal productivity; its millisecond-level search speed, zero-dependency deployment, and deep integration across all major shells and editors make it a perennial favorite among developers.
uses: Power terminal users — Fuzzy-locate files, directories, and command history at speed, replacing traditional grep/find interactions.
Shell efficiency enthusiasts — Build custom fuzzy menus and keyboard-driven workflows in Bash, Zsh, Fish, or Nushell.
Vim/Neovim users — Use as an editor plugin for fuzzy searching files, buffers, LSP symbols, and more.
Ops & DevOps engineers — Instantly pinpoint targets in massive logs, processes, or Kubernetes resources.

zh.tag: 人人都能用的现代 Docker 管理工具
zh.what: Arcane 是一个开源的 Docker 管理平台，提供直观的界面来管理容器、镜像、网络和卷。它旨在简化 Docker 的日常操作，让非专业用户也能轻松上手。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端仪表盘（如 dashboard-1.19.3.png 所示）和后端服务（Go 编写），并提供官方文档站点、SBOM 清单和 Crowdin 多语言翻译支持。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，前端可能基于 Web 技术（如 React/Vue，但未明确），依赖 Docker API 进行容器管理。集成 Crowdin 进行翻译，使用 Snyk 进行安全扫描。
zh.hot: 随着 Docker 的普及，用户对易用的管理界面需求增加。Arcane 以“为每个人设计”为口号，提供现代化 UI，且近期在 GitHub 上获得 6890 星，日增 18 星，进入 Go 语言趋势榜。
uses: 开发者和运维人员：需要快速管理多个 Docker 容器和服务的场景。
初学者：希望避开命令行，通过图形界面学习 Docker 操作。
团队协作：需要统一管理 Docker 环境，并支持多语言界面的团队。

en.tag: Modern Docker management designed for everyone
en.what: Arcane is an open-source Docker management platform that provides an intuitive interface for managing containers, images, networks, and volumes. It aims to simplify daily Docker operations, making it accessible to non-experts.
en.content: The repository includes a frontend dashboard (as shown in dashboard-1.19.3.png) and a backend service written in Go, along with an official documentation site, SBOM manifest, and Crowdin localization support.
en.stack: Backend is written in Go, frontend likely uses web technologies (e.g., React/Vue, not specified), relies on Docker API for container management. Integrates Crowdin for translations and Snyk for security scanning.
en.hot: With the rise of Docker, there is a growing demand for easy-to-use management interfaces. Arcane's modern UI and 'designed for everyone' approach have attracted 6890 stars, with 18 new stars today, ranking #9 on GitHub Trending for Go.
uses: Developers and DevOps: for quickly managing multiple Docker containers and services.
Beginners: who prefer a GUI over CLI to learn Docker operations.
Teams: needing centralized Docker management with multilingual UI support.

zh.tag: 开源 RAG 引擎，融合 Agent 能力，为 LLM 提供上下文层

zh.tag: 一键追溯进程/端口/容器/文件来源的 CLI+TUI 工具

en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI and TUI program, along with installation scripts, documentation, and a browser demo. It parses process trees, service managers, containers, and file systems to generate causal chains.

伦理黑客 —— 在隔离沙箱中快速验证漏洞利用路径的技术爱好者

en.tag: Fully autonomous AI agent system for complex penetration testing
en.what: PentAGI is an AI-powered autonomous penetration testing platform that plans and executes complex security assessments using intelligent agents. It operates within fully isolated Docker sandboxes to help security researchers and ethical hackers identify vulnerabilities efficiently.
en.content: The repository includes a complete Docker-based deployment, web UI and API, plus adapters for over a dozen LLM providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek and Ollama. It also integrates advanced modules such as Graphiti knowledge graph, Langfuse observability, and OAuth authentication.
en.stack: The core system is built in Go with a modern web frontend. It leverages Docker for strict task-level sandbox isolation and offers flexible plug-ins for both proprietary and open-source LLMs.
en.hot: With 20,871 Stars and 1,111 added this week alone, PentAGI ranks 15th on GitHub's weekly Go trending list, reflecting strong community excitement for autonomous AI-driven penetration testing.
uses: Enterprise red/blue teams seeking automated vulnerability assessment and defense validation
Penetration testers looking to boost efficiency of complex security tasks with AI agents
Security researchers studying autonomous decision-making and tool orchestration in offensive AI
Ethical hackers and enthusiasts who need isolated sandboxes to rapidly verify exploit paths

zh.tag: 终端里的 Kubernetes 管理神器
zh.what: K9s 是一个基于终端 UI 的 Kubernetes 集群管理工具，提供实时监控和交互式操作。它持续观察集群变化，让用户通过命令快速导航、查看和管理资源。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、文档、截图和演示视频，提供安装、使用、定制等指南。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，依赖 Kubernetes API 和终端 UI 库（如 tview），支持多种平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 34k+ star 成为 Kubernetes 生态的明星工具，因其高效、美观的终端界面和活跃的社区支持而广受欢迎。
uses: Kubernetes 管理员和开发者：快速排查和操作集群资源
DevOps 工程师：在终端中监控和部署应用
学习和演示：通过直观的 UI 理解 Kubernetes 概念

en.tag: A terminal UI to manage Kubernetes clusters in style
en.what: K9s is a terminal UI tool for managing Kubernetes clusters, offering real-time monitoring and interactive operations. It continuously watches cluster changes and lets users navigate, view, and manage resources via commands.
en.content: The repo includes Go source code, docs, screenshots, and demo videos, with guides for installation, usage, and customization.
en.stack: Written in Go, leveraging Kubernetes APIs and terminal UI libraries (e.g., tview), cross-platform.
en.hot: With 34k+ stars, it's a star tool in the Kubernetes ecosystem, popular for its efficient, stylish terminal UI and active community support.
uses: K8s admins and developers: quickly troubleshoot and operate cluster resources
DevOps engineers: monitor and deploy apps from the terminal
Learning and demos: understand K8s concepts via an intuitive UI

zh.tag: 自动化 Docker 容器镜像更新工具
zh.what: Watchtower 是一个用于自动化 Docker 容器镜像更新的工具。当新镜像推送到 Docker Hub 或私有仓库时，它会自动拉取新镜像，优雅地关闭旧容器，并使用相同的配置重新启动容器。它适用于家庭实验室、媒体中心、本地开发环境等场景，但不建议用于生产环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Watchtower 的源代码、Dockerfile、文档和配置示例。主要组件是 Go 编写的守护进程，通过 Docker API 监控镜像更新。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Docker Engine API 与 Docker Hub 或私有仓库交互。支持通过环境变量或配置文件进行配置。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上受到关注，因为它解决了 Docker 用户手动更新容器的痛点，自动化了流程，节省时间。今日新增 13 星，总星数 4215，位列 Go 语言日榜第 22 名。
uses: 家庭实验室爱好者：自动化更新自托管服务容器，保持最新版本。
开发人员：在本地开发环境中自动更新依赖镜像，提高效率。
媒体中心用户：确保媒体服务器等容器自动更新，减少手动维护。
运维人员：在非生产环境中简化镜像更新流程，但需注意生产环境不推荐。

en.tag: Automate Docker container image updates
en.what: Watchtower is a tool that automates the updating of Docker container images. When a new image is pushed to Docker Hub or a private registry, it pulls the new image, gracefully shuts down the existing container, and restarts it with the same options used during deployment. It is intended for homelabs, media centers, local dev environments, and similar, but not recommended for production.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, Dockerfile, documentation, and configuration examples for Watchtower. The main component is a daemon written in Go that monitors image updates via the Docker API.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go, it relies on the Docker Engine API to interact with Docker Hub or private registries. Configuration is supported via environment variables or configuration files.
en.hot: The repository gains attention because it solves the pain point of manually updating Docker containers, automating the process and saving time. With 13 new stars today and a total of 4215, it ranks 22nd on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Homelab enthusiasts: Automate updates for self-hosted service containers to keep them current.
Developers: Automatically update dependency images in local dev environments for efficiency.
Media center users: Ensure containers like media servers update automatically, reducing manual maintenance.
Ops personnel: Simplify image update workflows in non-production environments, though not recommended for production.

zh.tag: 开源LLM知识平台，集RAG检索、Agent推理与自动Wiki于一体
zh.what: WeKnora 是腾讯开源的面向企业级文档理解与语义检索的 LLM 知识框架。它能将原始文档转化为可查询的 RAG 知识库、自主编排检索与工具调用的推理 Agent，以及可自动维护的互联 Wiki 知识图谱。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言服务端为核心，包含多数据源接入模块、ReAct Agent 引擎、Wiki 自动构建与知识图谱组件，以及可嵌入外部站点的发布部件、Chrome 扩展、运行时任务队列看板与多工作空间 RBAC 企业级管理后台。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，后端兼容 20 余种 LLM 提供商，接入 Langfuse 实现全链路可观测，并支持多实例存储后端与飞书、Notion、语雀等企业数据源。
zh.hot: 凭借「RAG + Agent + 自动 Wiki」三位一体的独特定位，WeKnora 在 GitHub 已斩获 18.5k Stars，单日新增 49 Star 并跻身 Go 语言 Trending 日榜第 20 位，成为企业知识管理赛道的瞩目新星。
uses: 企业知识管理团队 —— 需要将飞书/Notion 等分散文档统一为可检索、可推理的中央知识库。
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望快速集成带 RBAC、多租户和可观测性的 RAG 与 Agent 能力。
社区与开源项目维护者 —— 想通过自动 Wiki 与知识图谱降低文档维护成本。
网站运营者 —— 意图通过嵌入部件将智能问答 Agent 发布到外部站点。

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform unifying RAG, Agent reasoning, and auto-Wiki
en.what: WeKnora is a Tencent open-source, LLM-powered knowledge framework for enterprise-grade document understanding and semantic retrieval. It turns raw documents into a queryable RAG system, an autonomous ReAct agent that orchestrates retrieval and tools, and a self-maintaining interlinked Wiki with an interactive knowledge graph.
en.content: The repository centers on a Go-based server core, featuring multi-source ingestion adapters, a ReAct Agent engine, auto-Wiki and knowledge graph components, plus embeddable site widgets, a Chrome extension, a runtime task-queue dashboard, and enterprise multi-workspace RBAC controls.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it integrates with 20+ LLM providers, leverages Langfuse for full observability, and supports multi-instance storage backends alongside enterprise data sources such as Feishu, Notion, and Yuque.
en.hot: Driven by its unique trio of RAG, Agent, and auto-Wiki, WeKnora has earned 18.5k stars on GitHub, adding 49 stars in a single day and hitting 20th place on the Go Trending daily list, making it a rising star in enterprise knowledge management.
uses: Enterprise knowledge teams seeking to unify scattered docs from Feishu/Notion into a centralized, searchable, and reasoning-ready knowledge base.
AI application developers looking to quickly integrate RAG and Agent capabilities with RBAC, multi-tenancy, and observability.
Open-source maintainers and communities wanting to reduce documentation overhead via auto-generated Wiki and knowledge graphs.
Website operators aiming to publish intelligent Q&A agents to external sites through embeddable widgets.

zh.tag: 一站式开源 DevOps 平台：代码托管、CI/CD、开发环境与制品库
zh.what: Harness Open Source 是一个端到端的开发者平台，集成了源代码管理、CI/CD 流水线、托管开发环境（Gitspaces）和制品库。它旨在为团队提供一个完整的开源 DevOps 解决方案，覆盖从代码托管到部署的整个开发流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Harness 平台的完整源代码，包括后端服务（Go 编写）、前端界面以及 Docker 镜像。项目结构包含多个组件，如代码托管、流水线引擎、Gitspaces 和制品库等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，前端可能使用 React 等现代框架。依赖包括 Docker、protobuf 等，需要 Node.js 和 Go 1.20+ 环境进行开发。
zh.hot: Harness 作为 Drone 的下一代产品，吸引了大量关注，star 数已达 37k+。它提供了一体化的 DevOps 能力，解决了开发者对统一平台的需求，因此热度持续上升。
uses: 开发团队：需要一体化 DevOps 平台，简化代码托管、CI/CD 和开发环境管理。
DevOps 工程师：希望从 Drone 迁移到更全面的平台，或寻求开源替代方案。
自托管用户：偏好本地部署，掌控数据和安全性的团队。

en.tag: All-in-one open-source DevOps platform: source control, CI/CD, dev environments, and artifact registry
en.what: Harness Open Source is an end-to-end developer platform that integrates source code management, CI/CD pipelines, hosted development environments (Gitspaces), and artifact registries. It aims to provide teams with a complete open-source DevOps solution covering the entire development workflow from code hosting to deployment.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Harness platform, including backend services (written in Go), frontend interfaces, and Docker images. The project structure includes multiple components such as source control, pipeline engine, Gitspaces, and artifact registry modules.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, with frontend likely using modern frameworks like React. Dependencies include Docker, protobuf, and requires Node.js and Go 1.20+ for development.
en.hot: As the next generation of Drone, Harness has attracted significant attention, with over 37k stars. It offers an all-in-one DevOps capability, addressing the need for a unified platform, which keeps its popularity rising.
uses: Development teams: need an all-in-one DevOps platform to simplify code hosting, CI/CD, and dev environment management.
DevOps engineers: looking to migrate from Drone to a more comprehensive platform, or seeking open-source alternatives.
Self-hosted users: teams that prefer on-premises deployment for data control and security.

zh.tag: 在 ARM64 Linux 上运行 x86 应用的高性能模拟器
zh.what: FEX 是一个用户态模拟器，允许在 ARM64 Linux 设备上运行 x86 和 x86-64 程序，类似 qemu-user 和 box64。它支持 32 位和 64 位二进制，可与 Wine/Proton 配合运行 Windows 游戏，并可将 API 调用转发到宿主机库以减少模拟开销。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心、FEXConfig 图形配置工具、FEXRootFSFetcher 工具、安装脚本、文档和源代码结构说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 ARMv8.0+ 硬件，支持多种 Linux 发行版，需要 x86-64 RootFS。
zh.hot: 今日新增 6 星，总星数 7827，位居 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第一。其广泛的兼容性和游戏支持能力吸引了大量 ARM 设备用户。
uses: ARM64 Linux 用户希望在设备上运行 x86 应用或游戏
开发者测试和调试跨架构软件
游戏玩家使用 Wine/Proton 在 ARM 设备上玩 Windows 游戏
希望优化特定应用性能的高级用户

en.tag: High-performance x86/x86-64 emulator for ARM64 Linux
en.what: FEX is a usermode emulator that allows running x86 and x86-64 applications on ARM64 Linux devices, similar to qemu-user and box64. It supports both 32-bit and 64-bit binaries, can be used with Wine/Proton to play Windows games, and forwards API calls to host libraries to reduce emulation overhead.
en.content: The repository contains the emulator core, FEXConfig GUI tool, FEXRootFSFetcher tool, installation scripts, documentation, and source outline.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, requires ARMv8.0+ hardware, supports multiple Linux distributions, and needs an x86-64 RootFS.
en.hot: Gained 6 stars today, total 7827, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending C++ daily. Its broad compatibility and gaming support attract many ARM device users.
uses: ARM64 Linux users wanting to run x86 apps or games
Developers testing and debugging cross-architecture software
Gamers using Wine/Proton to play Windows games on ARM devices
Advanced users tweaking performance per application

zh.tag: Google 开源的端到端机器学习框架与生态平台
zh.what: TensorFlow 是 Google 开发的端到端开源机器学习平台，提供从研究到生产部署的完整工具链与库生态。它让研究者能够推进机器学习前沿，也让开发者轻松构建和部署 AI 驱动的应用。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 运行时、Python 与 C++ API、Keras 高级接口，以及 TensorFlow Lite、TensorFlow.js 等跨平台推理部署工具和丰富的官方示例。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 构建高性能计算后端，通过 Python 提供主要前端接口；支持 CUDA GPU 加速、Bazel 构建系统及 Docker 部署，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为深度学习领域最具影响力的基础框架之一，TensorFlow 凭借 196,329 星（本周新增 365 颗）和工业级稳定性，持续获得学术界与工业界的广泛采用。
uses: 机器学习研究者 —— 需要灵活底层接口进行模型创新与算法实验
AI 应用开发者 —— 希望借助 Keras 和 TF Lite 快速训练并部署到端侧或服务器
工程团队 —— 寻求从训练到推理的规模化、可移植生产流水线
高校学生 —— 学习深度学习原理与工程实践的首选框架之一

en.tag: Google's end-to-end open-source ML framework and ecosystem
en.what: TensorFlow is an end-to-end open-source machine learning platform developed by Google, offering a comprehensive toolchain and library ecosystem from research to production. It enables researchers to push the state-of-the-art in ML while allowing developers to easily build and deploy AI-powered applications.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ runtime, Python and C++ APIs, the Keras high-level interface, plus cross-platform deployment tools like TensorFlow Lite and TensorFlow.js along with extensive official examples.
en.stack: Built on C++ for a high-performance compute backend with Python as the primary frontend; it supports CUDA GPU acceleration, Bazel builds, Docker deployment, and multi-language bindings.
en.hot: As one of the most influential foundational deep-learning frameworks, TensorFlow maintains strong momentum with 196,329 stars and 365 new stars this week, reflecting broad academic and industrial adoption for its production-grade stability.
uses: ML researchers —— who need flexible low-level APIs for model innovation and algorithmic experiments
AI application developers —— looking to quickly train and deploy models to mobile, edge, or server via Keras and TF Lite
Engineering teams —— seeking scalable, portable production pipelines from training to inference
Students and educators —— using it as a primary framework to learn deep-learning concepts and engineering practices

zh.tag: NVIDIA 推理通信加速库，面向 Dynamo 的点对点传输
zh.what: NIXL 是 NVIDIA 推出的推理传输库，旨在加速 AI 推理框架（如 Dynamo）中的点对点通信。它通过模块化插件架构抽象 CPU/GPU 内存和文件/块/对象存储，简化数据传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库、Python API 绑定、文档（架构、后端指南、遥测等）、以及基准测试工具（NIXLBench 和 KVBench）。
zh.stack: 基于 C++20，依赖 UCX（1.22.x）和 GDRCopy 以获得最佳性能；提供 PyPI 包，自动选择 CUDA 12/13 后端。
zh.hot: 作为 NVIDIA Dynamo 生态的关键组件，NIXL 解决了推理场景中大规模数据传输的瓶颈，刚开源即获 1178 星，并登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: AI 推理框架开发者，需要高效的点对点通信
NVIDIA Dynamo 用户，优化多 GPU 推理性能
系统工程师，需要跨内存/存储的抽象传输层
性能调优人员，使用 NIXLBench 进行基准测试

en.tag: NVIDIA library for accelerating point-to-point comms in AI inference, e.g., Dynamo
en.what: NIXL is NVIDIA's inference transfer library designed to accelerate point-to-point communications in AI inference frameworks like Dynamo. It abstracts various memory (CPU/GPU) and storage (file/block/object) via a modular plugin architecture.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ library, Python API bindings, docs (architecture, backend guide, telemetry), and benchmark tools (NIXLBench and KVBench).
en.stack: Built on C++20, depends on UCX (1.22.x) and GDRCopy for max performance; PyPI package auto-selects CUDA 12/13 backends.
en.hot: As a key component of NVIDIA Dynamo, NIXL addresses data transfer bottlenecks in inference; it gained 1178 stars quickly and hit the C++ trending list.
uses: Developers of AI inference frameworks needing efficient P2P comms
NVIDIA Dynamo users optimizing multi-GPU inference
Systems engineers needing an abstraction layer over memory/storage
Performance tuners using NIXLBench for benchmarking

zh.tag: 开源金融终端，提供市场分析与投资研究工具
zh.what: FinceptTerminal 是一个现代化的金融应用程序，提供高级市场分析、投资研究和经济数据工具。它旨在为用户提供交互式探索和数据驱动的决策支持，界面友好。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码，基于 Qt6 构建的桌面 GUI，以及 Python 脚本用于数据处理。提供实时市场数据、图表、投资组合分析等功能模块。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 C++20、Qt6 框架、Python 3.11+，以及 AGPL-3.0 许可证。依赖项通过 CMake 管理。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上获得 29k+ 星标，今日新增 104 星，位居 C++ 日榜第一。尽管维护频率降低，但作为开源金融终端，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 个人投资者 —— 用于市场分析和投资决策支持
金融研究人员 —— 获取经济数据和进行量化研究
开发者 —— 学习和扩展金融终端功能

en.tag: Open-source financial terminal for market analytics and investment research
en.what: FinceptTerminal is a modern finance application offering advanced market analytics, investment research, and economic data tools, designed for interactive exploration and data-driven decision-making in a user-friendly environment.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, a Qt6-based desktop GUI, and Python scripts for data processing. It includes modules for real-time market data, charting, portfolio analysis, and more.
en.stack: Tech stack includes C++20, Qt6 framework, Python 3.11+, licensed under AGPL-3.0. Dependencies are managed via CMake.
en.hot: The project has gained 29k+ stars on GitHub, with 104 new stars today, ranking #1 on C++ daily trending. Despite reduced maintenance, its open-source financial terminal nature attracts significant attention.
uses: Individual investors — for market analysis and investment decision support
Financial researchers — to access economic data and conduct quantitative research
Developers — to learn and extend financial terminal capabilities

zh.tag: 统一云端与本地离线推理的跨平台 AI 客户端
zh.what: 这是一个生产就绪的跨平台 AI 聊天客户端，支持在 Android 设备上本地运行 GGUF 模型（GPU 加速，无需联网），同时可无缝切换到 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google Gemini 或 Kimi 等云端 API。它提供多模态聊天、持久化会话、后台任务和智能自动配置等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Flutter 应用源码，包括 UI 层（聊天、任务、模型、设置视图）、GetX 控制器、服务层（本地推理、云服务、下载服务）以及推理管线的架构说明。
zh.stack: 基于 Flutter 3.x（Dart >=3.3.0），使用 GetX 管理状态，Hive 本地存储，Dio 网络请求，以及 Firebase 消息推送。本地推理依赖 Vulkan 加速。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 日榜（C++）排名第 5，今日新增 23 星，总星数 834。其亮点是同时支持本地离线运行和云端 API，且针对多种 Android 设备进行了图像生成测试，满足了用户对隐私和灵活性的需求。
uses: 注重隐私的用户：希望在本地运行模型，避免数据上传到云端。
移动开发者：需要参考 Flutter 跨平台 AI 客户端架构和本地推理集成。
AI 爱好者：希望在没有网络或低配设备上体验 LLM 和图像生成。

en.tag: Unified cross-platform AI client bridging cloud APIs and on-device offline LLM inference
en.what: A production-ready cross-platform AI chat client that runs GGUF models locally on Android with GPU acceleration (no internet after download) and seamlessly switches to cloud APIs like OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, or Kimi. It offers multimodal chat, persistent sessions, background tasks, and smart auto-configuration.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Flutter app source code, including UI layer (chat, task, model, settings views), GetX controllers, service layer (local inference, cloud service, download service), and architecture documentation for the inference pipeline.
en.stack: Built with Flutter 3.x (Dart >=3.3.0), uses GetX for state management, Hive for local storage, Dio for networking, and Firebase for push notifications. Local inference relies on Vulkan acceleration.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 23 stars today and 834 total. Its appeal lies in combining local offline execution with cloud API fallback, tested on various Android devices for image generation, addressing privacy and flexibility needs.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to run models locally without data leaving their device.
Mobile developers looking for a reference Flutter cross-platform AI client architecture and local inference integration.
AI enthusiasts who want to experiment with LLMs and image generation offline or on low-end devices.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 开发的 C++ 测试框架，提供单元测试、模拟对象和丰富的断言。它支持自动测试发现、死亡测试、参数化测试等特性，是 C++ 社区最广泛使用的测试工具之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的合并源码、构建系统（CMake/Bazel）、文档和示例。目录结构包括 googletest（核心框架）、googlemock（模拟库）和 docs（文档）。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖 C++17 及以上标准（1.17.x 分支）。构建支持 CMake 和 Bazel，计划引入 Abseil 依赖。

uses: C++ 开发者 —— 编写单元测试和集成测试
质量保证工程师 —— 自动化测试和持续集成
开源项目维护者 —— 为项目添加测试覆盖
教学场景 —— 学习 C++ 测试最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework providing unit testing, mocking, and a rich set of assertions. It supports automatic test discovery, death tests, parameterized tests, and is one of the most widely used testing tools in the C++ community.
en.content: The repository contains merged source code of GoogleTest and GoogleMock, build systems (CMake/Bazel), documentation, and examples. Directory structure includes googletest (core framework), googlemock (mocking library), and docs.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation, requires C++17 or later (1.17.x branch). Build supports CMake and Bazel, with planned dependency on Abseil.
en.hot: As the industry standard for C++ testing, it maintains steady updates (45 stars this week). The 1.17.0 release requires C++17, attracting new users.
uses: C++ developers — writing unit and integration tests
QA engineers — automated testing and CI
Open-source maintainers — adding test coverage to projects
Educational settings — learning C++ testing best practices

zh.tag: 极速 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only与编译双模式
zh.what: spdlog 是一款高性能 C++ 日志库，支持头文件-only和编译两种集成方式。它提供丰富的日志输出目标、异步/同步模式、运行时与编译时日志级别过滤，以及基于 fmt 的现代化格式化语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件目录、CMake 构建脚本、多平台 CI 配置、示例代码及基准测试；用户可直接拷贝 include 文件夹以头文件方式使用，或通过 CMake 编译为静态/动态库。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++11/14 实现，格式化层依赖 fmt 库；支持通过 CMake 构建，并覆盖 Linux、Windows、macOS、Android 等主流平台。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最广泛采用的日志方案之一，spdlog 凭借极致性能与零成本抽象累积近 3 万 Star；本月新增 141 Star 并登 Trending 月榜第 16，足见其在高性能后端与嵌入式场景的持续热度。
uses: 高性能 C++ 后端服务开发者 —— 需要纳秒级延迟的同步或异步日志记录
跨平台桌面与嵌入式应用团队 —— 寻求覆盖 Windows、Linux、macOS 及 Android 的统一日志方案
游戏引擎与中间件开发者 —— 追求头文件-only快速集成或编译库以缩短构建时间
DevOps 与系统工具开发者 —— 需要日志轮转、syslog、环境变量级别控制等生产级特性

en.tag: Blazing-fast C++ logging library with header-only & compiled modes
en.what: spdlog is a high-performance C++ logging library offering both header-only and compiled integration modes. It supports multiple sinks, asynchronous/sync logging, runtime and compile-time level filtering, and modern formatting powered by the fmt library.
en.content: The repo provides header-only sources, CMake build scripts, cross-platform CI configs, usage examples, and benchmarks. Users can either copy the include folder for header-only use or build a static/shared library via CMake.
en.stack: Built on modern C++11/14, it relies on the fmt library for formatting and uses CMake for building, supporting Linux, Windows, macOS, Android, and more.
en.hot: As one of the most widely adopted C++ logging solutions, spdlog has amassed nearly 30k stars thanks to its extreme performance and zero-cost abstractions; gaining 141 stars this month and ranking 16th on the Trending monthly chart reflects its enduring popularity in high-performance backends and embedded systems.
uses: High-performance C++ backend engineers — needing nanosecond-scale sync or async logging
Cross-platform desktop and embedded teams — seeking a unified logging solution across Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android
Game engine and middleware developers — pursuing header-only quick integration or compiled libraries for faster build times
DevOps and systems tool builders — requiring production-grade features like log rotation, syslog, and environment-level controls

zh.tag: Cloudflare Workers 开源运行时，自托管与本地开发利器
zh.what: workerd 是 Cloudflare Workers 背后的 JavaScript/Wasm 服务器运行时，基于 V8 引擎构建。它支持将 Workers 应用部署到自有服务器，也可作为开发工具在本地测试，还能充当可编程 HTTP 代理。
zh.content: 仓库包含 workerd 的完整源代码、文档、示例配置，以及用于构建和测试的脚本。核心是 C++ 实现的运行时，提供基于标准 Web API 的 Workers 执行环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 V8 引擎（JavaScript/Wasm），支持 Linux、macOS 和 Windows。构建系统采用 Bazel。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare Workers 的开源核心，workerd 吸引了大量开发者和企业关注，今日新增 57 星，总星数 8519，在 C++ 日榜排名第 8。其独特的 nanoservices 架构和兼容性设计是亮点。
uses: 自托管 Workers 应用：将原本部署在 Cloudflare 上的代码迁移到自己的服务器。
本地开发与测试：在本地模拟 Workers 环境，加快迭代。
可编程 HTTP 代理：用于请求拦截、修改和路由。
学习 Cloudflare Workers 内部机制：研究其设计原理和实现。

en.tag: Open-source runtime powering Cloudflare Workers for self-hosting and local dev
en.what: workerd is the JavaScript/Wasm server runtime that powers Cloudflare Workers, built on V8. It enables self-hosting Workers applications, local development and testing, and can act as a programmable HTTP proxy.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, example configs, and build/test scripts for workerd. The core is a C++ runtime providing a Workers execution environment based on standard Web APIs.
en.stack: Primarily C++, depends on V8 for JS/Wasm, supports Linux, macOS, and Windows. Build system uses Bazel.
en.hot: As the open-source core of Cloudflare Workers, workerd attracts developers and enterprises; +57 stars today, 8519 total, #8 on C++ daily trending. Its nanoservices architecture and compatibility design stand out.

Local development: simulate the Workers environment for faster iteration.
Programmable HTTP proxy: intercept, modify, and route requests.
Learn Workers internals: study its design principles and implementation.

zh.tag: 通用运动恢复结构与多视角立体视觉管线
zh.what: COLMAP 是一个通用的运动恢复结构（SfM）和多视角立体（MVS）管线，提供图形界面和命令行界面。它能够从有序或无序的图像集合中重建三维场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、文档、示例数据集、预构建二进制文件、Docker 镜像、Conda 包以及 Python 绑定（PyCOLMAP）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Ceres Solver、PoseLib、SiftGPU、VLFeat 等库，支持 CUDA 和 HIP/ROCm（AMD GPU），并提供 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为三维重建领域的经典工具，COLMAP 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 星，总星数达 12412，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 9 名。
uses: 计算机视觉研究人员进行三维重建实验
摄影测量和测绘专业人员处理图像数据
开发者集成三维重建功能到自己的应用中
教育领域用于教学演示和学术研究

en.tag: General-purpose Structure-from-Motion and Multi-View Stereo pipeline
en.what: COLMAP is a general-purpose Structure-from-Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) pipeline with a graphical and command-line interface. It reconstructs 3D scenes from ordered or unordered image collections.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, documentation, sample datasets, pre-built binaries, Docker images, Conda packages, and Python bindings (PyCOLMAP).
en.stack: Primarily C++, with dependencies on Ceres Solver, PoseLib, SiftGPU, VLFeat, supporting CUDA and HIP/ROCm (AMD GPUs), and offering Python bindings.
en.hot: As a classic tool in 3D reconstruction, COLMAP continues to gain attention, with 13 new stars today and 12,412 total, ranking 9th on the C++ trending list.
uses: Computer vision researchers conducting 3D reconstruction experiments
Photogrammetry and surveying professionals processing image data
Developers integrating 3D reconstruction into their applications
Educational use for teaching demonstrations and academic research

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 的 JSON 解析与序列化库
zh.what: 这是一个广受欢迎的头文件优先 JSON 库，为 C++ 开发者提供直观、STL 风格的 API 来解析、生成和操作 JSON 数据。它支持将 JSON 与 C++ 数据结构无缝互转，大幅降低了现代 C++ 项目中处理 JSON 的复杂度。
zh.content: 仓库以单头文件（json.hpp）为核心分发形态，同时包含完整的测试套件、基准测试、文档网站源码及多包管理器（Conan、vcpkg 等）支持配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++11/14/17 标准库实现，无需外部依赖，仅依赖 STL 容器和模板元编程，支持通过 CMake 构建测试与示例。
zh.hot: 凭借超 5 万 Star 和今日新增 17 Star 登上 C++ 日榜第 10，它已成为 C++ 生态的事实标准 JSON 库。其“像 STL 一样直观”的 API 设计和单头文件即用的便捷性持续吸引开发者。

嵌入式与游戏项目团队希望以单头文件引入依赖，简化构建流程
基础设施开发者在微服务、配置系统或协议网关中进行结构化数据交换

en.tag: Modern C++ JSON parsing and serialization library
en.what: A widely-adopted, header-only JSON library for C++ offering an intuitive, STL-like API to parse, generate, and manipulate JSON. It enables seamless mapping between JSON and C++ data structures, dramatically simplifying JSON handling in modern C++ projects.
en.content: The repository centers around a single-header distribution (json.hpp), complemented by comprehensive tests, benchmarks, documentation site sources, and package manager integrations like Conan and vcpkg.
en.stack: Built on C++11/14/17 with zero external dependencies, relying solely on STL containers and template metaprogramming; tests and examples are built via CMake.
en.hot: With over 50k stars and 17 new stars today, ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list, it has become the de facto standard JSON library in the C++ ecosystem. Its STL-intuitive API design and single-header convenience continue to attract developers.
uses: C++ backend and client developers needing lightweight, high-performance JSON parsing and serialization
Embedded and game teams looking to simplify builds with a single-header dependency
Infrastructure developers performing structured data exchange in microservices, config systems, or protocol gateways

zh.tag: MySQL 社区分支，兼容并扩展的 SQL 数据库
zh.what: MariaDB 是一个由 MySQL 原核心团队发起的开源关系型数据库，高度兼容 MySQL，并增加了原生向量搜索、多种可插拔存储引擎、同步集群等特性。它被广泛应用于从小型应用到大型生产系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MariaDB 服务器的完整源代码，包括存储引擎（InnoDB、Aria、MyRocks 等）、复制与集群模块、SQL 解析器、安全功能以及文档和构建指南。

zh.hot: 作为 MySQL 的流行替代品，MariaDB 持续获得关注，今日新增 12 星，总星数 8052，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 11 名。其原生向量搜索等新特性吸引了开发者。
uses: 需要 MySQL 兼容但希望获得更多扩展功能的开发者
寻求开源、可自主托管的数据库解决方案的企业
对向量搜索和高级 SQL 功能感兴趣的数据工程师
从 MySQL 迁移到更开放平台的组织

en.tag: Community-developed MySQL fork with extended features
en.what: MariaDB is an open-source relational database forked from MySQL, led by original MySQL developers. It maintains high MySQL compatibility while adding native vector search, pluggable storage engines, synchronous clustering, and more. It powers workloads from small apps to large-scale production.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the MariaDB server, including storage engines (InnoDB, Aria, MyRocks, etc.), replication and clustering modules, SQL parser, security features, and documentation/build guides.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with a pluggable storage engine architecture and cross-platform build support.
en.hot: As a popular MySQL alternative, MariaDB continues to gain attention, with 12 new stars today and 8052 total, ranking #11 on the C++ trending list. Its native vector search and other new features attract developers.
uses: Developers needing MySQL compatibility with extra features
Enterprises seeking open-source, self-hosted database solutions
Data engineers interested in vector search and advanced SQL
Organizations migrating from MySQL to a more open platform

zh.tag: 跨平台深度相机 SDK，支持深度与彩色流及标定
zh.what: librealsense 是 RealSense 深度相机的官方跨平台 SDK，提供深度和彩色流，以及内参和外参标定信息。它支持多种编程语言和操作系统，广泛应用于机器人、计算机视觉和 AR/VR 等领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含 SDK 核心库、示例代码、文档、工具和固件更新程序，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java）和 ROS 集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android，可选依赖包括 OpenCV、CUDA 和 librealsense 的 Python 绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 RealSense 官方 SDK，迁移到新组织后持续更新，拥有近 9000 星，是深度相机开发者的核心工具。

计算机视觉研究者：获取深度数据用于算法开发
AR/VR 应用开发者：实现手势识别和环境感知
嵌入式开发者：在边缘设备上集成深度感知

en.tag: Cross-platform SDK for RealSense depth cameras with depth/color streaming and calibration
en.what: librealsense is the official cross-platform SDK for RealSense depth cameras, providing depth and color streaming along with intrinsic and extrinsic calibration information. It supports multiple programming languages and operating systems, widely used in robotics, computer vision, and AR/VR.
en.content: The repository contains the SDK core library, examples, documentation, tools, and firmware updater, with language bindings for Python, C#, Java, and ROS integration.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with CMake, supports Windows, Linux, macOS, and Android, with optional dependencies like OpenCV, CUDA, and Python bindings.
en.hot: As the official RealSense SDK, it continues to update after migrating to a new organization, with nearly 9k stars, making it a core tool for depth camera developers.

Computer vision researchers: to obtain depth data for algorithm development
AR/VR developers: for gesture recognition and environment perception
Embedded developers: to integrate depth sensing on edge devices

zh.tag: 开源自动驾驶仿真平台，支持传感器与场景定制
zh.what: CARLA 是一个专为自动驾驶研究设计的开源仿真器，支持开发、训练和验证自动驾驶系统。它提供开放的数字资产（城市布局、建筑、车辆）以及灵活的传感器和环境条件配置。
zh.content: 仓库包含 CARLA 仿真器的完整源代码，包括 Unreal Engine 5.5 版本的开发分支（ue5-dev），以及文档、构建脚本、Python API 参考和蓝图库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 Unreal Engine 5.5，提供 Python API 用于交互，支持 Linux 和 Windows 系统。
zh.hot: CARLA 是自动驾驶研究领域最流行的开源仿真器之一，拥有 14k+ 星标，持续活跃开发，近期因 UE5 版本更新而受到关注。
uses: 自动驾驶算法研究人员：在仿真环境中测试感知、规划和控制算法
学术教育：用于自动驾驶课程教学和实验
行业开发者：验证自动驾驶系统在复杂场景下的性能
数据生成：生成合成训练数据以补充真实数据

en.tag: Open-source autonomous driving simulator for research, with flexible sensors and scenarios
en.what: CARLA is an open-source simulator designed for autonomous driving research, supporting development, training, and validation of autonomous driving systems. It provides open digital assets (urban layouts, buildings, vehicles) and flexible sensor suites and environmental conditions.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the CARLA simulator, including the development branch for Unreal Engine 5.5 (ue5-dev), along with documentation, build scripts, Python API reference, and blueprint library.
en.stack: Primarily C++ and Unreal Engine 5.5, with a Python API for interaction, supporting Linux and Windows.
en.hot: CARLA is one of the most popular open-source simulators for autonomous driving research, with 14k+ stars and active development, recently gaining attention due to the UE5 version update.
uses: Autonomous driving researchers: test perception, planning, and control algorithms in simulation
Academic education: for teaching and experiments in autonomous driving courses
Industry developers: validate AD systems in complex scenarios
Data generation: generate synthetic training data to complement real data

zh.tag: 跨平台 2D/3D 开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一款功能丰富的跨平台游戏引擎，支持从统一界面创建 2D 和 3D 游戏。它提供了一套全面的常用工具，让用户专注于游戏开发，无需重复造轮子。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Godot 引擎的完整源代码、编辑器、导出模板以及官方文档和演示示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 OpenGL/Vulkan 等图形 API，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux、Android、iOS 及 Web 平台。
zh.hot: 作为完全免费开源、无版税的游戏引擎，Godot 社区活跃，本月新增近 2000 星，持续吸引独立开发者和小型团队。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速制作 2D/3D 游戏并一键导出到多平台
游戏教育 —— 学习游戏开发原理，无需付费或授权
小型工作室 —— 低成本开发商业游戏，保留全部知识产权

en.tag: Cross-platform 2D and 3D open-source game engine
en.what: Godot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It provides a comprehensive set of common tools, allowing users to focus on making games without reinventing the wheel.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, editor, export templates, official documentation, and demo projects for the Godot Engine.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relies on graphics APIs like OpenGL/Vulkan, and supports Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
en.hot: As a completely free and open-source game engine with no royalties, Godot has an active community, gaining nearly 2000 stars this month, continuously attracting indie developers and small teams.
uses: Indie game developers — quickly create 2D/3D games and export to multiple platforms with one click
Game education — learn game development principles without licensing fees
Small studios — develop commercial games at low cost while retaining full IP

zh.tag: 高效相似度搜索与稠密向量聚类库
zh.what: Faiss 是一个用于高效相似度搜索和稠密向量聚类的库。它包含在任意大小的向量集合中进行搜索的算法，甚至支持超出 RAM 容量的集合。它由 Meta 的 FAIR 团队开发，提供 C++ 实现和 Python/numpy 封装，并支持 GPU 加速。
zh.content: 仓库包含多种索引结构（如 IndexFlatL2、HNSW、NSG 等）和量化方法，支持 L2 距离和点积比较，并提供 GPU 实现（CUDA/ROCm）。还包括评估和参数调优的辅助代码，以及预编译的 Anaconda 包。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 实现，依赖 BLAS；可选支持 CUDA 或 AMD ROCm 的 GPU 加速，并提供 Python 接口。编译使用 cmake。
zh.hot: Faiss 是向量检索领域的标杆工具，被广泛应用于推荐系统、语义搜索等场景。虽然今日新增 star 不多，但累计 40k+ star 彰显其长期影响力和稳定性。
uses: 机器学习工程师：用于构建大规模相似性搜索系统，如推荐、去重。
数据科学家：进行向量聚类和最近邻搜索，加速实验。
研究人员：评估和调优向量索引算法。
后端开发者：集成到服务中，实现高性能向量检索。

en.tag: Efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors
en.what: Faiss is a library for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors. It contains algorithms that search in sets of vectors of any size, up to ones that may not fit in RAM. Developed by Meta's FAIR team, it is written in C++ with Python/numpy wrappers and GPU support.
en.content: The repository contains various index structures (e.g., IndexFlatL2, HNSW, NSG) and quantization methods, supporting L2 distance and dot product comparison, with GPU implementations (CUDA/ROCm). It also includes supporting code for evaluation and parameter tuning, as well as precompiled Anaconda packages.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, with BLAS as the only dependency; optional GPU support via CUDA or AMD ROCm, and a Python interface. Build with cmake.
en.hot: Faiss is a benchmark tool in vector retrieval, widely used in recommendation systems and semantic search. Despite modest daily stars, its 40k+ total stars reflect long-term influence and stability.
uses: ML engineers: build large-scale similarity search systems for recommendation, deduplication.
Data scientists: perform vector clustering and nearest neighbor search to accelerate experiments.
Researchers: evaluate and tune vector indexing algorithms.
Backend developers: integrate into services for high-performance vector retrieval.

zh.tag: 开源无人机自动驾驶仪栈，行业基石
zh.what: PX4 是一个开源的自动驾驶仪软件栈，用于无人机和无人车辆，支持多旋翼、固定翼、垂直起降、地面车辆等多种平台。它提供模块化架构、广泛的硬件支持和开发者友好的工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的自动驾驶仪源码、文档、模拟器集成、测试工具以及构建系统。核心组件包括 uORB 中间件、飞行控制栈、传感器驱动和 MAVLink/DDS 通信接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，运行于 NuttX、Linux 和 macOS 上。依赖包括 MAVLink、DDS/ROS 2、Pixhawk 硬件生态和 SITL 模拟器。
zh.hot: 作为无人机行业的标准自动驾驶仪栈，拥有超过 12k 的 star，持续活跃的社区和 Linux 基金会支持，使其在 GitHub 上保持热度。
uses: 无人机开发者：用于构建自定义飞行控制器和无人机应用
研究人员：用于无人机算法验证和仿真实验
教育机构：用于无人机课程教学和实验平台

zh.what: Kronos 是一个专为金融市场 K 线序列设计的解码器基础模型。它通过两阶段框架：先用量化器将 OHLCV 数据转为层次化离散 token，再用自回归 Transformer 预训练，统一处理多种量化任务。

en.stack: Built on PyTorch and Transformer architecture, with Hugging Face Transformers and custom tokenizer.
