zh.content: 仓库包含 Codex CLI 的 Rust 源码、跨平台编译构建脚本，以及支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 的预编译二进制发布。除终端版外，项目还指向 IDE 插件和云端 Codex Web 的入口。
zh.stack: 核心采用 Rust 开发，保证高性能与低资源占用；提供 curl、npm、Homebrew 等多种安装方式，支持通过 ChatGPT 账号或 OpenAI API 密钥进行身份验证。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方出品的终端编码工具，凭借 99.2k Stars 的超高人气和单日新增 328 Stars 的强劲势头，成功登顶 Rust 日榜第二。它将 AI 编程能力直接嵌入开发者最熟悉的终端环境，轻量且开源。
uses: 终端重度使用者 —— 希望在命令行中直接调用 AI 辅助编程的开发者
全栈工程师 —— 需要快速完成代码生成、重构与调试的敏捷开发场景
开源贡献者 —— 希望基于 Apache-2.0 协议研究或扩展 AI Agent 能力的工程师
ChatGPT 订阅用户 —— 想将现有 Plus/Pro/Edu 等计划权益延伸至本地开发环境

en.tag: OpenAI's official lightweight coding agent for your terminal
en.what: Codex CLI is a terminal-native AI coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your machine. It interprets natural language instructions to help write, refactor, and debug code without leaving your terminal. Users can authenticate via their ChatGPT plan or an OpenAI API key.
en.content: The repository contains the Rust source code for Codex CLI, cross-platform build scripts, and precompiled binaries for macOS, Linux, and Windows. It also points to IDE extensions and the cloud-based Codex Web agent.
en.stack: Core is built in Rust for high performance and low resource usage. It supports multiple installation methods including curl, npm, and Homebrew, and authenticates via ChatGPT accounts or OpenAI API keys.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI terminal coding tool, it commands massive attention with 99.2k Stars and 328 new Stars today, ranking second on the Rust daily trending list. It brings AI coding directly into the familiar terminal environment in a lightweight, open-source package.
uses: Terminal power users — developers who want AI assistance directly in their command line
Full-stack engineers — those needing rapid code generation, refactoring, and debugging
Open-source contributors — engineers looking to study or extend an Apache-2.0 AI agent
ChatGPT subscribers — users wanting to extend their Plus/Pro/Edu benefits to local development

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的极速 Python 包与项目管理器
zh.what: uv 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Python 包和项目管理工具，旨在替代 pip、pip-tools、pipx、poetry、pyenv 等多个工具。它提供比 pip 快 10-100 倍的性能，并支持项目依赖管理、脚本运行、Python 版本管理等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 uv 的 Rust 源码、文档、基准测试和安装脚本。主要组件包括命令行接口、依赖解析器、全局缓存和锁文件机制。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 crates.io 生态。可通过 curl 或 pip 安装，无需 Rust 或 Python 环境。
zh.hot: uv 凭借其惊人的速度和全面的功能迅速走红，已获得 88k+ star。本周新增 354 star，位列 Rust 周榜第 9，反映出开发者对高性能 Python 工具链的强烈需求。
uses: Python 开发者：替代 pip 和 poetry，加速依赖安装和项目管理
CI/CD 环境：利用其速度和缓存机制，减少构建时间
多版本 Python 管理：通过 uv 安装和管理不同 Python 版本
脚本运行：直接运行带内联依赖声明的 Python 脚本

en.tag: An extremely fast Python package and project manager written in Rust
en.what: uv is a Python package and project manager written in Rust, designed to replace pip, pip-tools, pipx, poetry, pyenv, and more. It is 10-100x faster than pip and offers comprehensive project management, script execution, and Python version management.
en.content: The repository contains uv's Rust source code, documentation, benchmarks, and installation scripts. Key components include a CLI, dependency resolver, global cache, and lockfile mechanism.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, leveraging the crates.io ecosystem. Installable via curl or pip without requiring Rust or Python.
en.hot: uv has gained massive popularity due to its incredible speed and comprehensive features, amassing 88k+ stars. With 354 new stars this week, ranking #9 on the Rust weekly trending list, it reflects developers' strong demand for high-performance Python tooling.
uses: Python developers: replace pip and poetry for faster dependency installation and project management
CI/CD environments: leverage speed and caching to reduce build times
Multi-version Python management: install and manage Python versions via uv
Script running: run Python scripts with inline dependency metadata

zh.tag: 多服务器部署与自动化管理平台
zh.what: Komodo 是一个用于在众多服务器上构建和部署软件的开源工具。它提供统一的界面来管理多台服务器，支持自动化部署、环境配置、同步更新等操作，并允许通过 API 进行扩展。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心应用代码、文档、截图以及部署脚本。界面支持浅色和深色主题，涵盖仪表盘、堆栈管理、Compose、环境变量、同步、更新、统计和导出等功能模块。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，可能使用现代 Web 框架构建前端，后端采用 Rust 生态。依赖包括 Docker 等容器技术，用于构建和部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 104 星，总星数达 11854，位列 Rust 周榜第 10。其无限服务器连接和 API 自动化的承诺吸引了寻求轻量级自托管部署方案的用户。
uses: 需要管理多台服务器的 DevOps 工程师或系统管理员
寻求自托管、开源部署工具的个人开发者或小团队
希望利用 API 实现自动化部署和运维的自动化爱好者
对 Rust 构建的现代基础设施工具感兴趣的技术人员

en.tag: Multi-server deployment and automation platform
en.what: Komodo is an open-source tool for building and deploying software across many servers. It provides a unified interface to manage multiple servers, supporting automated deployments, environment configuration, sync updates, and extensibility via APIs.
en.content: The repository contains core application code, documentation, screenshots, and deployment scripts. The UI supports light and dark themes, featuring modules for dashboard, stack management, Compose, environment variables, sync, updates, stats, and export.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, likely using modern web frameworks for the frontend and Rust ecosystem for the backend. Dependencies include container technologies like Docker for building and deploying.
en.hot: Gained 104 stars this week, reaching 11,854 total, ranking 10th on the Rust weekly trending. Its promise of unlimited server connections and API automation attracts users seeking lightweight self-hosted deployment solutions.
uses: DevOps engineers or sysadmins managing multiple servers
Individual developers or small teams seeking self-hosted, open-source deployment tools
Automation enthusiasts wanting to leverage APIs for automated deployment and ops
Tech professionals interested in modern infrastructure tools built with Rust

zh.tag: Rust 即时模式 GUI 库，跨 Web 与原生
zh.what: egui 是一个用 Rust 编写的简单、快速且高度可移植的即时模式 GUI 库。它可以在 Web、原生环境以及游戏引擎中运行，旨在成为最易用的 Rust GUI 库，也是用 Rust 制作 Web 应用的最简单方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 egui 库、官方框架 eframe（支持 Web、Linux、Mac、Windows 和 Android）、示例代码以及集成指南。
zh.stack: 纯 Rust 实现，无 unsafe 代码，依赖少，可集成到任何能绘制纹理三角形的环境中。
zh.hot: 凭借易用性和跨平台能力，在 Rust 社区广受欢迎，GitHub 星标近 3 万，本周新增 99，位列 Rust 周榜第 12。
uses: Rust 开发者快速构建 GUI 应用或 Web 应用
游戏引擎开发者集成调试工具或编辑器界面
需要轻量级、无依赖 GUI 的嵌入式或桌面项目

en.tag: Easy-to-use immediate mode GUI in Rust, runs on web and native
en.what: egui is a simple, fast, and highly portable immediate mode GUI library for Rust. It runs on the web, natively, and in game engines, aiming to be the easiest-to-use Rust GUI library and the simplest way to make a web app in Rust.
en.content: The repository contains the core egui library, the official eframe framework (supporting Web, Linux, Mac, Windows, and Android), examples, and integration guides.
en.stack: Pure Rust, no unsafe code, minimal dependencies, integrable into any environment that can draw textured triangles.
en.hot: Popular in the Rust community for its ease of use and cross-platform capabilities, with nearly 30k stars, 99 added this week, ranking #12 on the Rust weekly trending list.
uses: Rust developers quickly building GUI or web apps
Game engine developers integrating debug tools or editor UIs
Projects needing a lightweight, dependency-free GUI for embedded or desktop

zh.tag: 零配置的终端 IDE，强大快速且易用
zh.what: Fresh 是一款现代化的全功能终端文本编辑器，提供类似 VS Code 和 Sublime Text 的直观体验。它无需配置即可使用，支持熟悉的快捷键、鼠标操作和 IDE 级功能，没有学习曲线。
zh.content: 仓库包含编辑器源码、安装脚本、文档和演示 GIF。功能涵盖文件管理、多光标编辑、搜索替换、LSP 支持、命令面板、主题定制和多任务编排器。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖终端 UI 库和 LSP 客户端，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借零配置和 IDE 级体验，在终端编辑器中脱颖而出。本周新增 132 星，总星数达 8137，位列 Rust 周榜第 13 名。
uses: 喜欢在终端工作但需要 IDE 功能的开发者
需要处理超大文件且要求低延迟的用户
寻求零配置、开箱即用编辑器的初学者
希望在多任务工作流中高效切换的开发者

en.tag: Zero-config terminal IDE: powerful, fast, and easy to use
en.what: Fresh is a modern, full-featured terminal text editor that brings the intuitive UX of VS Code and Sublime Text to the terminal. It works with zero configuration, offering familiar keybindings, mouse support, and IDE-level features with no learning curve.
en.content: The repository contains the editor's source code, installation scripts, documentation, and demo GIFs. Features include file management, multi-cursor editing, search & replace, LSP support, command palette, theme customization, and an orchestrator for multitasking.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries and LSP client, cross-platform support.
en.hot: Standing out among terminal editors with zero-config and IDE-level experience. Gained 132 stars this week, total 8137, ranking 13th on Rust weekly trending.
uses: Developers who love the terminal but need IDE features
Users who need to handle huge files with low latency
Beginners seeking a zero-config, out-of-the-box editor
Developers who want efficient multitasking workflows

zh.tag: MCP 官方 Rust SDK，异步运行时实现
zh.what: 这是 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的官方 Rust SDK，提供核心协议实现和过程宏工具。它支持最新 MCP 规范，并兼容旧版本，用于构建 AI 代理与工具之间的标准化通信。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个 crate：rmcp（核心协议实现）和 rmcp-macros（用于生成工具实现的过程宏）。文档涵盖工具、资源、提示、采样、通知、订阅、缓存、HTTP 传输等丰富功能。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 tokio 异步运行时，依赖 serde 进行序列化，使用 schemars 生成 JSON Schema。
zh.hot: 作为 MCP 官方 SDK，它紧跟最新协议规范，吸引大量 Rust 开发者。本周新增 53 星，总星数 3764，位列 Rust 周榜第 14。
uses: Rust 开发者构建 MCP 服务器或客户端
需要与 AI 工具集成的应用开发者
希望使用 Rust 高性能特性的 MCP 实现者

en.tag: Official Rust SDK for Model Context Protocol with async runtime
en.what: This is the official Rust SDK for the Model Context Protocol, providing core protocol implementation and procedural macros. It supports the latest MCP spec while maintaining compatibility with older versions, enabling standardized communication between AI agents and tools.
en.content: The repository contains two crates: rmcp (core protocol implementation) and rmcp-macros (procedural macros for tool implementations). Documentation covers tools, resources, prompts, sampling, notifications, subscriptions, caching, HTTP transports, and more.
en.stack: Built on Rust with tokio async runtime, uses serde for serialization and schemars for JSON Schema generation.
en.hot: As the official MCP SDK, it closely follows the latest protocol spec, attracting many Rust developers. Gaining 53 stars this week, total 3764, ranking 14th on Rust weekly trending.
uses: Rust developers building MCP servers or clients
App developers needing integration with AI tools
MCP implementers leveraging Rust's high performance

zh.tag: Rust 异步运行时，构建可靠、高性能异步应用
zh.what: Tokio 是一个事件驱动、非阻塞 I/O 的异步运行时，用于编写可靠、异步、精简的 Rust 应用。它提供多线程工作窃取调度器、基于操作系统事件队列的 reactor，以及异步 TCP/UDP 套接字等核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含运行时核心库、调度器、reactor、网络模块、定时器等，以及丰富的示例和文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖操作系统事件队列（epoll、kqueue、IOCP 等），提供异步 I/O 和并发原语。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中最流行的异步运行时，Tokio 凭借零成本抽象和高性能，成为构建网络服务的基石，持续获得大量关注。
uses: Rust 开发者构建高性能网络服务（如 Web 服务器、代理、数据库客户端）
需要异步 I/O 和并发处理的应用，如聊天系统、实时数据处理
学习 Rust 异步编程和运行时原理的开发者

en.tag: Rust async runtime for building reliable, high-performance async apps
en.what: Tokio is an event-driven, non-blocking I/O runtime for writing reliable, asynchronous, and slim applications in Rust. It provides a multithreaded work-stealing scheduler, a reactor backed by OS event queues, and async TCP/UDP sockets.
en.content: The repo contains the runtime core library, scheduler, reactor, networking modules, timers, and extensive examples and documentation.
en.stack: Written in Rust, leverages OS event queues (epoll, kqueue, IOCP), provides async I/O and concurrency primitives.
en.hot: As the most popular async runtime in the Rust ecosystem, Tokio's zero-cost abstractions and high performance make it a cornerstone for building network services, consistently attracting significant attention.
uses: Rust developers building high-performance network services (web servers, proxies, database clients)
Applications needing async I/O and concurrency, like chat systems, real-time data processing
Developers learning Rust async programming and runtime internals

zh.tag: 用 Rust 构建的高性能并行浏览器引擎
zh.what: Servo 是一个用 Rust 语言编写的原型 web 浏览器引擎，旨在为开发者提供轻量级、高性能的嵌入式 Web 技术替代方案。它支持多平台（macOS、Linux、Windows、OpenHarmony、Android），并利用并行架构提升渲染效率。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器引擎实现，包括布局、渲染、CSS 解析、JavaScript 引擎集成等模块，以及构建脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 Cargo 构建系统，支持通过 mach 工具链进行跨平台编译。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 生态中标志性的浏览器引擎项目，Servo 持续吸引关注，本月新增 347 星，位列 Rust 月榜第 23 名，体现了开发者对高性能、安全浏览器技术的兴趣。
uses: 浏览器引擎开发者 —— 研究并行渲染和 Rust 在浏览器中的应用
嵌入式 Web 技术用户 —— 在应用中集成轻量级浏览器引擎
Rust 爱好者 —— 学习大型 Rust 项目架构与性能优化

en.tag: A high-performance parallel browser engine written in Rust
en.what: Servo is a prototype web browser engine written in Rust, aiming to provide developers with a lightweight, high-performance alternative for embedding web technologies. It supports multiple platforms (macOS, Linux, Windows, OpenHarmony, Android) and leverages a parallel architecture for efficient rendering.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser engine implementation, including layout, rendering, CSS parsing, JavaScript engine integration, along with build scripts and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, uses Cargo build system, and supports cross-platform compilation via the mach toolchain.
en.hot: As a landmark browser engine project in the Rust ecosystem, Servo continues to attract attention, gaining 347 stars this month and ranking 23rd on the Rust monthly list, reflecting developer interest in high-performance, safe browser technology.
uses: Browser engine developers — researching parallel rendering and Rust in browsers
Embedded web technology users — integrating a lightweight browser engine into applications
Rust enthusiasts — learning large-scale Rust project architecture and performance optimization

zh.tag: 开源可扩展的离线语音转录桌面工具
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台的桌面语音转文字应用，主打完全离线、隐私优先的转录体验。用户只需按下可配置的快捷键说话，即可将语音实时转换为文本并自动输入到任意文本框中。所有音频处理均在本地完成，无需联网或上传云端。
zh.content: 仓库包含跨平台桌面客户端源码、基于 Rust 的本地音频处理管线，以及集成 Whisper 和 Parakeet V3 的离线转录引擎，同时提供了 Raycast 插件等扩展集成。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，使用 Silero VAD 进行语音活动检测，支持 Whisper（Small/Medium/Turbo/Large）和 Parakeet V3 本地模型，并可在 GPU 加速下运行。
zh.hot: 在隐私焦虑与云服务费高涨的背景下，Handy 以「完全开源、完全离线」的差异化定位迅速获得开发者关注，本月新增近 3,000 Star，累计突破 2.6 万，登榜 GitHub Rust 月榜第 17 名。
uses: 隐私敏感用户 —— 需要在本地完成语音输入、拒绝云端上传的写作者与专业人士。
开发者与极客 —— 希望 Fork 并二次扩展自定义模型或工作流的技术用户。
跨平台办公场景 —— 在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上追求高效语音转文字输入的远程工作者。
可访问性需求者 —— 需要无障碍语音输入工具但不愿付费订阅的辅助功能使用者。

en.tag: Free, open-source & extensible offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app that transcribes your voice entirely offline with a privacy-first approach. Press a configurable shortcut, speak, and it pastes the transcribed text directly into any text field. All audio processing happens locally on your machine, with no data sent to the cloud.
en.content: The repository houses the cross-platform desktop client source, a Rust-based local audio pipeline, and an offline transcription engine integrating Whisper and Parakeet V3 models, plus integrations like a Raycast extension.
en.stack: Built in Rust, it uses Silero VAD for voice-activity detection and supports local Whisper (Small/Medium/Turbo/Large) and Parakeet V3 models with optional GPU acceleration.
en.hot: Amid rising privacy concerns and cloud-service costs, Handy's 'fully open-source and fully offline' positioning has resonated strongly with developers, adding nearly 3,000 stars this month to reach 26.7K+ and ranking 17th on GitHub's Rust monthly trending list.
uses: Privacy-conscious users — writers and professionals who need local voice input without cloud uploads.
Developers & tinkers — technical users who want to fork and extend custom models or workflows.
Cross-platform workers — remote workers on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking efficient offline dictation.
Accessibility seekers — users needing assistive voice-input tools without paid subscriptions.

zh.tag: Rust 官方包管理器，构建与依赖管理
zh.what: Cargo 是 Rust 的官方包管理器，负责下载项目依赖并编译项目。它简化了依赖管理、构建和发布流程，是 Rust 生态的核心工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Cargo 的源代码，包括命令行工具、库 crate、文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，依赖 C 编译器、git、OpenSSL 等，可选系统库包括 libcurl、libgit2 等。
zh.hot: 作为 Rust 官方工具，长期占据趋势榜，本周新增 54 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Rust 开发者日常构建和管理项目依赖
学习 Rust 工具链和包管理机制
贡献者参与 Cargo 的开发与维护

en.tag: Official Rust package manager for building and managing dependencies
en.what: Cargo is the official package manager for Rust, responsible for downloading project dependencies and compiling the project. It simplifies dependency management, building, and publishing, serving as a core tool in the Rust ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of Cargo, including the command-line tool, library crates, documentation, and contributor guides.
en.stack: Written in Rust, requires a C compiler, git, OpenSSL, and optionally uses system libraries like libcurl and libgit2.
en.hot: As the official Rust tool, it consistently ranks on trending lists, gaining 54 stars this week and maintaining developer interest.

Learners studying the Rust toolchain and package management
Contributors participating in Cargo's development and maintenance

zh.tag: 阿里巴巴开源的企业级AI代码审查CLI工具
zh.what: OpenCodeReview 是一款基于 AI 的代码审查 CLI 工具，起源于阿里巴巴集团内部，经过两年大规模验证，为数万开发者服务并发现数百万代码缺陷。它读取 Git diff，通过具备工具调用能力的 Agent 将变更文件发送给可配置的 LLM，生成精确到行的结构化审查评论。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具源码、内置精细调优的规则集（NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL注入等）、支持 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 兼容接口，以及多语言文档和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Git 和 LLM API（OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容），支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 作为阿里巴巴内部大规模验证的代码审查工具开源，结合确定性流水线和 LLM Agent 的混合架构，精准行级评论和内置规则集吸引了大量开发者，今日新增 162 星，总星数 10964。
uses: 开发团队 —— 集成到 CI/CD 流水线，自动审查代码提交，提升代码质量
个人开发者 —— 在本地运行审查，快速发现潜在缺陷和安全漏洞
开源维护者 —— 用于管理 PR 审查，减少人工负担

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested AI code review CLI with deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent
en.what: OpenCodeReview is an AI-powered code review CLI tool originating from Alibaba Group's internal system, serving tens of thousands of developers and identifying millions of code defects over two years. zh.what: Bitchat 是一款去中心化、点对点的即时通讯应用，支持蓝牙 Mesh 网络（离线）和 Nostr 协议（互联网）双传输架构。无需账户、手机号或中央服务器，注重隐私与抗审查。

zh.stack: 使用 Swift 开发，依赖 Bluetooth LE（CoreBluetooth）和 Nostr 协议栈，集成 Noise Protocol 加密、LZ4 压缩、Geohash 地理编码。

en.tag: Decentralized messaging with Bluetooth mesh & Nostr
en.what: Bitchat is a decentralized peer-to-peer messaging app with dual transport: Bluetooth mesh for offline and Nostr for internet. No accounts, phone numbers, or central servers; privacy-first and censorship-resistant.
en.content: Full source code for iOS/macOS native app with Bluetooth mesh multi-hop relay, Nostr global relays, location-based channels, IRC-style commands, end-to-end encryption (Noise + NIP-17), and emergency wipe.
en.stack: Built with Swift, leveraging Bluetooth LE (CoreBluetooth) and Nostr protocol stack, with Noise Protocol encryption, LZ4 compression, and Geohash geocoding.
en.hot: Its decentralized, serverless, offline-capable design resonates with privacy and censorship concerns, gaining 1720 stars in 24h and 28722 total.

Offline/disaster scenarios — Bluetooth mesh works without internet
Protests or censorship — decentralized architecture resists blocking
Tech enthusiasts — IRC-style commands and open-source code

希望统一调度自有 AI 订阅工具的高级用户——将 Codex、Claude Code 等集中在一套桌面环境中管理

en.tag: Parallel AI coding agent orchestrator for desktop and mobile

Teams needing on-the-go oversight—monitor and steer agents from the mobile companion app anywhere
Power users with multiple AI subscriptions—unify Codex, Claude Code, and others under one desktop orchestrator
Engineers prioritizing code safety—each agent operates in its own git worktree to avoid polluting the main branch

en.tag: AI skill pack for design engineers to level up UI animation taste

Frontend developers — learn animation best practices and design principles

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货

zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates

en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 在聊天里一键生成可交互系统架构图

架构师在代码审查前对比不同版本的架构差异

en.tag: Turn codebases into interactive system maps right in chat
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that lets AI coding assistants (like Cursor, Claude Code) generate polished, interactive technical maps directly in chat from a codebase or system description. en.stack: Built on HTML/JavaScript, generates diagrams via typed JSON IR and deterministic checks; installable via npx, compatible with multiple AI agents.
en.hot: With 7,074 new stars this month and nearly 10k total, developers clearly need intuitive architecture visualization in AI workflows, and Archify delivers an out-of-the-box solution.
uses: Developers using AI assistants to quickly understand unfamiliar codebases
Architects comparing architecture changes before code review
Technical writers creating shareable interactive system docs
Teams presenting or training with visual system maps

zh.tag: 让 AI 一键操控 Office 文档的开源命令行套件

en.tag: Open-source CLI suite that gives AI agents full control over Office documents
en.what: OfficeCLI is an open-source Office suite purpose-built for AI agents, enabling them to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files through a single command. It runs as a single binary without requiring any Microsoft Office installation or dependencies.

en.stack: Built primarily in C# and distributed as a single, self-contained binary with zero external dependencies and no Microsoft Office installation required. It includes a custom-built HTML rendering engine that converts Office documents into HTML or PNG for AI visual feedback loops.
en.hot: As the world's first Office suite built specifically for AI agents, it directly addresses the urgent need for automated document processing in the Agent era. Its 'one-line command, zero Office install' experience fueled a surge of 4,611 stars this week, bringing the total to nearly 19,000 and landing it at #10 on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers who need to equip agents with the ability to read and write Office documents
Automation workflows that batch-generate reports, presentations, and spreadsheets with minimal setup
RAG and enterprise knowledge-base builders requiring high-fidelity parsing of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files
Cross-platform DevOps users who need to process Office files on Linux or servers without Microsoft Office installed

zh.tag: 为 Claude 等 AI 提供终端控制、文件搜索与 diff 编辑的 MCP 服务器

Automation-minded users seeking a unified chat interface for code search, editing, and process management

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理打造的设计语言与技能集，终结千篇一律的 SaaS 模板风

独立创始人/产品经理 —— 需要快速建立品牌感强、视觉一致的产品界面
设计工程师 —— 想将设计规范转化为 AI 可执行的确定性规则与检测流程

en.tag: A design language and skillset for AI coding agents to escape generic SaaS templates

zh.tag: 让Claude具备看视频能力的Agent插件，一键解析任意视频
zh.what: 它通过 /watch 命令为 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 助手赋予“观看”视频的能力。用户粘贴任意视频链接或本地路径后，它会自动下载、提取关键帧、获取时间戳字幕，并将视觉和音频信息完整交给 Claude 理解。最终让 AI 真正“看到”画面并“听到”内容，而非仅靠标题猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 Python 的 /watch 插件核心源码，以及面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Copilot、Gemini CLI 等 50 余种 Agent Skills 平台的安装配置与文档。整体以命令行插件形态交付，采用零配置设计，首次运行时自动引导安装 yt-dlp 与 ffmpeg。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 构建，使用 yt-dlp 负责视频下载，ffmpeg 处理帧提取与音视频分离，优先调用免费字幕接口，无字幕时回退至 OpenAI Whisper API。通过标准化插件协议与 Claude Code 等 Agent 环境集成。
zh.hot: 在 8992 颗 Star 的基础上本周再增 1876，跻身 GitHub Python 周榜第 15 名。它精准解决了 AI Agent 无法感知视频这一痛点，以零配置、多平台兼容和“真正看懂视频”的体验迅速获得开发者青睐。
uses: 内容创作者与营销人员：快速拆解竞品视频结构、分析热门视频开场钩子与广告创意
开发者与测试工程师：通过录屏诊断 Bug，让 AI 直接定位问题帧并分析故障原因

en.tag: Agent plugin that gives Claude eyes: downloads, frames & transcribes any video
en.what: It gives Claude and other AI agents the ability to "watch" videos via a simple /watch command. The tool downloads the video, extracts scene-aware frames, pulls timestamped transcripts (free captions first, Whisper as fallback), and feeds everything to the AI. This lets Claude actually see what's on screen and hear the audio instead of guessing from titles or partial transcripts.
en.content: The repo contains the Python core of the /watch plugin, plus installation configs and docs for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI and over 50 Agent Skills hosts. It ships as a CLI plugin with zero-config setup, automatically installing yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first run.
en.stack: Built in Python, it relies on yt-dlp for video fetching, ffmpeg for frame extraction and audio demuxing, and falls back to the OpenAI Whisper API when free captions are unavailable. It integrates with agent environments via plugin protocols.
en.hot: With 8,992 stars and 1,876 added this week alone, it hit #15 on GitHub's Python Trending list. It solves the critical gap of AI agents being unable to perceive video, winning developers over with zero-config setup, multi-platform support, and a true "see-and-hear" experience.
uses: Content creators & marketers: analyze competitor video structures, viral hooks, and ad creatives
Developers & QA engineers: diagnose bugs from screen recordings by having the AI pinpoint issue frames
Learners & researchers: turn long videos or course playlists into searchable, timestamped notes
Product managers & analysts: strip hype from launch videos and extract substantive feature updates

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 流式3D重建的几何上下文Transformer基础模型
zh.what: LingBot-Map 是一个前馈式 3D 基础模型，能够从流式数据中实时重建三维场景。它通过几何上下文 Transformer 架构，在单一流式框架内统一了坐标定位、密集几何线索编码与长程漂移校正。
zh.content: 仓库提供交互式演示脚本 demo.py、离线批量渲染管线，以及 KITTI 和 Oxford Spires 评估基准；预训练模型权重已同步发布在 HuggingFace 与 ModelScope。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 与 PyTorch 构建，核心采用 Transformer 架构，支持 SDPA 与 FlashInfer 双后端以加速超长序列的流式推理。
zh.hot: 该模型可在 518×378 分辨率下以约 20 FPS 稳定处理超 10,000 帧的长序列，月增 4,765 Star，总星数突破 12,000，跻身 GitHub Python 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 自动驾驶与机器人感知 —— 需要实时从连续视频流构建大规模 3D 场景地图。
AR/VR 内容生成 —— 为沉浸式应用提供高效的长序列几何重建与离线渲染能力。
计算机视觉研究者 —— 探索流式 3D 基础模型、几何 Transformer 与长程漂移校正的前沿方向。

en.tag: Geometric Context Transformer for real-time streaming 3D reconstruction
en.what: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model that reconstructs scenes from streaming data in real time. It unifies coordinate grounding, dense geometric cues, and long-range drift correction within a single streaming framework via its Geometric Context Transformer architecture.
en.content: The repo ships an interactive demo script (`demo.py`), an offline rendering pipeline, and evaluation benchmarks for KITTI and Oxford Spires, with pretrained weights hosted on both HuggingFace and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built in Python on PyTorch with a Transformer core, supporting both SDPA and FlashInfer backends to accelerate inference over extremely long sequences.
en.hot: Delivering stable ~20 FPS inference at 518×378 across sequences exceeding 10,000 frames, the project gained 4,765 stars this month, surpassing 12,000 total and hitting #18 on GitHub’s monthly Python Trending list.
uses: Autonomous driving & robotics teams — for real-time large-scale 3D mapping from continuous video streams.

uses: Frontend developers — quickly build consistent, accessible React UIs
Design system teams — reference Meta's internal best practices or customize themes directly
AI agent developers — leverage the same API and docs for AI-generated UI components

zh.tag: AI 智能体工具链：统一 LLM API、代理循环、TUI 与编程代理 CLI
zh.what: 提供模块化 AI 代理开发框架，整合多厂商 LLM API、代理运行时与终端交互界面。内置可自扩展的编程代理 CLI，支持工具调用、状态管理与交互式编码任务。
zh.content: 仓库采用 monorepo 结构，包含 pi-ai（统一 LLM 接口）、pi-agent-core（代理运行时）、pi-coding-agent（交互式编码 CLI）和 pi-tui（差分渲染终端 UI）四个核心包。README 还提供了容器化与沙箱隔离方案，以及面向人类和代理的协作规范。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 npm 管理 monorepo 依赖与生命周期脚本。支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等主流 LLM 提供商，并可通过 Docker 或 Gondolin micro-VM 进行容器化隔离。

uses: 需要构建多模型 AI 代理的开发者——统一接口降低集成成本
追求终端原生体验的 CLI 用户——内置 TUI 与差分渲染提升交互效率
关注代码安全隔离的团队——提供 Docker、micro-VM 等多种沙箱方案
希望人机与 AI 代理协作的项目维护者——贡献指南同时面向人类与 Agent

en.tag: AI agent toolkit with unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI and coding agent CLI
en.what: A modular AI agent development framework that unifies multi-provider LLM APIs, agent runtime, and terminal UI. It features a self-extensible coding agent CLI with tool calling, state management, and interactive coding capabilities.
en.content: The monorepo houses four core packages: pi-ai (unified LLM API), pi-agent-core (agent runtime), pi-coding-agent (interactive CLI), and pi-tui (diff-rendered terminal UI). It also includes containerization guides and contribution rules for both humans and agents.
en.stack: Built on TypeScript with npm-based monorepo tooling and lifecycle scripts. Supports major LLM providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google) and offers containerization via Docker or Gondolin micro-VM.
en.hot: It gained 2,741 stars this week, landing at #17 on GitHub's TypeScript Weekly Trending with over 72.2k total stars. The combination of a unified LLM API and a self-extensible coding agent has drawn strong developer interest.
uses: Developers building multi-model AI agents — unified API reduces integration overhead
CLI users preferring terminal-native experiences — built-in TUI with diff rendering
Teams requiring secure isolation — supports Docker, micro-VM, and sandbox patterns
Project maintainers enabling human and AI co-contribution — guidelines cover both humans and agents

zh.tag: 本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集克隆、合成与听写于一体
zh.what: Voicebox 是一款本地优先的开源 AI 语音工作室，集语音克隆、文本转语音与实时语音输入于一体。它能够在本地运行 7 种 TTS 引擎，支持 23 种语言的语音合成，并通过全局热键向任意文本框听写。此外，它还能为 MCP 兼容的 AI 智能体赋予自定义语音，实现完整的语音输入输出闭环。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 TypeScript 的桌面应用源码、7 套 TTS 引擎的本地集成、语音克隆与听写核心模块，以及配套落地页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 主技术栈为 TypeScript，构建跨平台桌面应用；依赖本地运行的 LLM 进行语音文本优化，并集成 7 种 TTS 引擎与语音克隆模型实现完整语音 I/O。
zh.hot: 在 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 等云端方案之外，Voicebox 以完全本地运行和隐私保护击中用户痛点，月增 12,138 Star 达 42,229 颗，跻身 TypeScript 月榜第 8。它一次性覆盖语音克隆、合成与听写全链路，降低了创作者与开发者对闭源语音服务的依赖。
uses: 内容创作者 —— 快速克隆音色并生成多语言旁白，无需依赖云端付费 API。
隐私敏感用户 —— 语音数据完全本地处理，适合对数据安全有较高要求的个人与企业。
AI 开发者 —— 为 MCP 智能体快速接入自定义语音，构建具备语音交互能力的本地应用。
效率办公人群 —— 通过全局热键向任意文本框实时语音输入，替代传统键盘录入。

en.tag: Local-first open-source AI voice studio for cloning, synthesis and dictation
en.what: Voicebox is a local-first, open-source AI voice studio that combines voice cloning, text-to-speech, and real-time dictation in one app. It runs seven TTS engines locally for speech synthesis across 23 languages, and lets you dictate into any text field via a global hotkey. It also gives MCP-aware AI agents a custom voice, closing the full voice I/O loop on your machine.
en.content: The repository contains the TypeScript-based desktop application source, integrations for seven local TTS engines, voice-cloning and dictation modules, plus a landing site and documentation.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript as a cross-platform desktop app; it relies on a bundled local LLM for speech refinement and integrates seven TTS engines plus voice-cloning models for complete on-device voice I/O.
en.hot: Hitting a pain point against cloud incumbents like ElevenLabs and WisprFlow, Voicebox offers fully local, privacy-preserving voice I/O; it gained 12,138 stars this month to reach 42,229, ranking 8th on the TypeScript monthly trending list. Its all-in-one coverage of cloning, synthesis, and dictation lowers reliance on proprietary voice services for creators and developers.
uses: Content creators — quickly clone voices and generate multilingual narrations without cloud APIs.
Privacy-conscious users — process all voice data locally for individuals and enterprises with strict data-security needs.
AI developers — give MCP-compatible agents custom voices to build locally running voice-interactive applications.
Productivity-focused users — dictate into any text field via a global hotkey as a keyboard alternative.

zh.tag: 终端AI编码代理，开箱即用支持视频输入与子代理
zh.what: Kimi Code CLI 是一个运行在终端中的 AI 编码代理，能够读取和编辑代码、执行 shell 命令、搜索文件、抓取网页，并根据反馈自主决策下一步操作。它默认使用月之暗面的 Kimi 模型，也支持配置其他兼容的模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Kimi Code CLI 的完整源代码、安装脚本、文档和示例。CLI 采用单二进制分发，无需 Node.js 环境，通过一条命令即可安装。

zh.hot: 本周新增 1400+ Star，GitHub 周榜第 4。作为月之暗面推出的 AI 编码代理，其视频输入、子代理并行工作等创新功能吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中使用 AI 辅助编码、调试和项目理解
团队 —— 通过子代理并行处理多个任务，提升开发效率
AI 爱好者 —— 探索视频输入、MCP 配置等前沿 AI 代理功能

en.tag: Terminal AI coding agent with video input and subagents out of the box
en.what: Kimi Code CLI is an AI coding agent that runs in your terminal, capable of reading and editing code, running shell commands, searching files, fetching web pages, and autonomously deciding next steps based on feedback. It works out of the box with Moonshot AI's Kimi models and can be configured to use other compatible providers.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, installation scripts, documentation, and examples for Kimi Code CLI. The CLI is distributed as a single binary, requiring no Node.js setup, and can be installed with a single command.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on Kimi models or compatible APIs, terminal UI based on TUI framework, supports MCP protocol and plugin ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 1400+ stars this week, ranking 4th on GitHub weekly trending. As Moonshot AI's AI coding agent, its innovative features like video input and parallel subagents have attracted significant developer attention.
uses: Developers — use AI to assist coding, debugging, and project understanding in the terminal
Teams — leverage subagents for parallel task processing to boost development efficiency
AI enthusiasts — explore cutting-edge AI agent features like video input and MCP configuration

zh.tag: Google 官方 Agent Skills 库，打通 Claude/Cursor/Codex 多代理生态
zh.what: Stitch Skills 是一个面向 Google Stitch 平台的 Agent Skills 库，遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准，兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等主流编码代理。它通过 Stitch MCP 服务器为 AI 代理提供设计、构建与工具类能力，让开发者能在多代理环境中复用同一套技能。
zh.content: 仓库按插件维度组织，包含 stitch-design、stitch-build、stitch-utilities 三大插件集，以及 .agents/plugins 等配置目录，支持通过 Codex、Claude Code 或 Cursor 按需安装。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主语言，基于 MCP（Model Context Protocol）协议与 Stitch MCP 服务器通信，并遵循 Agent Skills 开放标准接入各编码代理。
zh.hot: 仓库已获 7.6k Star，本周新增 1,076 颗跃居 GitHub Trending 周榜第 3，背后是 Google 官方背书与「一套技能多代理复用」的开放标准吸引力。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 的开发者，想要扩展 AI 代理的设计与构建能力
需要在 Google Stitch 平台内管理设计系统、组件库的工程团队
希望基于 Agent Skills 开放标准构建跨代理兼容插件的 AI 基础设施开发者
追求「安装即用」插件化工作流，减少多代理环境配置成本的技术团队

en.tag: Google's official Agent Skills library bridging Claude, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI
en.what: Stitch Skills is an Agent Skills library for the Google Stitch platform that follows the open Agent Skills standard, compatible with leading coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It exposes design, build, and utility capabilities to AI agents via the Stitch MCP server, enabling reusable skills across multi-agent workflows.
en.content: The repository is organized into plugin suites including stitch-design, stitch-build, and stitch-utilities, alongside .agents/plugins configurations, supporting selective installation via Codex, Claude Code, or Cursor.
en.stack: Built primarily in TypeScript, it communicates via the MCP (Model Context Protocol) with the Stitch MCP server and conforms to the open Agent Skills standard for agent integration.
en.hot: With 7,637 stars and 1,076 new ones this week to rank #3 on GitHub Trending, it draws attention from Google's official backing and the promise of one skill set reusable across multiple agents.
uses: Developers using Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex looking to extend agents with design and build capabilities
Engineering teams managing design systems and component libraries within the Google Stitch platform
AI infrastructure developers building cross-agent compatible plugins based on the open Agent Skills standard
Technical teams seeking plug-and-play workflows to reduce setup overhead across multi-agent environments

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers

Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

自动化脚本：需要访问仓库文件的工作流
学习 GitHub Actions：参考官方动作的最佳实践

en.tag: Official GitHub Action to check out a repository
en.what: actions/checkout is the official GitHub Action to check out a repository into the workspace for workflows. By default, it fetches only a single commit for the triggering ref/SHA, with fetch-depth controlling history depth.
en.content: The repository contains the action's source code, documentation, and releases, implemented in TypeScript, with inputs like repository, ref, token, fetch-depth, etc.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and the GitHub Actions toolkit (@actions/*), running on Node.js, migrated to ESM modules.
en.hot: As one of the most fundamental GitHub Actions, used in nearly every workflow, it gained 435 stars this month, maintaining high popularity.
uses: CI/CD pipelines: check out code before build, test, deploy
Automation scripts: workflows needing repository files
Learning GitHub Actions: reference official action best practices

全栈开发者 —— 在 Next.js、Vite 等框架中集成使用

Full-stack developers — integrate with frameworks like Next.js, Vite, etc.

zh.tag: 代码驱动、实时更新的软件架构可视化工具
zh.what: LikeC4 是一种建模语言和工具集，用于从代码描述生成软件架构图。它受 C4 模型启发，但允许自定义符号、元素类型和嵌套层级，使架构图始终与实际代码同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LikeC4 语言规范、CLI 工具、VS Code 扩展以及示例模板。核心是 `likec4` 包，提供 `start` 命令启动本地预览服务器，并支持导出为静态站点。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时。前端使用 React 渲染交互式图表，支持 VS Code 和 Open VSX 扩展。
zh.hot: 今日新增 58 星，总星数 4019，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 12。开发者对“代码即架构”的自动化、可视化需求强烈，LikeC4 提供了比传统 UML 更灵活、更现代的替代方案。
uses: 软件架构师 —— 用代码定义并维护系统架构图，确保文档与实现一致
开发团队 —— 在 CI/CD 中自动生成架构图，用于代码审查和文档
技术写作者 —— 为开源项目或内部系统创建可交互的架构文档

en.tag: Code-driven, always up-to-date software architecture visualization
en.what: LikeC4 is a modeling language and toolset that generates software architecture diagrams from code descriptions. Inspired by the C4 model, it allows custom notation, element types, and nested levels, keeping diagrams always in sync with the actual code.
en.content: The repository includes the LikeC4 language specification, CLI tool, VS Code extension, and example templates. The core `likec4` package provides a `start` command to launch a local preview server and supports exporting to static sites.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, runs on Node.js. The frontend uses React for interactive diagram rendering, with extensions for VS Code and Open VSX.
en.hot: Gained 58 stars today, total 4019, ranked #12 on TypeScript daily trending. Developers have a strong demand for automated, code-driven architecture visualization, and LikeC4 offers a more flexible, modern alternative to traditional UML.
uses: Software architects — define and maintain system architecture diagrams in code, ensuring docs match implementation
Development teams — auto-generate architecture diagrams in CI/CD for code reviews and documentation
Technical writers — create interactive architecture docs for open-source or internal systems

zh.tag: 下一代 TypeScript ORM，面向 AI Agent 友好

从 Prisma ORM 迁移到新版本的用户，或新项目脚手架搭建者

Users migrating from Prisma ORM to the new version, or those scaffolding new projects

en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript and Go, with a React-based frontend and Go backend. Dependencies include various data source plugins and visualization libraries.

Data analysts and developers for creating interactive dashboards
Enterprises needing unified monitoring of metrics, logs, and traces

zh.tag: Claude Code 的 OpenAI Codex 插件，实现代码审查与任务委托
zh.what: 这是 OpenAI 官方为 Claude Code 开发的插件，让开发者无需离开终端环境即可调用 Codex 进行代码审查或任务委托。用户可通过斜杠命令执行只读评审、对抗性压力测试，或将编码任务后台交给 Codex 代理处理。
zh.content: 仓库包含插件源码、Claude Code 市场清单配置，以及内置的 /codex:* 斜杠命令和 codex-rescue 子代理。同时提供完整安装文档与演示视频，支持通过 npm 安装 Codex CLI 并自动处理登录与会话交接。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 18.18+ 构建，作为 Claude Code 插件运行，需 OpenAI Codex CLI 及 ChatGPT 订阅或 OpenAI API Key。通过 Claude Code 插件市场分发，并使用 npm 管理 Codex 全局安装。
zh.hot: 凭借 OpenAI 官方背书与 Claude Code 的庞大用户基础，该插件本周新增 1801 Star，以近 3 万总星标数冲入 GitHub 周榜第 12 名。它精准击中了开发者希望在同一终端内无缝切换 Claude 与 Codex 两大 AI 工作流的痛点。
uses: Claude Code 忠实用户 —— 希望在熟悉的终端工作流中直接复用 Codex 的审查与代理能力。
追求代码质量的团队 —— 需要对多文件变更进行常规审查或对抗性压力测试，发现潜在设计缺陷。
高频使用 AI 辅助编程的开发者 —— 想将耗时任务后台委托给 Codex，通过异步状态查询和结果拉取保持专注。
多 AI 工具链整合者 —— 试图打通 Anthropic 与 OpenAI 生态，构建统一的命令行 AI 开发环境。

en.tag: Claude Code plugin integrating OpenAI Codex for code review and task delegation
en.what: An official OpenAI plugin that embeds Codex capabilities directly into Claude Code, letting developers review and delegate coding tasks without leaving their terminal. It exposes slash commands for read-only reviews, adversarial pressure-testing, and background task delegation to Codex agents.
en.content: The repo hosts the plugin source, Claude Code marketplace manifest, and built-in slash commands such as /codex:review plus the codex-rescue subagent. It also includes comprehensive installation docs and a demo video, supporting npm-based Codex CLI setup and automated session hand-off.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript for Node.js 18.18+, it runs as a Claude Code plugin and requires the OpenAI Codex CLI along with a ChatGPT subscription or OpenAI API key. It is distributed via the Claude Code plugin marketplace and uses npm for global Codex CLI installation.
en.hot: Backed by OpenAI and Claude Code's large user base, the plugin gained 1,801 stars this week and reached #12 on GitHub Trending with nearly 29k total stars. It directly addresses developer demand for seamlessly switching between Claude and Codex within a single terminal workflow.
uses: Claude Code power users who want to leverage Codex review and agent capabilities inside their existing terminal workflow.
Teams focused on code quality looking to run standard or adversarial reviews on multi-file changes to uncover design flaws.
Developers heavily using AI-assisted coding who want to delegate long-running tasks to Codex in the background and check results asynchronously.
Multi-AI toolchain integrators aiming to bridge Anthropic and OpenAI ecosystems within a unified CLI environment.

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的CAD与机器人设计技能库
zh.what: Text-to-CAD 是一个为AI代理提供CAD、机器人和硬件设计技能的库。它允许代理通过自然语言或图像生成、编辑CAD模型，并导出为STEP、STL、3MF等格式，同时支持机器人描述文件（URDF、SDF、SRDF）的生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个技能模块：CAD建模、CAD预览、标准件查找、切片、机器人描述文件生成等，每个技能都有独立的文档和实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python 3.11+，依赖CAD内核（如CadQuery）和机器人描述库，前端预览基于Web浏览器。
zh.hot: 将大语言模型与CAD/机器人设计结合，极大降低了硬件设计门槛，今日新增297星，总星数8649，登顶JavaScript日榜。
uses: AI代理开发者：为代理集成CAD和机器人设计能力
硬件工程师：通过自然语言快速生成3D模型
机器人爱好者：自动生成URDF等机器人描述文件
创客与教育：降低CAD学习曲线，快速原型设计

en.tag: A skill library for AI agents to generate CAD, robotics, and hardware designs
en.what: Text-to-CAD is a library of agent skills for CAD, robotics, and hardware design. It enables agents to generate and edit CAD models from plain language or images, export to STEP, STL, 3MF, and produce robot description files (URDF, SDF, SRDF).
en.content: The repo contains multiple skill modules: CAD modeling, CAD viewer, off-the-shelf parts sourcing, slicing, and robot description file generation, each with its own documentation and implementation.
en.stack: Primarily uses Python 3.11+, with CAD kernel (e.g., CadQuery) and robot description libraries; frontend preview is web-based.
en.hot: Combining LLMs with CAD and robotics design dramatically lowers the barrier to hardware design. Gained 297 stars today, total 8649, topping the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate CAD and robotics design skills into agents
Hardware engineers: quickly generate 3D models from natural language
Robotics enthusiasts: auto-generate robot description files like URDF
Makers and educators: lower CAD learning curve for rapid prototyping

zh.tag: 全球主流AI系统提示词泄露收录与透明度研究
zh.what: 持续抓取并归档 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok 等主流 AI 的系统提示词（system prompts），揭示模型在接收用户消息前的隐藏指令与行为规则。项目被《华盛顿邮报》等权威媒体引用，成为 AI 透明度研究的重要信源。
zh.content: 按厂商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI 等）分目录存放各产品的完整系统提示词文本，涵盖常规对话、编程助手（Claude Code、Copilot）、深度研究（Perplexity）等多场景版本。
zh.stack: 以 Markdown 文档为主，辅以简单的 JavaScript 脚本和 GitHub Actions 自动化更新，无需复杂后端依赖。
zh.hot: 本月新增近 3,000 Star 冲上 Trending 月榜第 3，反映出行业与公众对 AI 黑箱指令的极强好奇心；模型版本快速迭代也让提示词考古成为开发者刚需。
uses: AI 研究者与媒体 —— 分析不同厂商的系统级安全策略与价值观对齐方式
提示词工程师与开发者 —— 逆向学习顶级产品的指令工程技巧以优化自身应用
关注 AI 伦理的公众 —— 了解聊天机器人在对话前的隐藏规则与行为边界

en.tag: Leaked system prompts archive for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and more
en.what: This repository systematically collects and archives leaked system prompts from leading AI chatbots like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Grok, exposing the hidden instructions and behavioral rules they receive before processing user messages. Cited by major outlets like The Washington Post, it serves as a key resource for AI transparency research.
en.content: Organized by vendor (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, etc.), the repo stores verbatim system prompt texts across products and scenarios, including general chat, coding agents (Claude Code, Copilot), and deep research modes (Perplexity).
en.stack: Primarily Markdown documentation with lightweight JavaScript utilities and GitHub Actions for automated updates, requiring no complex backend dependencies.
en.hot: Surging with nearly 3,000 new stars this month to hit #3 on GitHub Trending, it reflects intense curiosity about AI black box instructions; rapid model iteration has also made prompt archaeology essential for developers.
uses: AI researchers and journalists — analyze system-level safety policies and value alignment across vendors
Prompt engineers and developers — reverse-engineer instruction-engineering techniques from top products to optimize their own apps
AI-ethics-minded public — understand the hidden rules and behavioral boundaries chatbots follow before responding

zh.tag: 高性能低开销的 Node.js Web 框架，专注开发者体验与插件生态
zh.what: Fastify 是一个专为 Node.js 设计的高性能 Web 框架，致力于在提供卓越开发者体验的同时保持极低的服务器开销。它通过强大的插件架构让开发者能够快速构建可扩展的后端服务，并在高负载下依然保持出色的响应速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Fastify v5 核心源码、完整的类型定义、官方文档网站源码，以及丰富的示例和基准测试脚本。核心由轻量级的路由引擎、请求生命周期管理器和插件系统组成，配套有完善的 CI/CD 工作流。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 运行时开发，核心使用 JavaScript 编写并完整支持 TypeScript，依赖 find-my-way 高性能路由库、Pino 日志库，以及 @fastify 系列官方插件。
zh.hot: 拥有 36.7k Star 的 Fastify 凭借比 Express 更低的性能开销和原生的异步/等待支持，成为 Node.js 生态中构建高并发服务的首选框架之一。本周新增 85 Star 并冲入 JavaScript 周榜第 7，反映出社区对其 v5 版本稳定性与插件生态的持续认可。
uses: 需要支撑高并发 API 服务的后端开发团队
希望从 Express 迁移到更现代、更低开销框架的 Node.js 开发者
构建微服务架构并需要强大插件扩展能力的工程师
追求高性能日志与请求链路管理的运维型开发者

en.tag: High-performance, low-overhead Node.js web framework with plugin architecture
en.what: Fastify is a high-performance web framework for Node.js designed to deliver the best developer experience with minimal overhead. Its powerful plugin architecture enables developers to build scalable backend services that maintain excellent responsiveness under heavy load.
en.content: The repository contains the Fastify v5 core source code, complete TypeScript definitions, official website source, and comprehensive benchmarks. The core consists of a lightweight router, request lifecycle manager, and plugin system with extensive CI/CD workflows.
en.stack: Built on Node.js with JavaScript core and full TypeScript support. It relies on find-my-way for routing, Pino for logging, and the official @fastify plugin ecosystem.
en.hot: With 36.7k stars, Fastify has become a top choice for high-concurrency Node.js services by offering lower overhead than Express and native async/await support. Its 85 new stars this week and #7 spot on the JavaScript trending list reflect sustained community confidence in its v5 stability and plugin ecosystem.
uses: Backend teams building high-concurrency API services
Node.js developers migrating from Express to a more modern, lower-overhead framework
Engineers building microservices that require a powerful plugin extension system
Developers seeking high-performance logging and request lifecycle management

zh.tag: 面向AI代理的HTML交互式编辑器，支持本地人机协作反馈
zh.what: Lavish 是一款本地优先的 HTML 制品编辑器，专为 AI 代理生成的富交互内容设计。它让开发者直接在浏览器中审阅、标注和修改 HTML 文件，并通过 AXI 协议将反馈无缝回传给 Agent，替代低效的截图与长文本沟通。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Lavish Editor 的核心 CLI、AXI 接口实现、本地浏览器渲染引擎，以及面向 Agent Skills 的 npx skills 安装钩子。README 还提供了面向产品计划、技术方案等场景的内置可视化模板。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，以 CLI 形式分发，通过 npm 发布；支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows 跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1,445 星，以 1,967 星登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 月榜第 5。它精准切中了 AI Agent 时代“生成 HTML 容易、协作修改难”的痛点，用本地优先和 AXI 协议重新定义了人机协作的编辑体验。
uses: 使用 AI 编程助手并需要可视化审阅 Agent 生成 HTML 报告/原型的开发者
需要与 Agent 进行精细化交互反馈而非截图和文字的产品经理与技术负责人
希望本地安全运行、不愿将 HTML 制品上传云端的企业与隐私敏感用户

en.tag: Local-first interactive HTML editor for human-AI collaboration on agent artifacts.
en.what: Lavish is a local-first HTML editor designed for AI agent-generated rich artifacts. It lets users review, annotate, and edit rendered HTML directly in the browser, then sends structured feedback back to agents via the AXI protocol—replacing inefficient screenshots and long text messages.
en.content: The repo contains the core CLI, AXI interface, local browser rendering engine, and npx skills install hooks for agent integration. It also ships with built-in visualization templates for product planning and technical design scenarios.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/Node.js and distributed as a cross-platform CLI via npm, supporting macOS, Linux, and Windows.
en.hot: It gained 1,445 stars this month, hitting 1,967 total and ranking 5th on GitHub's monthly JavaScript Trending. It nails the pain point that HTML is easy for agents to generate but hard for humans to collaboratively refine, redefining the human-AI editing loop with local-first principles and the AXI protocol.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants who need to visually review agent-generated HTML reports or prototypes
Product managers and tech leads seeking precise interactive feedback loops with agents instead of screenshots
Privacy-conscious users and enterprises wanting local-first execution without uploading artifacts to the cloud

zh.tag: JavaScript 代码检查与修复工具
zh.what: ESLint 是一个用于识别和报告 ECMAScript/JavaScript 代码中模式的工具，类似于 JSLint 和 JSHint，但使用 Espree 解析器，基于 AST 评估代码模式，并且完全可插拔，每条规则都是一个插件，可以在运行时添加更多规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ESLint 的核心源代码、文档（网站、配置指南、规则列表）、贡献指南、行为准则、问题报告模板、常见问题、发布说明、安全政策、语义化版本政策、ESM 依赖说明、许可证、团队和赞助商信息。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js（要求 ^20.19.0、^22.13.0 或 >=24），使用 Espree 解析器，支持 TypeScript 类型定义（需要 TypeScript 5.3+），可通过 npm 或 pnpm 安装。
zh.hot: ESLint 是 JavaScript 生态中最流行的代码检查工具，月增 251 星，总星数达 27449，持续保持高热度，因为它是保证代码质量和一致性的必备工具。
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript 开发者：在开发过程中自动检查代码错误和风格问题。
团队协作：通过共享配置统一代码风格，减少代码审查中的争议。
CI/CD 流程：集成到持续集成中，在合并前自动检查代码质量。
开源项目维护者：为项目贡献者提供代码规范，保证代码库健康。

en.tag: Find and fix problems in your JavaScript code
en.what: ESLint is a tool for identifying and reporting on patterns found in ECMAScript/JavaScript code. It is similar to JSLint and JSHint but uses Espree for parsing, evaluates patterns via AST, and is completely pluggable—every rule is a plugin and you can add more at runtime.
en.content: The repository contains ESLint's core source code, documentation (website, configuration guide, rules list), contribution guide, code of conduct, issue templates, FAQ, release notes, security policy, semantic versioning policy, ESM dependencies, license, team, and sponsors.
en.stack: Built on Node.js (requires ^20.19.0, ^22.13.0, or >=24), uses Espree parser, supports TypeScript type definitions (requires TypeScript 5.3+), installable via npm or pnpm.
en.hot: ESLint is the most popular linting tool in the JavaScript ecosystem, gaining 251 stars this month to reach 27,449 total, maintaining high popularity as an essential tool for code quality and consistency.
uses: JavaScript/TypeScript developers: automatically catch errors and style issues during development.
Team collaboration: unify code style via shared configs, reducing review disputes.
CI/CD pipelines: integrate into continuous integration to check code quality before merge.
Open source maintainers: provide contribution guidelines to keep the codebase healthy.

zh.tag: 跨平台隐私优先语音转文字工具，支持本地与云端模型
zh.what: OpenWhispr 是一款开源的桌面端语音听写应用，用户可通过全局热键在任何软件中将语音实时转为文字。它支持完全离线的本地转录（Whisper / NVIDIA Parakeet），也允许接入自有密钥的云模型，确保音频数据不出本地即可隐私可控地完成输入。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的跨平台桌面客户端源码与构建产物，覆盖 macOS、Windows、Linux 的全局热键、语音听写、会议转录、AI 笔记及 Agent 功能模块，并附带安装包、API 文档与官网。
zh.stack: 项目以 JavaScript 为主语言开发，基于 Electron 或同类跨平台桌面框架，前端采用现代 Web 技术栈，后端通过本地绑定集成 Whisper 与 NVIDIA Parakeet，并提供 REST API 以对接第三方云服务。
zh.hot: 在 WisprFlow、Granola 等付费语音转写工具备受关注的背景下，OpenWhispr 以“完全开源、零数据收集”的隐私定位成为热门替代方案，本月新增 802 Star，累计达 4,617 Star，跻身 GitHub JavaScript 月榜第 10 名。
uses: 需要高效语音输入的写作者与开发者——通过全局热键在任意编辑器中快速 dictation。
对隐私敏感的用户与团队——利用本地模型实现完全离线的会议转录与笔记生成。
寻求免费替代方案的知识工作者——以开源方案替换 WisprFlow/Granola 进行日常语音记录。

en.tag: Privacy-first cross-platform voice-to-text dictation with local & cloud models
en.what: OpenWhispr is an open-source desktop dictation app that turns speech into text anywhere via a global hotkey. It offers fully offline transcription with local engines like Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet, or cloud processing via BYOK, keeping user audio data private and under their own control.
en.content: The repository includes the full cross-platform desktop client source and release builds for macOS, Windows, and Linux, featuring global hotkey handling, voice dictation, meeting transcription, AI note-taking, and agent modules, plus API docs and a website.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript and built on a cross-platform desktop framework (likely Electron or Tauri) with a modern web-based UI, it binds locally to Whisper and NVIDIA Parakeet for on-device inference and exposes REST APIs for optional cloud integration.
en.hot: Positioned as a free, open-source and zero-telemetry alternative to paid tools like WisprFlow and Granola, OpenWhispr gained strong traction this month with 802 new stars, reaching 4,617 total stars and ranking #10 on GitHub’s JavaScript monthly trending chart.
uses: Writers and developers needing efficient voice input — dictate into any editor via a global hotkey.
Privacy-conscious users and teams — run fully offline meeting transcription and note-taking with local models.
Knowledge workers seeking free alternatives — replace paid tools like WisprFlow or Granola for daily voice logging.

zh.tag: 用 Claude 操控 TradingView 图表的 AI 助手桥
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP 服务器，通过 Chrome DevTools 协议将 Claude Code 连接到本地运行的 TradingView 桌面应用，实现 AI 辅助的图表分析、Pine Script 开发和流程自动化。所有数据处理均在本地完成，不传输外部。

en.tag: AI bridge connecting Claude Code to TradingView Desktop for chart analysis & automation
en.what: An MCP server that connects Claude Code to your locally running TradingView Desktop via Chrome DevTools Protocol, enabling AI-assisted chart analysis, Pine Script development, and workflow automation. All data processing stays local.

en.hot: Combines LLM agents with professional trading tools, meeting traders' automation needs. 4543 stars (+28/day), #3 on JavaScript daily trending.

Developers: study LLM agent interaction with desktop financial apps
Quant researchers: automate backtesting and indicator extraction

zh.tag: Tailwind CSS 最流行的免费开源组件库

en.tag: The most popular free & open-source component library for Tailwind CSS
en.what: daisyUI is a component library built on Tailwind CSS, offering a wide range of ready-to-use UI components without custom CSS. It enables rapid construction of beautiful interfaces with simple class names and supports theme customization.

en.hot: As the most popular component library in the Tailwind CSS ecosystem, it has over 41k stars, with 730 added this month, continuously attracting developers.

Design system teams: leverage theme customization for rapid brand-specific interfaces

zh.tag: 非官方 ChatGPT Linux 桌面端，从 macOS 官方包提取并本地构建
zh.what: 该项目将 OpenAI 官方仅提供 macOS 版本的 ChatGPT 桌面应用（含 Chat、Work、Codex）转换为可在 Linux 运行的 Electron 应用。它通过提取上游 DMG 文件、应用 Linux 兼容性补丁并重建原生模块，最终打包成多种 Linux 发行版支持的安装格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含从 macOS DMG 提取、打补丁、构建原生模块的完整脚本，以及用于 Debian/Ubuntu、Fedora、Arch 和 Nix 的安装包配置；可选的 Linux 专属功能存放在 `linux-features/` 目录，同时提供 AppImage 自构建和本地更新管理器支持。
zh.stack: 基于 Electron 与 JavaScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 运行时；构建系统使用 Makefile 驱动，通过 CI 工作流自动化打包 .deb、.rpm、pacman 及 AppImage，并支持 Wayland 与 X11 显示协议。
zh.hot: OpenAI 迟迟未推出官方 Linux 客户端，该项目填补了空白；本周新增 395 Star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 5，反映出 Linux 开发者对原生 ChatGPT 桌面体验的强烈需求。

AI 重度使用者 —— 需要本地安装 Chat、Work 和 Codex 功能，而非仅使用网页版

en.tag: Unofficial ChatGPT Desktop for Linux, extracted & rebuilt from official macOS DMG
en.what: This project converts OpenAI's official macOS-only ChatGPT Desktop app (including Chat, Work, and Codex) into a runnable Linux Electron application. It extracts the upstream DMG, applies Linux compatibility patches, rebuilds native modules, and packages the result for various Linux distributions.
en.content: The repository contains complete scripts for extracting the macOS DMG, applying patches, and rebuilding native modules, alongside packaging configs for Debian/Ubuntu, Fedora, Arch, and Nix. Optional Linux-only integrations live in `linux-features/`, with support for AppImage self-builds and a local update manager.
en.stack: Built with Electron and JavaScript, requiring Node.js; the build system is driven by Makefiles and CI workflows that automate packaging into .deb, .rpm, pacman, and AppImage formats, with support for both Wayland and X11.
en.hot: With no official Linux client from OpenAI, this project fills a critical gap; it gained 395 stars this week and hit #5 on the JavaScript Trending list, reflecting strong demand from Linux users for a native ChatGPT desktop experience.
uses: Linux developers/users seeking a native ChatGPT desktop experience on Debian, Fedora, Arch, and other distros.
Power users who need local access to Chat, Work, and Codex features instead of relying solely on the web app.
Desktop-centric workflow users wanting system-level shortcuts, local integrations, and an offline update manager.
Open-source contributors interested in unofficial Linux ports, Electron cross-platform patching, and packaging improvements.

zh.tag: Git 工作树 + tmux 窗口的零摩擦并行开发管理器，专为 AI Agent 打造

en.content: The repo includes Rust source code, core commands (add, merge), adapters for multiple terminal backends, a Dashboard and Sidebar UI, and a /worktree skill integration for delegating tasks to agents inside worktrees.
en.stack: Built primarily in Rust, it relies on git worktrees under the hood and supports tmux, Zellij, Kitty, and WezTerm as windowing backends, exposing both CLI and terminal UI interfaces.
en.hot: Riding the wave of AI agent parallel development, it ranks #15 on GitHub Trending Rust, with 1,853 stars and 73 new this week. Its 'zero-friction' philosophy of leveraging existing terminal tools rather than new GUIs directly addresses developer pain points in managing multi-agent workflows.
uses: Terminal developers juggling multiple feature branches who want to avoid constant context switching
Engineers running multiple AI agents (coding, review, testing) in parallel locally
Heavy CLI users of tmux/Zellij/Kitty seeking automated, opinionated workflows

en.tag: Instant, secure, lightweight sandbox purpose-built for AI agents
