zh.tag: 多核友好的C++刚体物理与碰撞检测引擎，服务3A游戏与VR
zh.what: Jolt Physics 是一个为现代多核 CPU 优化的刚体物理与碰撞检测库，专为游戏和 VR 应用设计。它支持在后台线程并行加载物理数据、执行碰撞查询，同时保持主模拟循环的稳定性能与即时可见的数据一致性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的物理引擎源码、可独立运行的示例程序与测试用例，以及针对布娃娃、车辆、碰撞查询等模块的详细文档。代码采用 C++17 编写，提供了跨平台的 CMake 构建系统与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 核心基于现代 C++17 标准开发，无第三方运行时依赖，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 及主流游戏主机平台。构建系统采用 CMake，并集成了 SonarCloud 质量门禁与自动化测试。
zh.hot: 凭借《地平线：西之绝境》与《死亡搁浅2》等3A大作的背书，该仓库已获得近 1.1 万 Star，本周新增 242 星并登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 2 名。开发者在寻求 PhysX/Havok 替代方案时，高度关注其多核并行架构与即时可见的数据一致性设计。
uses: 3A游戏工作室 —— 需要高性能、可定制物理引擎以驱动开放世界与复杂交互的团队
VR/AR开发者 —— 追求稳定物理模拟与低延迟交互的沉浸式应用制作人
独立游戏开发者 —— 寻找零授权费用、跨平台支持且生产验证过的物理中间件
图形引擎研究者 —— 学习现代多核物理架构、碰撞检测算法与无锁数据设计的工程师

en.tag: Multi-core C++ rigid body physics engine powering AAA games and VR apps
en.what: Jolt Physics is a modern, multi-core optimized rigid body physics and collision detection library designed for games and VR applications. It supports background loading of physics data and concurrent collision queries while maintaining stable simulation performance and immediately visible data consistency.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source, standalone sample applications, test suites, and detailed documentation for ragdolls, vehicles, and collision queries. It is written in C++17 with cross-platform CMake build systems and CI configurations.
en.stack: The core is written in modern C++17 with no third-party runtime dependencies, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and major game consoles. It uses CMake for building and integrates SonarCloud quality gates with automated testing.
en.hot: Backed by AAA titles like Horizon Forbidden West and Death Stranding 2, the repo has amassed nearly 11k stars, gaining 242 this week and hitting #2 on GitHub's C++ Trending list. Developers exploring alternatives to PhysX/Havok are drawn to its multi-core parallel architecture and immediate data consistency.
uses: AAA game studios needing high-performance, customizable physics for open worlds and complex interactions
VR/AR developers building immersive apps that require stable simulation and low-latency interaction
Indie developers seeking a zero-license-fee, cross-platform, production-proven physics middleware
Engine researchers studying modern multi-core physics architectures and lock-free data design

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 异步网络与底层 I/O 基础设施库
zh.what: Asio 是一个跨平台的 C++ 库，专注于提供异步网络与底层 I/O 编程能力，统一封装了各操作系统的复杂原生 API。开发者可用它高效构建 TCP/UDP 套接字、串口通信及定时器等组件，广泛应用于高并发服务器、实时系统和嵌入式通信场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含头文件-only 与源码编译两种形态的完整实现，以及示例程序、单元测试和离线 HTML 文档。根目录按 src、include、doc、example 组织，便于直接集成或打包构建。
zh.stack: 核心为现代 C++（C++11 起），零依赖或可选衔接 Boost，支持 Linux、Windows、macOS 及嵌入式平台。编译系统覆盖 Autotools、CMake 和纯 Makefile，适配多种工具链。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 异步网络编程的事实标准之一，Asio 凭借稳定 API 与卓越性能持续吸引开发者，目前获星 6.1k，本周新增 175 星并跻身 C++ 周榜第 8。最新 1.38.1 版本的发布进一步印证了社区对高性能底层 I/O 基础设施的旺盛需求。
uses: 需要构建高并发网络服务或实时通信系统的后端 C++ 开发者
追求跨平台一致 API、不想直接编写操作系统原生 I/O 代码的嵌入式/工具链团队
希望基于成熟异步模型开发游戏服务器、金融行情网关或物联网网关的工程团队

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ library for asynchronous networking and low-level I/O
en.what: Asio is a cross-platform C++ library for network and low-level I/O programming, offering a consistent asynchronous model across operating systems. It abstracts complex native APIs into composable components like TCP/UDP sockets, serial ports, and timers, making it ideal for high-concurrency servers and real-time systems.
en.content: The repository ships the library in both header-only and compiled source forms, alongside examples, unit tests, and offline HTML documentation. It is organized under src, include, doc, and example directories for easy integration or packaging.
en.stack: Written in modern C++ (C++11 and up) with zero mandatory dependencies—optionally interoperable with Boost—and supports Linux, Windows, macOS, and embedded targets. Build systems include Autotools, CMake, and plain Makefiles for broad toolchain compatibility.
en.hot: A de-facto standard for C++ asynchronous networking, Asio maintains strong momentum with 6.1k stars and 175 added this week, ranking 8th on the GitHub C++ Trending list. The recent 1.38.1 release underscores continued community demand for robust, high-performance low-level I/O infrastructure.
uses: Backend C++ developers building high-concurrency network services or real-time communication systems
Embedded and tooling teams seeking a cross-platform, consistent API without managing native OS I/O directly
Engineering teams developing game servers, financial market gateways, or IoT hubs on a proven asynchronous model

zh.tag: 网格优化库，让模型更小渲染更快
zh.what: 这是一个用于优化三角形网格的库，通过减少网格复杂度和存储开销，使 GPU 渲染更高效。它提供了 C/C++ 接口，并支持通过 FFI 从其他语言调用，同时还有配套的 gltfpack 工具和 clusterlod 库。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库源码（src/）、gltfpack 命令行工具（gltf/）、clusterlod 单头文件库（demo/），以及测试和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 C 和 C++ 接口；支持 CMake 构建，也可直接添加源文件；有 Rust 和 JavaScript 的绑定。
zh.hot: 本月新增 464 星，总星数 8187，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）第 4 名。其高效的网格优化算法对游戏开发和 3D 渲染领域至关重要，且提供了多种语言绑定和工具链，受到广泛关注。
uses: 游戏开发者：优化 3D 模型以减少 GPU 负载和内存占用
3D 内容创作者：使用 gltfpack 自动优化 glTF 文件
引擎开发者：集成到渲染管线中提升性能
需要跨语言调用的开发者：通过 FFI 或绑定使用

en.tag: Mesh optimization library for smaller meshes and faster rendering
en.what: This library optimizes triangle meshes to reduce complexity and storage overhead, making GPU rendering more efficient. It provides C/C++ interfaces, supports FFI for other languages, and includes companion tools like gltfpack and clusterlod.
en.content: The repository contains core library sources (src/), the gltfpack command-line tool (gltf/), the clusterlod single-header library (demo/), along with tests and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, offering C and C++ interfaces; supports CMake builds or direct source inclusion; has Rust and JavaScript bindings.
en.hot: Gained 464 stars this month, total 8187, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++). Its efficient mesh optimization algorithms are crucial for game development and 3D rendering, with multiple language bindings and tools, attracting wide attention.
uses: Game developers: optimize 3D models to reduce GPU load and memory usage
3D content creators: use gltfpack to automatically optimize glTF files
Engine developers: integrate into rendering pipelines for performance
Developers needing cross-language calls: use via FFI or bindings

zh.tag: OpenAI Whisper 的 C/C++ 高性能移植，支持端侧与多硬件加速
zh.what: whisper.cpp 是 OpenAI Whisper 自动语音识别（ASR）模型的纯 C/C++ 实现，专注于高性能推理与零依赖部署。它支持从移动端到服务器的全场景运行，可在本地完成语音转文字而无需联网。
zh.content: 仓库核心仅包含 whisper.h 与 whisper.cpp，其余依赖 ggml 机器学习库；提供面向 iOS、Android、WebAssembly、Java 等平台的示例与绑定，以及 Docker 镜像和 C 风格 API。
zh.stack: 基于纯 C/C++ 与 ggml 张量库，无外部依赖；通过 ARM NEON、Metal、Core ML、Vulkan、CUDA、ROCm 等后端实现跨平台硬件加速，并支持 INT8/INT4 量化。
zh.hot: 凭借 51.8k Stars 和本周 238 新增热度，whisper.cpp 以极致轻量化和「苹果芯片优先」策略成为端侧 AI 语音标杆，几乎覆盖了从手机到 NPU 的所有推理场景。
uses: 移动端开发者 —— 需在 iOS/Android 实现离线语音输入与实时字幕
嵌入式与 IoT 工程师 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上部署无网 ASR
跨平台桌面应用开发者 —— 通过 C API 或 WebAssembly 集成转写功能
AI 基础设施团队 —— 构建支持多硬件（NVIDIA/AMD/昇腾）的后端推理服务

en.tag: C/C++ Whisper port optimized for edge & multi-hardware inference
en.what: whisper.cpp is a pure C/C++ implementation of OpenAI's Whisper ASR model, optimized for high-performance inference and zero-dependency deployment. It enables on-device speech-to-text across the full spectrum from mobile to server, all without requiring a network connection.
en.content: The repo centers on whisper.h and whisper.cpp, leveraging the ggml library for ML primitives; it ships with platform examples and bindings for iOS, Android, WebAssembly, Java, plus Docker images and a C-style API.
en.stack: Built on pure C/C++ and the ggml tensor library with zero external dependencies; it accelerates inference across hardware via ARM NEON, Metal, Core ML, Vulkan, CUDA, and ROCm, with support for INT8/INT4 quantization.
en.hot: With 51.8k stars and 238 new stars this week, whisper.cpp has become the go-to edge-AI voice benchmark by pairing extreme lightweight design with an Apple Silicon-first strategy, covering nearly every inference scenario from phones to NPUs.
uses: Mobile developers needing offline speech input and real-time captions on iOS/Android.
Embedded and IoT engineers deploying network-free ASR on Raspberry Pi and low-power devices.
Cross-platform desktop developers integrating transcription via C API or WebAssembly.
AI infrastructure teams building backend inference services across NVIDIA, AMD, and Ascend hardware.

zh.tag: 跨语言高性能开源 RPC 框架与通信基础设施
zh.what: gRPC 是由 Google 开源的现代高性能远程过程调用（RPC）框架，旨在让客户端与服务端应用透明通信。它基于 HTTP/2 和 Protocol Buffers 构建，支持多种编程语言，简化了分布式连接系统的构建。
zh.content: 仓库包含基于 C++ 的核心运行时、多语言绑定（Python、Ruby、PHP、C#、Go、Java 等）以及丰富的示例代码。同时提供构建脚本、测试套件和每日更新的预编译包。
zh.stack: 核心基于 C++ 实现，依赖 Protocol Buffers 作为接口定义与序列化格式，通过 HTTP/2 传输。提供各语言原生 SDK，涵盖 Node.js、Go、Java、Dart、Kotlin 等主流生态。
zh.hot: 凭借 45.1K+ Star 的社区认可度与本周新增 158 Star 的持续热度，gRPC 已成为云原生时代服务间通信的事实标准。其多语言支持与卓越性能使其在微服务架构中广受欢迎，稳居 C++ 周榜第 4。
uses: 后端开发者构建跨语言微服务与分布式系统
云原生架构师设计服务网格与容器化通信方案
基础平台团队打造高性能内部 API 与基础设施
多语言技术栈团队统一服务调用协议与接口规范

en.tag: Cross-language, high-performance open-source RPC framework
en.what: gRPC is a modern, high-performance open-source RPC framework by Google that enables transparent communication between client and server applications. Built on HTTP/2 and Protocol Buffers, it supports multiple languages and simplifies building distributed connected systems.
en.content: The repository contains the C++-based core runtime, multi-language bindings (Python, Ruby, PHP, C#, Go, Java, etc.), and extensive examples. It also includes build scripts, test suites, and daily precompiled packages.
en.stack: The core is implemented in C++, relying on Protocol Buffers for IDL and serialization over HTTP/2. It offers native SDKs for major ecosystems including Node.js, Go, Java, Dart, and Kotlin.
en.hot: With 45.1K+ stars and 158 new stars this week, gRPC has become the de facto standard for service-to-service communication in the cloud-native era. Its multi-language support and outstanding performance make it widely adopted in microservices, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Backend developers building cross-language microservices and distributed systems
Cloud-native architects designing service mesh and containerized communication
Platform teams building high-performance internal APIs and infrastructure
Polyglot teams standardizing service call protocols and interface specifications

zh.tag: 开源像素动画与精灵图编辑器，游戏美术必备工具
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款专注于像素艺术和动画精灵图创作的专业桌面软件，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台。它通过图层与帧分离的动画时间轴、洋葱皮预览和丰富的像素画笔工具，帮助用户制作游戏素材和复古风格动画。软件同时提供 Lua 脚本扩展、命令行接口和多种格式导入导出，满足从个人创作到工业化流程的多样化需求。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面端源码，基于自研 UI 框架构建，涵盖绘画引擎、动画时间轴、颜色管理、文件读写及脚本系统等核心模块。除主程序代码外，还提供了依赖库（如 Skia 图形后端）的集成配置和跨平台构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主体采用 C++ 开发，图形渲染基于 Skia 库，并依赖 Google 的 depot_tools 进行依赖管理；构建系统支持 CMake，覆盖 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三端编译。
zh.hot: 凭借 38.1k+ Star 的社区认可度，Aseprite 是像素艺术领域的事实标准工具；其开源属性与专业级动画功能（如洋葱皮、Lua 脚本）持续吸引独立游戏开发者和艺术创作者，本周再获 211 Star 登上 C++ 周榜前 20。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 快速绘制角色、场景与 UI 的像素风游戏素材
像素艺术家与动画师 —— 制作复古风插画、表情包和逐帧动画
游戏美术教育者 —— 作为低门槛、可扩展的像素画教学工具
工具链集成工程师 —— 利用 CLI 与 Lua 脚本实现自动化资产导出流水线

en.tag: Open-source pixel art & animated sprite editor for game developers and artists
en.what: Aseprite is a dedicated desktop application for creating pixel art and animated sprites across Windows, macOS, and Linux. It features a timeline that separates layers and frames, onion skinning for smooth animation workflows, and pixel-perfect drawing tools tailored for game asset creation. The tool also supports Lua scripting, CLI automation, and extensive import/export formats to fit both hobbyist and production pipelines.
en.content: The repository houses the full C++ desktop application source, built on a custom UI framework, covering the rendering engine, animation timeline, color management, file I/O, and scripting subsystems. It also includes dependency integrations (such as the Skia graphics backend) and cross-platform build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ with Skia handling the graphics backend and Google depot_tools managing dependencies; the project uses CMake and supports compilation on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: With over 38.1k stars, Aseprite is the de facto standard for pixel art; its open-source model combined with professional animation features—such as onion skinning and Lua scripting—keeps attracting indie game developers and artists, earning another 211 stars this week and landing in the top 20 of GitHub’s C++ Trending.
uses: Indie game developers — rapidly creating pixel-art characters, environments, and UI assets
Pixel artists and animators — producing retro-style illustrations, emoticons, and frame-by-frame animations
Game-art educators — teaching pixel fundamentals with a low-barrier, highly extensible tool
Pipeline engineers — automating asset export via CLI and Lua scripting in production workflows

zh.tag: 低延迟语音 AI 工具包，构建实时语音代理
zh.what: Moonshine Voice 是一个开源 AI 工具包，用于构建实时语音代理和界面。它提供语音转文本、意图识别和文本转语音功能，所有处理均在设备端完成，确保低延迟和隐私保护。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、预训练模型、跨平台示例应用（iOS、Android、macOS、Windows、Raspberry Pi 等）以及微控制器部署支持。提供高级 API 用于转录、TTS、语音克隆、说话人识别和对话代理。
zh.stack: 主要语言为 C++，支持 Python、iOS、Android、macOS、Linux、Windows 等多平台。模型基于 PyTorch 训练，推理使用 ONNX Runtime 或自定义引擎。
zh.hot: 凭借极低延迟（优于 Whisper）和完全本地运行的特点，吸引了近万 Star，今日新增 282，适合隐私敏感和实时场景。
uses: 语音助手开发者 —— 快速集成低延迟 STT/TTS 到应用中
边缘设备开发者 —— 在 Raspberry Pi、微控制器上部署语音 AI
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、金融等需要本地处理的语音应用
多语言语音应用 —— 支持中英西日韩等多语种 STT 和 TTS

en.tag: Low-latency speech AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents
en.what: Moonshine Voice is an open-source AI toolkit for building real-time voice agents and interfaces. It offers speech-to-text, intent recognition, and text-to-speech, all running on-device for low latency and privacy.
en.content: The repo includes the core library, pre-trained models, cross-platform example apps (iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, Raspberry Pi, etc.), and microcontroller deployment support. High-level APIs for transcription, TTS, voice cloning, speaker diarization, and conversational agents.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with bindings for Python, iOS, Android, macOS, Linux, Windows. Models trained with PyTorch, inference via ONNX Runtime or custom engine.
en.hot: With ultra-low latency (outperforming Whisper) and fully on-device processing, it has gained nearly 10K stars (+282 today), appealing to privacy-conscious and real-time applications.
uses: Voice assistant developers — integrate low-latency STT/TTS into apps
Edge device developers — deploy voice AI on Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers
Privacy-sensitive scenarios — medical, finance requiring on-device processing
Multilingual voice apps — STT/TTS supporting English, Chinese, Spanish, Japanese, etc.

zh.tag: Google 边缘端 ML/GenAI 高性能推理运行时
zh.what: LiteRT 是 TensorFlow Lite 的继任者，提供在边缘设备上部署机器学习与生成式 AI 的高性能运行时。它支持 GPU/NPU 加速，并集成了 LLM 推理、Web 推理、C++ 张量操作和 CLI 工具链。
zh.content: 仓库包含 LiteRT 运行时核心、构建状态徽章、文档链接以及多个子项目（LiteRT-LM、LiteRT.js、Tensor API、LiteRT CLI）的入口。
zh.stack: 主语言 C++，依赖 Python 3.13 构建环境，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows 多平台，集成 GPU/NPU 加速与 WebGPU/WASM。
zh.hot: 作为 TensorFlow Lite 的官方继任者，LiteRT 在边缘 AI 领域具有重大影响力，本月新增 586 星，总星数 3157，位列 C++ 月榜第 24 名。
uses: 移动端和嵌入式设备上的 ML/GenAI 推理部署
浏览器中通过 WebGPU/WASM 运行客户端 AI
AI 编码代理工作流加速（通过 LiteRT CLI）
边缘端 LLM 部署（通过 LiteRT-LM）

en.tag: Google's on-device runtime for high-performance ML & GenAI deployment on edge platforms
en.what: LiteRT, the successor to TensorFlow Lite, is Google's on-device runtime for deploying ML and GenAI on edge platforms with high performance. It features GPU/NPU acceleration, LLM inference, Web inference via WebGPU/WASM, C++ tensor API, and a CLI toolkit.
en.content: The repo contains the LiteRT runtime core, build status badges, documentation links, and entry points to subprojects like LiteRT-LM, LiteRT.js, Tensor API, and LiteRT CLI.
en.stack: Primary language is C++, with Python 3.13 build environment, multi-platform support (Linux/macOS/Windows), GPU/NPU acceleration, and WebGPU/WASM integration.
en.hot: As the official successor to TensorFlow Lite, LiteRT has significant impact in edge AI, gaining 586 stars this month (total 3157) and ranking #24 on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: ML/GenAI inference deployment on mobile and embedded devices
Running client-side AI in browsers via WebGPU/WASM
Accelerating AI coding agent workflows via LiteRT CLI
On-device LLM deployment via LiteRT-LM

zh.tag: vLLM 昇腾 NPU 社区插件，让大模型推理原生支持国产算力
zh.what: 这是 vLLM 推理引擎的社区维护硬件插件，旨在让主流大模型能够高效运行在华为昇腾（Ascend）NPU 上；它为国产 AI 算力提供了与 CUDA 生态对标的高性能推理方案，降低异构迁移成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含昇腾定制的算子实现、Attention 与采样后端加速模块、vLLM 版本兼容层，以及完整的构建脚本与中文/英文文档。
zh.stack: 核心模块以 C++ 编写并绑定 Python，底层调用华为 CANN 计算架构与 PyTorch 昇腾后端，通过 vLLM 的硬件插件接口完成对接。
zh.hot: 在国产算力替代与自主可控需求推动下，该插件补全了 vLLM 在昇腾生态的关键一环；仓库已获 2,431 Star，本周新增 52 星并跻身 GitHub C++ Trending 第 13 位，关注度持续走高。
uses: 昇腾 NPU 集群用户 —— 希望在华为 910B/310P 等硬件上无缝运行 vLLM 推理服务的工程团队。
国产算力平台构建者 —— 需要基于自主可控芯片搭建大模型推理底座的云厂商与科研机构。
异构适配开发者 —— 从事 AI 推理引擎后端移植、算子优化与硬件插件集成的系统工程师。

en.tag: Community plugin for running vLLM inference natively on Huawei Ascend NPUs
en.what: This community-maintained hardware plugin enables the vLLM inference engine to run efficiently on Huawei Ascend NPUs. It provides a high-performance serving solution for domestic AI hardware, reducing the migration cost from CUDA-centric ecosystems.
en.content: The repository houses Ascend-customized operators, attention and sampling acceleration backends, vLLM compatibility layers, plus build scripts and bilingual documentation.
en.stack: Core modules are written in C++ with Python bindings, calling Huawei's CANN stack and PyTorch Ascend backend underneath, and interfacing with vLLM through its hardware plugin API.
en.hot: Driven by demand for domestic hardware independence, the plugin fills a critical gap for vLLM on Ascend; having earned 2,431 stars with 52 added this week and a spot at #13 on GitHub's C++ Trending, it is gaining significant traction.
uses: Ascend NPU cluster users — Engineering teams seeking to run vLLM inference natively on Huawei 910B/310P hardware.
Domestic AI platform builders — Cloud providers and research institutes building LLM serving stacks on homegrown chips.
Heterogeneous adaptation developers — Systems engineers working on backend porting, operator optimization, and hardware plugin integration for inference engines.

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 原生单元测试与微基准框架，支持 TDD/BDD
zh.what: Catch2 是一个专为 C++ 设计的现代单元测试框架，同时提供微基准测试与基础 BDD 宏支持。它让测试代码看起来像普通 C++ 布尔表达式，无需繁琐的宏定义即可自然编写测试用例。
zh.content: 仓库包含多头文件库源码、CMake 构建配置、CI 工作流及详尽文档；v3 版本从单头文件重构为常规多文件库，提供独立的 benchmark 模块与测试宏集合。
zh.stack: 核心基于现代 C++（C++14/17/20 为主），使用 CMake 构建，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 多平台 CI，并提供 Godbolt 在线体验。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态最流行的测试框架之一，Catch2 已积累超 21k Star，本周新增 769 星并跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 7 名，反映出 C++ 社区对简洁、现代测试工具的旺盛需求。
uses: C++ 开发者 —— 需要为项目快速引入单元测试与回归测试
TDD/BDD 实践者 —— 想用接近自然语言的断言和场景描述写测试
性能工程师 —— 需要集成微基准测试以追踪代码性能回归
开源库维护者 —— 寻求跨平台、 header-only（v2）或现代库形态（v3）的测试方案

en.tag: Modern C++-native unit-testing & micro-benchmarking framework for TDD/BDD
en.what: Catch2 is a modern, C++-native unit testing framework that also offers micro-benchmarking capabilities and basic BDD macros. It lets you write tests using natural C++ boolean expressions without cumbersome macro boilerplate.
en.content: The repository houses a multi-header library source, CMake build configs, CI workflows, and extensive docs. Starting with v3, it was restructured from a single-header library into a normal multi-file library with a dedicated benchmark module and test macro suite.
en.stack: Built on modern C++ (primarily C++14/17/20), uses CMake, supports cross-platform CI on Linux, macOS, and Windows, and offers Godbolt online playground integration.
en.hot: One of the most popular C++ testing frameworks with over 21k stars, Catch2 gained 769 stars this week and hit #7 on the GitHub C++ Trending list, signaling strong demand for lightweight, modern C++ testing tools.
uses: C++ developers looking to quickly integrate unit and regression tests
TDD/BDD practitioners who want natural-language-like assertions and scenario descriptions
Performance engineers needing built-in micro-benchmarking to track code regressions
Open-source maintainers seeking cross-platform testing in header-only (v2) or modern library (v3) form

zh.tag: 极致美观的动态平铺 Wayland 合成器
zh.what: Hyprland 是一个独立、高度可定制、动态平铺的 Wayland 合成器，注重外观而不牺牲功能。它提供最新的 Wayland 特性、丰富的视觉效果（渐变边框、模糊、动画、阴影等）、强大的插件系统、内置插件管理器、撕裂支持（提升游戏性能）等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Hyprland 合成器的完整源代码、文档链接、安装指南、配置示例和画廊展示。代码库以 C++ 编写，易于扩展和阅读。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，不依赖 wlroots、libweston、kwin 或 mutter，完全独立实现。依赖 Wayland 协议和相关库。
zh.hot: 凭借出色的视觉效果和高度可定制性，Hyprland 在 Linux 桌面用户中广受欢迎，Star 数达 36,817，今日新增 24，持续活跃开发。
uses: Linux 桌面用户 —— 追求美观、高效、可定制的平铺窗口管理体验
Wayland 爱好者 —— 希望体验最新 Wayland 特性的用户
开发者 —— 对合成器实现感兴趣，或希望为其开发插件的开发者

en.tag: A highly customizable dynamic tiling Wayland compositor with stunning visuals
en.what: Hyprland is an independent, highly customizable, dynamic tiling Wayland compositor that doesn't sacrifice on its looks. It offers the latest Wayland features, extensive eye candy (gradient borders, blur, animations, shadows), a powerful plugin system, built-in plugin manager, tearing support for better gaming performance, and more.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the Hyprland compositor, documentation links, installation guides, configuration examples, and a gallery. The codebase is written in C++ and is designed to be easily expandable and readable.
en.stack: Developed primarily in C++, Hyprland is fully independent and does not rely on wlroots, libweston, kwin, or mutter. It depends on Wayland protocols and related libraries.
en.hot: With its stunning visuals and high customizability, Hyprland has gained immense popularity among Linux desktop users, amassing 36,817 stars (24 new today) and maintaining active development.
uses: Linux desktop users — seeking a beautiful, efficient, and customizable tiling window management experience
Wayland enthusiasts — users wanting to experience the latest Wayland features
Developers — interested in compositor implementation or developing plugins for Hyprland

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 自动四边形网格重建工具
zh.what: AutoRemesher 是一款跨平台的自动四边形网格重建工具，能将高多边形网格转换为干净的四边形拓扑结构。它基于 Geogram、libigl 等库构建，支持 GUI 和命令行模式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本（qmake/CMake）、第三方依赖（如 TBB）以及示例模型。
zh.stack: 使用 C++14 编写，依赖 Qt 5.15.2、TBB、Geogram、libigl 等库，支持 Linux、Windows 和 macOS。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1768 星，总星数达 3113，在 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）中排名第 18，因其在 3D 建模和游戏开发中的实用价值而受到关注。
uses: 3D 建模师和数字艺术家，用于优化高多边形模型为四边形拓扑
游戏开发者，用于创建适合实时渲染的干净网格
研究人员和学生，用于学习四边形网格重建算法

en.tag: Automatic quad remeshing tool
en.what: AutoRemesher is a cross-platform automatic quad remeshing tool that converts high-polygon meshes into clean quad-based topology. It is built on top of libraries like Geogram and libigl, and supports both GUI and CLI modes.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts (qmake/CMake), third-party dependencies (like TBB), and example models.
en.stack: Written in C++14, depends on Qt 5.15.2, TBB, Geogram, libigl, etc., and supports Linux, Windows, and macOS.
en.hot: Gained 1768 stars this month, reaching 3113 total, ranking #18 on GitHub Trending monthly (C++), due to its practical value in 3D modeling and game development.
uses: 3D modelers and digital artists, to optimize high-poly models into quad topology
Game developers, to create clean meshes suitable for real-time rendering
Researchers and students, to learn quad remeshing algorithms

zh.tag: C++即时模式GUI库，轻量无依赖，专为工具与调试界面而生
zh.what: Dear ImGui 是一个无冗余、自包含的 C++ 即时模式图形用户界面库，专注于为开发者提供内容创作与调试工具的快速迭代能力。它输出优化后的顶点缓冲区，可无缝集成到现有 3D 渲染管线中，无需外部依赖。与传统保留模式 UI 不同，它更适合构建高性能的内部工具、可视化面板和调试窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以核心头文件与单文件源码（imgui.h / imgui.cpp）为主体，并附带大量官方渲染后端与平台绑定（DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、GLFW、SDL、Win32 等）。同时提供开箱即用的示例程序、综合 Demo 窗口、文档 Wiki，以及独立的 imgui_test_engine 测试引擎。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 编写，自包含且无任何外部依赖；通过可插拔后端接入 DirectX、OpenGL、Vulkan、Metal、WebGPU 等现代图形 API，并可绑定至 GLFW、SDL、Win32 等窗口系统。
zh.hot: 作为 C++ 生态中事实标准的工具型 UI 方案，Dear ImGui 已积累 74.7K Stars，本月新增 338 星并位列 Trending 月榜第 13。它几乎被所有主流游戏引擎和 3D 工具链采用，填补了高性能即时调试界面的长期空白。
uses: 游戏/图形引擎开发者 —— 为自研引擎快速搭建关卡编辑器、材质调试与性能分析面板
实时可视化与监控工具 —— 构建机器人、量化交易、嵌入式系统的实时数据看板
桌面工具软件作者 —— 为 C++ 桌面程序创建轻量、可移植的 ImGui 原生界面
算法与科研调试 —— 在图形/仿真/AI 训练过程中快速可视化参数与中间状态

en.tag: Bloat-free immediate-mode GUI library for C++ with minimal dependencies
en.what: Dear ImGui is a bloat-free, self-contained immediate-mode GUI library for C++ that empowers developers to build content creation and debugging tools with rapid iteration. It outputs optimized vertex buffers that can be rendered directly into any 3D pipeline, requiring zero external dependencies. Unlike retained-mode UI libraries, it is purpose-built for high-performance internal tools, visualizers, and debug windows.
en.content: The repository centers on core single-file headers (imgui.h / imgui.cpp) and ships with official renderer backends and platform bindings (DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, GLFW, SDL, Win32, etc.). It also includes ready-to-run examples, a comprehensive demo window, extensive documentation, and a separate imgui_test_engine for automated testing.
en.stack: Written in pure C++ with zero external dependencies; integrates with modern graphics APIs via swappable backends for DirectX, OpenGL, Vulkan, Metal, and WebGPU, alongside platform bindings for GLFW, SDL, and Win32.
en.hot: With 74.7K Stars and 338 new stars this month (ranking 13th on the monthly GitHub Trending), Dear ImGui is the de-facto standard for tooling UIs in C++. It is adopted by virtually every major game engine and 3D toolchain, filling a long-standing gap for high-performance immediate-mode debugging interfaces.
uses: Game/graphics engine developers — rapidly build level editors, material debuggers, and profiling dashboards for custom engines
Real-time visualization & monitoring — create live data dashboards for robotics, quant trading, and embedded systems
Desktop tool builders — craft lightweight, portable native UIs for C++ applications without heavy framework overhead
Algorithm & research debugging — visualize parameters and intermediate states during graphics, simulation, or AI training runs

zh.tag: 跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器，已可运行 Bloodborne 等独占大作
zh.what: shadPS4 是一款使用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持在 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 上运行 PS4 游戏。目前它已能成功启动并运行《血源诅咒》《如龙0》等热门独占作品，尽管仍处于开发初期，尚未达到完美体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心源码、图形/音频后端、指令翻译模块及系统服务实现，同时提供文档、兼容性列表与截图。用户可搭配独立的 QtLauncher 获得完整的图形界面体验。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 开发，利用 Vulkan 等图形 API 实现 GPU 指令转译与渲染，跨平台兼容 Windows、Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借已能运行《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占 3A 大作的突破性进展，该项目吸引了大量玩家与开发者关注，本周新增 332 Star 并累积至 32K+，跻身 GitHub C++ 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 硬核主机玩家 —— 想在 PC 或 Mac 上体验 PS4 独占大作。
模拟器开发者 —— 研究 PS4 系统架构、图形渲染与指令转译技术。
开源贡献者 —— 参与兼容性测试、漏洞修复与性能优化。
游戏研究者 —— 分析 PS4 游戏运行原理与系统调用实现。

en.tag: Cross-platform PS4 emulator already running exclusives like Bloodborne
en.what: shadPS4 is an early-stage PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++, enabling users to run PS4 titles on Windows, Linux, and macOS. It can already boot and play popular exclusives such as Bloodborne and Yakuza 0, though it remains a work in progress with known issues.
en.content: The repository houses the emulator core, graphics/audio backends, instruction translation modules, and system service implementations, along with documentation, compatibility lists, and screenshots. Users can pair it with the separate QtLauncher for a full GUI experience.
en.stack: Built primarily in C++, it leverages Vulkan and other graphics APIs to translate and render GPU instructions, with cross-platform support for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
en.hot: Its breakthrough ability to run PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne has drawn massive attention from gamers and developers, earning 332 new stars this week for a total of 32K+ and placing it 16th on GitHub's C++ Trending chart.
uses: Hardcore console gamers who want to play PS4 exclusives on PC or Mac.
Emulator developers studying PS4 system architecture, graphics rendering, and instruction translation.
Open-source contributors helping with compatibility testing, bug fixes, and performance optimization.
Game researchers analyzing PS4 game execution principles and system call implementations.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台 2D CAD 绘图工具
zh.what: LibreCAD 是一款基于 QCAD 社区版开发的免费 2D CAD 绘图软件，支持读取 DXF/DWG 格式，导出 DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG。它提供点、线、圆、椭圆、抛物线、双曲线、样条曲线等基本图元，并支持高度可定制的 GUI 和 30 多种语言翻译。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 LibreCAD 源代码，基于 Qt 框架和 libdxfrw 库实现 DXF/DWG 读写，并集成了 shapelib 用于 ESRI Shapefile 导入。提供预编译的稳定版和每日构建版，以及命令行工具用于 DXF 到 PDF/PNG/SVG 的转换。
zh.stack: 技术栈：C++、Qt（跨平台 GUI 框架）、libdxfrw（DXF/DWG 读写库）、shapelib（Shapefile 导入）。支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 多平台。
zh.hot: 本月新增 226 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 23 名。作为成熟的免费 CAD 替代方案，持续维护和更新（如 Qt6 支持）吸引了大量用户和贡献者。
uses: 工程师和设计师 —— 用于 2D 工程制图、建筑设计草图
教育领域 —— 作为免费 CAD 教学工具，降低学习成本
DIY 爱好者 —— 制作激光切割、CNC 加工图纸
企业用户 —— 替代昂贵的商业 CAD 软件进行基础绘图

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform 2D CAD drawing tool
en.what: LibreCAD is a free 2D CAD drawing tool based on the community edition of QCAD. It can read DXF/DWG files and export to DXF/DWG/PDF/SVG. It supports primitives like points, lines, circles, ellipses, parabolas, hyperbolas, and splines, with a highly customizable GUI and translations in over 30 languages.
en.content: The repository contains the full LibreCAD source code, built on Qt framework and libdxfrw for DXF/DWG read/write, with shapelib integration for ESRI Shapefile import. It provides precompiled stable and daily builds, plus command-line tools for DXF to PDF/PNG/SVG conversion.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++, Qt (cross-platform GUI framework), libdxfrw (DXF/DWG read/write), shapelib (Shapefile import). Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: Gained 226 stars this month, ranking 23rd in C++ monthly trending. As a mature free CAD alternative, continuous maintenance and updates (e.g., Qt6 support) attract many users and contributors.
uses: Engineers and designers — for 2D engineering drawings and architectural sketches
Education — as a free CAD teaching tool to reduce learning costs
DIY enthusiasts — creating laser cutting and CNC machining plans
Enterprise users — replacing expensive commercial CAD for basic drafting

zh.tag: Google 跨语言结构化数据序列化标准
zh.what: Protocol Buffers 是 Google 开发的语言中立、平台中立、可扩展的结构化数据序列化机制，用于高效编码和交换数据。它通过 .proto 文件定义数据结构，并生成多种语言的代码，广泛应用于 RPC 系统和数据存储。
zh.content: 仓库包含 protobuf 的完整源码，包括 C++ 实现的编译器（protoc）、运行时库、多种语言的生成代码（如 Java、Python、Go 等），以及构建系统（Bazel、CMake）和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定，依赖 Bazel、CMake 等构建工具，并集成 OpenSSF 安全评分。
zh.hot: 作为数据序列化的行业标准，protobuf 在微服务和分布式系统中被广泛采用，本月新增 302 星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 后端开发者：用于定义 API 请求/响应结构，生成高效序列化代码
微服务架构团队：作为 gRPC 等 RPC 框架的数据交换格式
数据工程师：用于大数据管道中的结构化数据编码和存储

en.tag: Google's language-neutral structured data serialization standard
en.what: Protocol Buffers is Google's language-neutral, platform-neutral, extensible mechanism for serializing structured data. It defines data structures in .proto files and generates code in multiple languages, widely used in RPC systems and data storage.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of protobuf, including the C++-based compiler (protoc), runtime libraries, code generators for multiple languages (Java, Python, Go, etc.), build systems (Bazel, CMake), and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, supports multiple language bindings, relies on build tools like Bazel and CMake, and integrates OpenSSF security scorecard.
en.hot: As an industry standard for data serialization, protobuf is widely adopted in microservices and distributed systems, gaining 302 stars this month and maintaining high popularity.
uses: Backend developers: define API request/response structures and generate efficient serialization code
Microservices teams: use as data interchange format for RPC frameworks like gRPC
Data engineers: encode and store structured data in big data pipelines

zh.tag: NASA 开源飞行软件框架，组件驱动快速开发
zh.what: F´ 是一个组件驱动的飞行软件框架，用于快速开发和部署航天及嵌入式软件应用。它由 NASA 喷气推进实验室开发，已在多个太空任务中成功部署，特别适合 CubeSats、SmallSats 等小型航天系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 框架核心（消息队列、线程等）、建模工具（自动生成代码）、可复用组件库、单元与集成测试工具，以及详细的用户手册和教程。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖 Python 3.10+（用于工具链）、Clang 或 GCC 编译器，支持 Linux、Windows (WSL) 和 macOS。
zh.hot: 作为 NASA 官方开源项目，F´ 在航天软件领域具有权威性，本月新增 488 星，总星数达 11633，反映出开发者对航天级嵌入式框架的浓厚兴趣。
uses: 航天器飞行软件开发者，尤其是 CubeSat/SmallSat 项目
嵌入式系统工程师，希望使用组件化架构快速原型
学术研究者，用于教学或航天软件架构研究
对 NASA 技术栈感兴趣的爱好者，探索开源航天工具

en.tag: NASA's open-source flight software framework for rapid embedded development
en.what: F´ is a component-driven flight software framework enabling rapid development and deployment of spaceflight and embedded software applications. Developed by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, it has been deployed on several space missions and is tailored for small-scale systems like CubeSats and SmallSats.
en.content: The repository includes the C++ framework core (message queues, threads), modeling tools for automatic code generation, a growing library of ready-to-use components, testing tools for unit and integration levels, plus comprehensive user manuals and tutorials.
en.stack: Primarily C++, with tooling in Python 3.10+, requiring Clang or GCC compilers, and supporting Linux, Windows (WSL), and macOS.
en.hot: As an official NASA open-source project, F´ holds authority in spaceflight software; with 488 new stars this month and 11,633 total, it reflects strong developer interest in aerospace-grade embedded frameworks.
uses: Spacecraft flight software developers, especially for CubeSat/SmallSat missions
Embedded systems engineers seeking component-based rapid prototyping
Academic researchers for teaching or studying aerospace software architecture
Enthusiasts interested in NASA's tech stack exploring open-source space tools

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
